data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our
 **Agile Delivery** 
 team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

 The
 **Agile Delivery Manager** 
 is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead supplier engagement and governance, including defining SoWs, monitoring SLAs/KPIs, and managing vendor performance to support successful programme delivery. Collaborate with Procurement and Legal teams on commercial evaluations, contract negotiations, and onboarding of strategic technology partners and suppliers.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.


**Leadership Role:** 
 Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

 By joining us, you will become a Heartist®, because hospitality is, first and foremost, a work of heart.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Projects team is dedicated to supporting Accor’s opening teams and owners by delivering a tailored procurement value proposition. This role simplifies the pre\-opening process, generates value for all stakeholders, and ensures compliance with Accor’s procurement policies. As a trusted advisor to owners, you will provide end\-to\-end procurement support throughout the pre\-opening phase.
   

  

**Key Responsabilities**
* Define and lead the end\-to\-end pre\-opening procurement strategy for the Luxury \& Lifestyle portfolio across MEA, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and owner expectations.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration with Brand D\&TS, Development, Operations, and Finance to deliver integrated project outcomes.
* Own BOQs, budgets, and procurement roadmaps; manage a network of Procurement Agents and external consultants with clear performance standards.
* Lead mock\-up reviews, OS\&E design presentations, and takeover evaluations, representing Accor procurement at senior owner and brand forums.
* Project P\&L tracking and revenue collection; deliver executive\-level strategic reporting to SVPs, VPOs, and C\-suite stakeholders.
* Anticipate and mitigate supply chain risks — including lead time exposure, geopolitical disruption, and currency volatility — that could impact project opening dates or budget integrity
* Enforce brand standards throughout the procurement process; identify, escalate, and resolve deviations in coordination with brand, operations, and ownership stakeholders without compromising timelines or budgets
* Develop internal procurement capability by mentoring junior pre\-opening coordinators and procurement officers across the MEA region; embed repeatable processes and tools across the portfolio


**Qualifications**
* 15 years in procurement, supply chain, or project management within luxury hospitality
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-property or multi\-country program budgets, including forecasting, cost tracking, variance analysis, and executive reporting
* Grounded understanding of hotel operations, with the credibility to engage GMs, Heads of Department, and opening teams on operational readiness and procurement sequencing
* Proficiency in ERP or procurement platforms
* Established knowledge of luxury FF\&E manufacturers, OS\&E distributors, and freight/logistics networks across MEA markets, including customs and last\-mile considerations
* Expert negotiation and contract management.
* Strong programme management and P\&L ownership 6 PMP or equivalent certification preferred..
* Proven ability to drive procurement process adoption across diverse pre\-opening teams operating under time pressure
* Travel 40%\+ across the MEA region and market experience of this region is strongly preferred.
* Arabic language a plus

data.jd_text:
**Who You Are**
 Love making things happen? Do you get a weird amount of satisfaction from a perfectly organized spreadsheet, a seamless workflow, and a team running like a well\-oiled machine? We should talk.
   

  

 At Tactical, we build the kind of work people actually stop to watch—producing world\-class creative for global giants like Spotify, Snapchat, and Amazon. But brilliant creative doesn’t just happen by magic. It takes an absolute mastermind behind the scenes to keep the chaos organized, protect the budgets, and turn wild ideas into reality.
   

  

 This isn't a "sit back and take notes" kind of job. You’ll be the operational anchor of our agency, owning the Project Management function, mentoring a killer team of PMs, and personally steering our biggest, most complex projects.
   

  

 In short:
 **You’ll own the function. Lead the team. Run the most important projects.**
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Leveling up the team: Leading, coaching, and mentoring our PM team. You’ll build a culture of accountability, run 1\-to\-1s, and help them level up their commercial and project leadership skills.
* Guarding the framework: Setting the gold standard for how projects are scoped, planned, and delivered across the entire agency before they even hit production.
* Running the big gigs: Stepping up to personally drive our highest\-value, most complex, and strategically vital projects.
* Protecting the money: Ensuring our projects are as profitable as they are creative by catching scope creep early, managing budgets, and keeping delivery tight.
* System mastery: Acting as the ultimate guardian of our PM tool, Productive, ensuring all data is pristine, accurate, and trusted across the agency.
* Building bridges: Partnering with Creative, Client Services, and Finance to keep everyone aligned, navigate shifting priorities, and make sure PM is viewed as a strategic partner, not a support function.


**We're Looking For Someone Who..**
* Believes in great delivery: You know that strong project management isn’t just about tracking tasks—it’s about creating clarity and helping teams do their best work.
* Is calm in the wild: Organized by nature, you bring structure without the boring bureaucracy, and you thrive in fast\-moving agency environments where priorities pivot fast.
* Has the track record: You bring proven experience leading PM or delivery teams within a creative, social, or digital agency setup.
* Talks numbers and deadlines: You possess sharp commercial awareness and understand project profitability, resource allocations, and scoping inside out.
* Knows the tech stack: You are a pro at navigating agency management platforms like Productive, Monday.com, Asana, or similar tools.
* Brings the energy: You have zero ego, great communication skills, a solutions\-focused mindset, and a genuine passion for helping people grow.


 Think you’ve got what it takes to run the engine behind some of the best creative work in the world?
   

  

 Hit the link below to apply! 👇

data.jd_text:
Job Purpose:
 



 Oversee the planning, execution, and control of Rail Design’s Gold Line Metro portfolio, ensuring
 



 alignment with Dubai and RTA strategies, the Rail Network Plan 2032, and the corporate governance framework. Ensure the project is executed with high quality from start to finish. Provide strategic advice, monitor performance, and coordinate with partners to maintain compliant, efficient, and results\-driven delivery. Ensure program management components align with RTA’s strategic objectives, governance frameworks, quality standards, approved budgets, and operational excellence standards.
 



  





 Roles \& Accountabilities:
 



  





 Strategy
 



 • Serve as the primary advisor to RTA management and CEOs on Gold Line Metro portfolio priorities and benefits realization.
 



 • Ensure Gold Line Metro rail design projects’ objectives are aligned with the RTA strategy, Dubai Strategic Plan, and Rail Network Plan 2032, with a focus on design standards, asset
 



 lifecycle, and infrastructure integration.
 



 • Ensure consistency between program objectives and Dubai’s wider urban development frameworks and approved transport and infrastructure masterplan.
 



 • Ensure Gold Line Metro projects comply with the governance framework and corporate and
 



 technical standards.
 



 • Lead strategic committees for Gold Line Metro projects and coordinate corporate partnerships, memberships, and participation in external forums/agreements; follow up on outputs and performance commitments.
 



 • Oversee tracking and review of program\-level design KPIs, including integration of sustainability requirements, cost\-efficient design solutions, and adherence to approved
 



 design delivery schedules.
 



 • Contribute to the review of construction policies, safety standards, and technical procedures in collaboration with engineering and quality teams.
 



 • Drive the integration of sustainability, environmental, safety, and resilience goals across project planning and execution, ensuring consistent adoption of green design standards, safety compliance, and environmental impact mitigation across the projects.
 



  





 Operations
 



 • Review and track design submissions, contractor mobilization, and work design progress to support delivery milestones.
 



 • Conduct review and provide preliminary approvals on vendor and contractor deliverables to
 



 ensure alignment with program requirements, rail design standards and agreed specifications.
 



 • Monitor Gold Line Metro program lifecycle and performance including milestones, budgets,
 



 resource utilization, risk/challenge analysis and deliverables; prepare progress and
 



 completion reports and highlight deviations and recovery actions to the CEO.
 



 • Provide oversight of value engineering reviews at key stages, reviewing comprehensive reports with recommendations for cost reduction, service improvement, and operational
 



 resilience.
 



 • Oversee and align multidisciplinary rail design, review, and approval process covering architectural, structural, civil, MEP, accessibility, and signage elements including amendments
 



 and updates to ensure compliance.
 



 • Review change orders for Gold Line Metro projects, analyze root causes and justifications, ensure need and data validity, and submit recommendations and reports to the CEO and concerned units.
 



 • Champion and standardize application of value management principles during Gold Line Metro project phases and measure project benefits.
 



 • Manage communication and relationships with government/semi\-government entities and external partners including engineering teams, consultants, and contractors to resolve operational bottlenecks.
 



 • Lead CEO meeting preparation and ensure readiness of required briefs, documents, and presentations.
 



 • Manage complaints, escalations and suggestions for project\-related design issues, contractor delays and technical non\-compliance and risks with internal entities to timely closure.
 



 • Oversee maintenance of documentation repositories and reporting systems to ensure
 



 traceability and transparency across all infrastructure design projects.
 



 • Oversee coordination with internal and external stakeholders, including transport authorities
 



 and urban planners, to ensure multimodal integration, right\-of\-way resolution, and seamless
 



 station connectivity.
 



  





 Product / Process Improvement
 



 • Champion digital transformation and predictive project control by integrating advanced tools
 



 (e.g., BIM, GIS, AI\-enabled project tracking) into design and commercial governance.
 



 • Review performance reports and statistical data to identify challenges and propose actionable
 



 solutions.
 



 • Assist in dissemination of pioneering practices and lessons learned from projects in rail.
 



 • Guide the benchmarking of rail design performance against global best practices and lead
 



 continuous\-improvement initiatives.
 



 • Provide recommendations on AI initiatives (including Proof of Concepts and use\-case
 



 validation); ensure compliance with corporate documents.
 



 • Promote a culture of innovation and motivate departments to adopt cutting\-edge solutions.
 



 • Support capacity\-building sessions and awareness initiatives to strengthen program and
 



 project delivery capabilities.
 



  





 Physical Working Conditions
 



 • Hybrid role with regular field visits, design coordination walkthroughs, site inspections,
 



 testing oversight, and handover reviews to ensure quality compliance, address issues, and
 



 validate design implementation.
 



  





 Education:
 



 Bachelor's degree/ Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, Construction Management or Infrastructure Planning.
 



  





 Experience:
 



 • 12\+ years in case of master’s degree (14\+ years in case of bachelor’s degree).
 



 • Minimum 10 years of experience with at least 5 years of experience in program management in related functional area and 5 years of experience with government agencies.
 



  





 Qualification:
 



 Professional Certificate in Program Management (PgMP), PMP Certificate.

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented
 **Associate Director, Project Management** 
 to join our PM/CM Division based in Dubai OR Abu Dhabi, UAE.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced and commercially astute
 **Associate Director, Project Management** 
 to join our Project Management team in either Dubai or Abu Dhabi. This strategic role sits within our Core Office and will be responsible for managing key client relationships, overseeing project delivery during the pre\-construction and early construction phases, and supporting the successful mobilization of Construction Supervision assignments before Resident Engineer deployment.
 



  





 The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to clients, ensuring projects are appropriately planned, resourced, governed, and positioned for successful delivery while maintaining the highest standards of quality, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





 Client Relationship Management
 


* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, stakeholders, developers, government authorities, and project partners.
* Serve as the primary client interface during project initiation, planning, procurement, and mobilization phases.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships and support business growth initiatives.
* Lead project governance meetings and provide strategic guidance to clients throughout project development.



 Project Leadership \& Delivery
 


* Oversee Construction Supervision from award through mobilization and early delivery stages.
* Ensure effective project planning, execution strategies, resource allocation, and risk management processes are established.
* Monitor project performance against scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual obligations.
* Support the transition of projects from the Core Office to site\-based delivery teams, including Resident Engineers and project leadership personnel.
* Provide senior\-level oversight and intervention on critical project issues where required.



 Commercial \& Operational Management
 


* Manage project financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, invoicing, profitability, and resource utilization.
* Review and negotiate contracts, consultancy agreements, variations, and commercial matters.
* Ensure compliance with KEO's governance, quality management systems, and project delivery standards.
* Support bid preparation, technical proposals, project planning, and client presentations.



 Team Leadership
 


* Mentor and support Project Managers and project teams across multiple assignments.
* Promote collaboration across multidisciplinary teams and business units.
* Drive a culture of accountability, excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Support talent development and succession planning initiatives within the Project Management function.



 Risk, Quality \& Governance
 


* Establish project controls, reporting frameworks, and governance structures.
* Identify and proactively manage project risks and mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.
* Champion quality assurance and best practice project management methodologies.

data.jd_text:
**About GTN** 




 GTN is a FinTech\-powered brokerage business operating through its regulated subsidiaries. Backed by NTG Global Holdings Limited (Dubai), International Finance Corporation (IFC) of the World Bank Group, and SBI Ventures Singapore (a subsidiary of SBI Holdings Japan), GTN aims to create the most comprehensive global trading ecosystem. With a global team of over 500 people, GTN provides a multi\-market, multi\-asset class trading platform for institutional clients, operating on a B2B and B2B2C model.
 



 GTN currently serves clients through regulated subsidiaries in London, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong, and the USA. As part of our global expansion, we are focused on bringing our innovative trading platform to more markets worldwide. Our platform is designed for buy\- and sell\-side financial institutions and fintech companies, such as digital banks, wallet providers and neo brokers, offering a seamless experience across trading, wealth management, and API solutions.
 








**About the Role** 




 The Programme Manager will play a critical role in driving the successful delivery and governance of strategic initiatives across GTN Middle East. The role has end\-to\-end accountability for complex, cross\-functional programmes, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with the firm's strategic, commercial, and regulatory objectives.
 



 A key responsibility of this role is the implementation, operation, and ongoing oversight of the New Product Approval (NPA) process, ensuring new products are assessed, governed, and delivered in line with internal controls, regulatory requirements, and executive expectations.
 



 This role suits a senior programme professional with strong judgement, structured thinking, and the confidence to operate with autonomy while engaging and collaborating closely with all levels of stakeholders, including executive leadership.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**Programme \& Project Leadership** 



* Own and manage programmes and projects from initiation, execution to closure, with full accountability for scope, timelines, and outcomes.
* Translate strategic and commercial objectives into clear, executable programme plans with defined milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Oversee multiple workstreams concurrently, ensuring prioritisation and alignment across teams.



**New Product Approval (NPA) Governance** 



* Lead the implementation and ongoing management of the New Product Approval (NPA) process across the organisation.
* Act as the central point of coordination for new product initiatives, ensuring appropriate stakeholder input, approvals, and documentation are completed.
* Ensure new products progress through governance stages in a controlled, transparent, and timely manner.
* Provide visibility to senior management on NPA pipeline status, risks, and decision points.



**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement** 



* Facilitate senior\-level workshops, working sessions, and steering discussions to drive alignment and decision\-making.
* Proactively manage senior stakeholders across Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and Sales.
* Prepare high\-quality executive\-level materials including programme updates, dashboards, decision papers, and presentations for the CEO and leadership team.



**Risk, Delivery \& Change Management** 



* Identify delivery risks, interdependencies, and constraints early, implementing mitigation plans proactively.
* Monitor programme performance using appropriate frameworks, tools, and dashboards.
* Support change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, communications, and training where required, to ensure adoption and sustainability.



**Other Strategic Initiatives** 



* Support on driving other strategic initiatives as required.



  
 



**Requirements** 



* 10\+ years' experience in management consulting (Big 4 preferred) or equivalent programme leadership roles, with exposure to large\-scale transformation initiatives.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes with senior executive visibility.
* Strong experience within Capital Markets (Banking, Trading, Brokerage, Fintech, etc.) and knowledge of trading products.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing C\-suite\-level deliverables.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and comfortable operating in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Proficiency with project and programme management tools; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) desirable but not mandatory.



  
 



**Why Join Us?** 




 Join our dynamic and fast\-growing team building the infrastructure that connects investors around the world to global markets. As investing becomes increasingly more digitally driven, cross\-border, and embedded into financial services, GTN sits at the center of this transformation. Joining GTN means working with innovative partners and talented colleagues across trading, technology, and product teams in a fast\-growing, international environment. If you are excited about the future of fintech and global investing, GTN offers the opportunity to make a real impact.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Project Planning Digital Transformation \& Scheduling Systems Leader is a critical hybrid role responsible for designing, maintaining, and continuously improving the digital scheduling ecosystem that enables integrated project planning and execution across ITO and OTR.
   

  

 This role combines deep Primavera P6 scheduling expertise, project controls process knowledge, automation capability, enterprise systems understanding, and data\-driven analytics to support the One Project Schedule (OPS) operating model and wider planning transformation.
   

  

 The role will act as a bridge between Planning \& Scheduling, Engineering, Equipment Planning, Project Management, Factory teams, IT/UDC developers, PLM, PMx, Data Lake, and other enterprise tool owners. The position will lead the development and governance of scheduling tools, automation workflows, system integrations, dashboards, and data quality controls required to support baseline creation, schedule updates, project readiness, proposal analysis, field test learnings, and execution reporting.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* OPS Digital Scheduling Architecture
* Own and support the digital architecture required to enable the OPS scheduling model across projects.
* Maintain and enhance the Primavera P6 enterprise scheduling setup required for integrated Engineering, Equipment, Factory, Logistics, PM Key Dates, and project baseline schedules.
* Support OPS template governance, baseline schedule creation, rebaseline workflows, and schedule update/reporting processes.
* Ensure scheduling architecture supports integrated logic, cross\-product dependencies, PM Key Dates, CUD/Vendoc requirements, and baseline readiness.
* Partner with planning, engineering, equipment, and tool teams to convert field test learnings into repeatable digital scheduling solutions.
* Primavera P6 Administration \& Enterprise Scheduling Support
* Provide advanced Primavera P6 expertise across EPS/OBS structure, project codes, activity codes, calendars, baselines, layouts, global changes, user access, and schedule configuration.
* Support P6 project creation, template copying, baseline assignment, project coding, and integration readiness.
* Troubleshoot P6 issues related to scheduling options, F9 simulation, constraints, loops, negative float, baseline mismatches, and integration failures.
* Ensure P6 data structures are compatible with downstream tools such as GER, OTD Tracker, PMx, PLM, dashboards, and reporting environments.
* Support controlled deployment of P6 configuration changes in alignment with governance requirements.
* Tool Development, Automation \& Integration
* Lead or support development of automation tools that reduce manual planning effort and improve schedule quality.
* Partner with UDC / IT / development teams to define requirements, test solutions, validate outputs, and manage deployment of planning tools.
* Support integrations between P6 and enterprise systems such as PLM, PMx, Data Lake, UDC, OTD Tracker, LTDB, Vendoc/CDH loaders, and reporting dashboards.
* Translate business process requirements into functional tool specifications, user stories, validation logic, and test cases.
* Own user acceptance testing, defect tracking, and continuous improvement of planning automation tools.
* Ensure automation solutions are scalable, auditable, and aligned with project controls governance.
* ITO Proposal Planning \& Analysis Support
* Support ITO planning teams with proposal schedule analytics, standard cycle validation, lead time analysis, and bid readiness reviews.
* Handle complex TK and EEP projects scheduling during ITO phase including coordination with Partners, support deal teams for discussions with Customer during clarification phase.
* Help strengthen ITO\-to\-OTR handover by ensuring proposal assumptions, standard cycles, customer commitments, and OPS schedule logic are aligned.
* ITO analysis tools and dashboards maintenance / upgrade to compare contractual commitments against OPS/LTDB standard cycles.
* Identify disconnects between as\-sold dates, standard cycles, and execution templates before OTR baseline development.
* Provide analytical support for proposal risk reviews, schedule feasibility checks, and planning assumptions.
* Data Quality, Reporting \& Analytics
* Develop and maintain data quality checks for schedule readiness, baseline completeness, project codes, activity coding, MLI mapping, baseline type, and reporting eligibility.
* Support dashboards and analytics for schedule health, readiness gates, negative float, critical path, variance, cycle compliance, and tool sync status.
* Partner with reporting and data teams to ensure schedule data is accurately extracted, transformed, and consumed by downstream reporting tools.
* Support root cause analysis when projects do not appear correctly in trackers, dashboards, GER, OTD, or PMx/PLM reporting.
* Create structured diagnostics and issue\-resolution playbooks for recurring tool and data problems.
* Governance, Process \& Standardization
* Support creation and maintenance of QMS / governance documents for OPS tools, template management, baseline creation, rebaseline, reporting, and integrations.
* Define standard work instructions for tool users, planners, schedulers, and functional teams.
* Support monthly working team reviews and quarterly governance reviews for OPS tools and scheduling architecture.
* Maintain clear RACI alignment between Planning, Engineering, Equipment, Factory, PM, IT/UDC, and tool owners.
* Ensure lessons learned from pilot projects and field tests are converted into sustainable process and tool improvements.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management
* Act as a key interface between business users and technical development teams.
* Facilitate workshops, tool demos, issue\-resolution sessions, and schedule readiness reviews.
* Train and coach planners, schedulers, and stakeholders on tool usage, P6 configuration, automation workflows, and data governance expectations.
* Communicate technical issues in a clear, business\-oriented manner to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Promote adoption of standardized, integrated, and digitally enabled project controls practices.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 10 Years of experience in project controls, planning, scheduling, project management systems, or enterprise tool implementation.
* Strong working knowledge of Primavera P6, including project structures, baselines, codes, scheduling options, logic, calendars, and reporting data.
* Experience supporting complex projects, preferably in power generation, energy, infrastructure, engineering, manufacturing, or EPC environments.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business process needs into tool requirements, functional specifications, test scripts, and automation logic.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including Planning, Engineering, Equipment, Project Management, IT, and data/reporting teams.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
* Ability to diagnose complex system, data, and process issues and drive them to closure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Systems thinker with the ability to connect project controls processes, scheduling logic, enterprise tools, and business outcomes.
* Strong problem solver who can diagnose issues across people, process, data, and system layers.
* Comfortable operating between technical developers and business users.
* Proactive, structured, and execution\-focused.
* Able to challenge assumptions while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.
* Detail\-oriented with strong ownership mindset.
* Curious and willing to learn new tools, integrations, and business processes.
* Strong facilitator who can lead working sessions, issue reviews, and governance discussions.

data.jd_text:
At Coface, we’ve been managing credit risk for more than 75 years to help companies navigate and grow in an uncertain and volatile environment.
   

  

 We act for trade.
   

  

 As a global leading player in trade credit risk management, we support the growth of 100,000 clients across some 200 markets.
   

  

 Whatever their size, location or sector, we offer companies a full range of solutions: Trade Credit Insurance, Business Information, Debt Collection, Single Risk insurance, Surety Bonds, Factoring.
   

  

 Every day, we leverage our unique expertise and cutting\-edge technology to make trade happen, in both domestic and export markets.
   

  

**Commitments**
**Diversity, equity, and inclusion**
 Coface is fully committed to creating a work atmosphere that respects the individualities and diversity of its teams. Given the nature of its business, which operates across a global scope, Coface must remain a multicultural company. To that end, employees must benefit from an inclusive and non\-discriminatory work environment. This allows for collaborative and fruitful work between teams representing 80 nationalities and working in 58 countries.
   

  

 Coface has been focusing in particular on gender equity and gender balance in career opportunities, and diversity in senior management roles. Coface has initiated numerous actions plans in that field, together with indicators for monitoring progress.
   

  

 Accordingly, diversity and inclusion are a key component of the Group Human Resources strategy. Coface work environment must be seen as inclusive and the company as a place where employees can thrive and contribute their authenticity to their professional activities.
   

  

 To that end, Coface has introduced training and awareness\-raising initiatives to encourage the transformation of the corporate culture towards greater openness to diversity.… more
   

  

**Career growth and learning**
 At Coface, we strive to establish and develop a lasting relationship of trust, encouraging integration, and supporting professional development; these are our priorities and commitments.
   

  

 We have a dedicated program called “Move \& Grow” to boost internal mobility. In fact, we believe in internal mobility as an accelerator of career growth, as much as a fantastic opportunity to learn and grow from a more personal standpoint. We encourage you to seize every opportunity to get out of your comfort zone, by changing jobs and taking on new responsibilities.
   

  

 In parallel, we have a program dedicated to new comers, which provides access to all the information necessary for integration and allows them to follow a path marked out by individual meetings, immersive experiences, training and informal sharing moments. Furthermore, in order to continually develop your individual talent, we have a digital training platform with a wide range of content which encourages the sharing of exchanges and experience between the group's employees. We also have mentoring programs and much more to support your career development.
   

  

**Description**
**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities \- Build\-up and manage transformation programs, according to the company's strategy ; \- Build\-up and manage process efficiency with the fronters, to reach better quality of service. \- Set up local governance for Projects portfolio management; \- Coordinate requirements collection and change management for tools enhancements/corrections requests ; \- Animate local committees to gather needs \& development requests ; \- Plan \& follow up the activities, motivate and inspire team to successfully complete tasks ; \- Build strong relationships, achieve buy\-in of key stakeholders and influence others ; \- Risk management: coordinate the issues to be solved and decisions to be taken ; \- Ensure key deliverables are met, the projects finishes on time and budget ; \- Apply continuous improvement in project methodology ; \- Report at different levels (tactical/operational/board of directors) with timely and effective communication on opportunities, wins, financial impacts, KPIs, and concerns ; \- Manage successful handoffs to business owners and project closing ; \- All this activities will be performed with the support of a regional PMO team in charge of the strategic projects portfolio (coordination of projects \& provide global vision and coherency between projects).
   

  

**Missions**
 In the framework of Operations department, we are looking for a Transformation \& Business Process Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for projects and change management. You will also support process mapping, gap analysis and actions plan to improve quality, efficiency and customers / partners satisfaction. The main contact points will be with Business all functions, IT, Marketing, control functions. Key the participation in international working group and steering committees. This position will be based in Dubai and will report directly to local Country Manager and functionally to MAR Chief Operations Officer. Transformation Office believes in creating an exciting work environment in which we can develop professional skills around leading change, inspiring teams and developing professional collaboration in an international environment. Team members from all backgrounds get together here to tackle complex strategic transformation projects. We believe in sharing knowledge and collaborating, because only if we can improve ourselves, we will be able to help Coface improve sustainably.
   

  

**Experiences**
 Job Experience
   

  

* Knowledge of Coface business
* Minimum 5 years of experience in project management or process management
* Knowledge of Coface products and processes is a plus


 Competencies
   

  

 Technical skills :
   

  

* Knowledge of project \& change management processes and tools (Waterfall, Agile Project Management tools)
* Ability to anticipate risks, and manage mitigation with key stakeholders
* Excellent level of English required
* Previous experience in LEAN / Processes mapping and improvement
* Easiness with data analysis and KPIs definition and monitoring


 Soft skills
   

  

* Process/IT Curiosity \& ability to find out of the box solutions ;
* Strong leadership capacity, ability to drive and positively influence the motivation and development of project teams, capacity to take responsibility, management of virtual teams
* Authenticity, collaboration and open communication
* Ability to facilitate project meetings, negotiate with business or technical players, know how to get things done through formal channels and informal networks, effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.
* Ability to adapt to frequent changes and contingencies, management of time pressure priorities
* Ability to set clear values, priorities and standards, strong orientation to results, eager for achievement
* Excellent abilities to communicate at all levels of the organization


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or similar
   

  

**Additional Information**
* A culture focused on teamwork, continuous learning, and professional development
* Competitive base salary \+ performance based bonus
* Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance

data.jd_text:
The
 **Onboarding Lead** 
 is responsible for managing the end\-to\-end onboarding of new entities, programs, or operational changes into the current environment. The role ensures all changes are clearly identified, risks are assessed and mitigated, and stakeholders are aligned to enable a smooth, controlled, and successful transition.
 



 The Onboarding Lead acts as a
 **bridge between operations, change management, and stakeholders** 
 , ensuring readiness, adoption, and minimal service disruption during transitions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Change Identification \& Impact Visibility** 



* Identify and clearly articulate all operational, technological, and process changes resulting from onboarding activities
* Develop
 **Change Impact Assessments** 
 across key dimensions (people, process, technology, policy)
* Translate complex changes into simple, structured communication for stakeholders
* Maintain a centralized
 **Impact Register** 
 and onboarding tracker



  





**2\. Risk Management \& Mitigation Planning** 



* Identify onboarding\-related risks (operational, cultural, technical, and stakeholder risks)
* Conduct structured
 **risk assessments and impact analysis** 
 aligned with change governance standards
* Develop and document
 **mitigation plans and contingency strategies** 
 for each identified risk
* Maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and ensure regular updates
* Escalate critical risks to governance forums (PMO, Steering Committee)



  





**3\. Transition \& Onboarding Management** 



* Lead the onboarding lifecycle including:
* Entity assessment
* Requirement gathering
* Operational readiness evaluation
* Transition planning and execution
* Ensure onboarding aligns with overall program governance and timelines
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (Operations, IT, HR, Training, QA)



  





**4\. Change Management Execution** 



* Apply structured
 **Change Management methodologies (e.g., ADKAR, Kotter)** 
 for adoption and transition success
* Support stakeholder engagement, communication planning, and readiness assessments
* Drive change adoption through clear messaging, training alignment, and leadership engagement
* Identify resistance areas and implement targeted action plans



  





**5\. Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication** 



* Work closely with entity stakeholders, sponsors, and leadership teams
* Conduct onboarding workshops and alignment sessions
* Provide regular updates on:
* Change impacts
* Risks and mitigation status
* Readiness levels
* Act as the
 **single point of contact for onboarding and transition activities**



  





**6\. Readiness \& Go\-Live Governance** 



* Define and execute
 **readiness assessments** 
 prior to go\-live
* Ensure all onboarding criteria are fulfilled before transition
* Support decision\-making through structured readiness reports
* Coordinate go\-live activities and stabilization support



  





**7\. Documentation \& Governance Compliance** 



* Ensure all onboarding activities comply with:
* Change management standards
* Program governance frameworks
* Audit and documentation requirements
* Maintain:
* Change logs
* Impact assessments
* Risk registers
* Onboarding trackers



  





**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong knowledge of
 **change management principles (ADKAR, Kotter)**
* Proven experience in
 **transition management / large\-scale onboarding projects**
* Strong analytical capability in
 **risk identification and mitigation planning**
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills (executive\-level)
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across government entities



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* Minimum
 **5–8 years** 
 in operations, transition management, or change management roles
* Experience in
 **contact center or large transformation programs preferred**
* Proven track record in delivering complex onboarding or transition programs
* Bachelor’s degree (Business, Operations, Engineering, or equivalent)
* Change Management certification (Prosci, etc.) is a strong advantage



  





**KPIs / Success Measures** 



* Successful onboarding delivery within agreed timelines
* % readiness achieved before go\-live
* Reduction in post\-go\-live incidents
* Risk mitigation effectiveness (no major unmitigated risks realized)
* Stakeholder satisfaction and adoption levels



  





**Reporting Line** 



* Reports to:
 **Operations Director**
* Works closely with: PMO, Change Management Lead, Entity Stakeholders, IT, Training, QA

data.jd_text:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 At Jacobs, we'll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. Working at Jacobs offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.
   

  

 People are Jacobs’ greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent.
   

  

 Jacobs Advisory is seeking a senior
 **Strategy \& Transformation Lead** 
 to play a pivotal role in the growth of our Strategy \& Transformation capability in the Middle East.
   

  

 This is a leadership position for an experienced transformation professional who will both grow and shape an evolving regional capability and personally lead complex, high‑profile engagements for government and major private‑sector clients across the region.
   

  

 The role suits a leader with deep experience in public\-sector and infrastructure‑related transformation, someone who is comfortable operating at executive level, guiding large organisations through strategy, operating model redesign, and enterprise‑scale change, while building a strong, sustainable internal team around them.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The
 **Strategy \& Transformation Lead** 
 will
   

  

* Grow and shape Jacobs Advisory’s Strategy \& Transformation capability in the Middle East
* Act as lead advisor and engagement head on major transformation assignments
* Partner with senior government and private‑sector leaders to define direction and deliver lasting organisational change
* Develop people, methods, and market presence to support long‑term regional growth


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Grow and Shape the Regional Strategy \& Transformation Capability
   

  

* Play a leading role in maturing and scaling an existing Strategy \& Transformation capability, strengthening its market positioning, depth, and impact across the Middle East.
* Shape service offerings, approaches, and intellectual property across areas such as
* Public‑sector and infrastructure strategy
* Target operating model design
* Organisational Restructuring and governance
* Transformation delivery and change management
* Mentor, develop, and retain senior and mid‑level consultants, building a high‑performing, trusted team.
* Work collaboratively across Jacobs Advisory and the wider Jacobs business, integrating strategy and transformation with technical, digital, and delivery capabilities.
* Contribute to thought leadership, market engagement, and strategic pursuits aligned to government and city‑scale transformation agendas.


 Lead Complex Client Engagements
   

  

* Act as lead engagement partner for major, complex assignments, particularly for government, municipal, infrastructure, and regulated‑sector clients.
* Personally lead strategy and transformation programme spanning
* Enterprise and sector strategies
* Target operating models and organisational design
* Service delivery improvement
* Capability, governance, and performance frameworks
* Large‑scale change and implementation oversight
* Engage directly with senior client stakeholders, including Director Generals, executives, board members, and senior officials.
* Facilitate executive‑level discussions, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and guide clients through ambiguity, change, and decision‑making.
* Ensure engagements deliver practical, implementable outcomes with clear impact.


 Support Market Growth and Client Relationships
   

  

* Build long‑term trusted relationships with senior clients across government and the private sector.
* Lead or support major pursuits, shaping compelling propositions that reflect Jacobs integrated advisory and delivery capabilities.
* Represent Jacobs Advisory confidently in high‑level client forums, industry events, and strategic discussions across the region.

 You are a senior strategy and transformation leader with the presence, judgement, and experience to operate at the highest levels of client organisations while building strong internal teams.

* 20\+ years experience in strategy, transformation, or management consulting, with significant exposure to public‑sector, infrastructure, utilities, or regulated environments
* A strong track record leading large\-scale Strategy and Transformation Programmes , including enterprise or sector‑wide change across complex organisations.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing
* Target operating models
* Organizational and governance structures
* Performance and capability frameworks
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior executives and public‑sector leaders, acting as a trusted advisor rather than a technical specialist.
* Experience growing teams, mentoring senior professionals, and shaping advisory capabilities within a consulting or professional services environment.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and leadership skills, with the credibility to operate confidently in complex,high‑profile client environments.


 A degree in a relevant discipline (such as strategy, engineering, management, public policy, or similar) is expected. Career progression, leadership capability, and delivery track record are considered more important than specific academic backgrounds.

data.jd_text:
A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, employs approximately 48,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. **About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

data.jd_text:
Role : Director\- Delivery \& Installation Operations
 



 Location: Dubai, UAE
 



  





 This role exists to industrialize delivery and installation operations by introducing scalable operational systems, process discipline, and advanced last\-mile execution methodologies into a high\-volume, concurrent project environment. The position does not replace existing technical expertise — it complements it by building the operational architecture, governance, and scalability layer the business requires for its next phase of growth.
 



  





 The organization currently operates approximately 25 active customer projects per day across varying project sizes, product categories, installation durations, site conditions, and customer expectations. The environment has transitioned from a linear model to a dynamic operational network requiring:
 



 • Concurrent multi\-site project management
 



 • Daily resource reallocation and scheduling
 



 • Continuous customer communication at scale
 



 • Real\-time operational dependency management
 



 • Structured escalation and SLA\-based execution
 



  





 The core challenge is not technical installation knowledge — the organization possesses strong field execution capability. The gap is the absence of advanced process\-driven operational leadership capable of transforming fragmented execution into a scalable, predictable, and systemized operational engine.
 



  





 1\. Operational Architecture \& Process Design
 



 • Design, document, and implement end\-to\-end operational workflows covering scheduling, dispatch, installation sequencing, and project closure
 



 • Standardize all field execution processes across crew types, project categories, and site conditions
 



 • Build and maintain operational SOPs, handover protocols, and quality checkpoints
 



 • Transition the department from reactive firefighting to a structured, repeatable execution model
 



 2\. Multi\-Project Scheduling \& Dispatch Optimization
 



 • Own the daily and weekly scheduling function for all active installation and delivery projects
 



 • Implement dispatch optimization logic to maximize crew utilization and minimize idle time
 



 • Develop priority sequencing models that account for site readiness, product availability, and customer commitments
 



 • Manage resource conflicts and reallocate teams dynamically in response to live operational changes
 



 3\. Operational Control Tower
 



 • Establish and operate a live control tower function providing real\-time visibility into all active projects
 



 • Define and monitor key operational KPIs: on\-time completion rate, revisit rate, crew utilisation, SLA adherence, and delay frequency
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting structures for daily operational review and senior management reporting
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks early and drive structured resolution
 



 4\. Workforce Coordination \& Utilisation
 



 • Manage crew capacity planning, deployment, and productivity tracking
 



 • Coordinate with HR on workforce resourcing, shift planning, and contractor management
 



 • Develop performance frameworks for field teams aligned to operational KPIs
 



 • Reduce overdependence on key individuals by building cross\-trained, interchangeable crew structures
 



 5\. Customer Coordination \& SLA Management
 



 • Define and enforce SLA frameworks covering installation lead times, communication standards, and escalation thresholds
 



 • Work with customer\-facing teams to align operational capacity with customer commitments
 



 • Build structured customer coordination protocols for pre\-installation, day\-of, and post\-installation touchpoints
 



 • Own escalation handling for time\-sensitive or complex customer situations
 



 6\. Technology \& Systems Integration
 



 • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of operational management technology (scheduling tools, field service management platforms, and dispatch systems)
 



 • Work with IT to integrate operational systems with ERP, CRM, and customer portals
 



 • Drive adoption of digital tools across field teams to improve real\-time communication and job visibility
 



 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 • Act as the primary operational interface between the installation department, sales, logistics, procurement, and customer experience teams
 



 • Align project execution timelines with product availability, warehouse readiness, and client schedules
 



 • Participate in strategic planning discussions to translate business growth targets into operational capacity requirements
 



  





 8\. Leadership \& Culture
 



 • Build and mentor a high\-performance operational leadership team within the department
 



 • Establish a culture of accountability, process discipline, and continuous improvement
 



 • Champion data\-driven decision\-making and operational transparency across all levels of the team
 



  





 Academic Qualification :
 



 Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field
 



 Master's degree (MBA or MSc Operations/Supply Chain Management)
 



 Certification
 



 Relevant operational or project management certification (PMP, APICS CPIM, or equivalent)
 



 Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt; PRINCE2; Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
 



 Industry knowledge
 



 Demonstrated understanding of last\-mile logistics, field service operations, or installation project management
 



 Experience with furniture, fit\-out, modular kitchen, or home installation industries
 



 Proficiency in operational management tools, scheduling platforms, and ERP systems
 



 Experience with field service management software (e.g. ServiceMax, FieldAware, SAP FSM)
 



  





 Experience :
 



 Minimum 15 years in operations leadership, with at least 5 years at a senior management or director level
 



 Last\-mile operations
 



 Proven track record in high\-volume last\-mile delivery or installation environments (25\+ daily projects)
 



 Process transformation
 



 Demonstrated experience transitioning reactive operational models into scalable, process\-driven execution frameworks
 



 Multi\-site management
 



 Experience managing concurrent projects across multiple sites with dynamic resource allocation
 



 Team leadership
 



 Experience building and leading cross\-functional operations teams of 20 or more
 



 Technology implementation
 



 Track record of leading operational technology deployments (scheduling, FSM, ERP, or dispatch systems)

 At Emirates we are committed to helping our people grow and thrive. If you're ready for a rewarding and challenging career, apply today and become part of our world class team.
   

  

 Salary \& benefits

On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance, and more. data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is one of the world's fastest\-growing mobility infrastructure companies.
   

  

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility will depend on. The company is pre\-IPO, operating at scale across multiple geographies, and moving through one of the most consequential phases of its growth.
   

  

 The pace is fast and the stakes are high. The decisions being made now will define the company for a decade. We are building the next phase of this business to be AI\-native from the ground up and the people around the leadership table need to be operating at their best.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Strategy \& Operations serves as a trusted partner to the Co\-CEO and President, ensuring that ambitious growth plans are executable, aligned, and supported across the organisation. The role will be crucial in operationalizing the vision of Moove.
   

  

 On the execution side, this role owns the operating rhythm of the leadership team, converts strategic direction into clear accountabilities, and ensures decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded across business units. On the strategic side, the Director of Strategy \& Operations researches and constructs long\-term corporate strategy, embeds governance and decision rights, and provides forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into any corporate planning.
   

  

 Because much of the company’s operating infrastructure is still being built, this role carries significant build responsibility. The Director of Strategy \& Operations will design the ways of working, stand up performance frameworks, and embed the OKR and scorecard systems through which the business runs. This is an execution role with strategic range, the ratio matters, and the ceiling is high.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Strategy and Governance
   

  

* Research, construct, and support the development of long\-term corporate strategy in partnership with the Co\-CEO and President; ensure it is cascaded into business unit priorities through structured communication channels including town halls, leadership briefings, and BU\-level planning.
* Operationalise the operating model, ensuring business units are aligned, accountable, and able to deliver against growth priorities
* Guide the decentralisation effort, embedding governance structures and clear decision rights across business units
* Partner with senior functional leaders to identify and close capability gaps that impact business performance
* Provide forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into future strategy


 Operating Rhythm and Execution
   

  

* Own the executive operating rhythm, leadership meetings, offsites, board and committee reviews, ensuring decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded
* Translate strategic direction into clear actions, owners, and timelines across the organisation; hold stakeholders accountable to commitments
* Identify and remove blockers; drive stalled decisions to resolution with pace and rigour
* Facilitate integration across functions and business units, aligning resources and priorities to avoid silos
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact business performance or growth, ensuring mitigation plans are in place


 Performance and Organizational Effectiveness
   

  

* Embed OKRs and business performance scorecards in collaboration with the People Team; provide data\-driven insights to the Co\-CEO and executive team to inform decisions
* Ensure business performance outcomes are supported by aligned people performance priorities
* Manage information flow to and from the Co\-CEO, surface what requires attention and filter what does not


**Strategic Outputs**
* Prepare and own high\-stakes outputs: board materials, investor updates, strategic documents, and executive briefings
* Lead specific strategic and operational workstreams directly when required, including platform development and capital markets preparation
* Identify and deploy AI tools and workflows to increase the velocity and quality of the Co\-CEO’s office


**Experience**
**What You will need for this position**
* 6–10 years of experience owning outcomes in high\-growth or high\-complexity environments
* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, Director of Strategy \& Operations, COO, or senior operator at a high\-velocity technology company, or equivalent seniority from top\-tier strategy consulting with demonstrated operational delivery
* Experience building or running a critical function through a period of rapid growth, transformation, or M\&A activity
* Demonstrable track record of closing things, decisions, commitments, workstreams, at pace and without loss of quality


**Skills And Capabilities**
* Exceptional written communication; produces board\-quality documents, strategic memos, and executive briefings independently
* Ability to process complexity quickly, communicate it clearly, and operate with minimal direction
* Genuinely AI\-native; uses AI to increase personal and team velocity, with experience managing AI\-enabled workflows or operating system design
* Sufficient fluency across technology, capital markets, and business transformation to engage credibly across Moove’s active workstreams
* Strong product and technology instincts; understands how software is built, how platforms scale, and how technology and physical operations intersect
* Sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate
* Available across geographies and time zones as required


**What Does Success Look Like**
* The Co\-CEO and President’s office operates as a high\-performance execution engine, no decisions stall, no commitments drop
* The company’s operating cadence is designed, implemented, and running effectively within the first 90 days
* OKRs and performance scorecards are embedded and generating actionable insights for the executive team
* Governance structures and decision rights are documented and operational across all business units
* Board and investor outputs are produced on time, to a consistently high standard
* Strategic workstreams move faster and with greater clarity as a direct result of this role’s involvement


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CO\-CEO \& President, and closely working with our office of the CEO team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.
