 We are looking for a Managing Director to become the senior operating leader r
data.jd_text:
Role Overview
   

  

 Outpace Professional Services (OPS) is building a multi\-practice professional services platform across business systems, legal and corporate services, advisory, and future service areas.
   

  

 We are looking for a Managing Director to become the senior operating leader responsible for scaling OPS from a founder\-led services company into a disciplined, multi\-practice professional services firm. This person will build the management system, leadership cadence, commercial discipline, delivery governance, and acquisition\-readiness required to support ambitious growth.
   

  

 The Managing Director will own the operating layer between executive strategy and day\-to\-day practice execution. They will ensure each practice has clear leadership, P\&L accountability, delivery standards, growth targets, KPI visibility, and escalation discipline.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands\-on operating role for someone who has scaled professional services, consulting, systems integration, advisory, or multi\-practice services organizations before.
   

  

 Practice Areas
   

  

**OPS Currently Works Across Several Professional Services Areas, Including**
* Business Systems: ERP/Odoo, Salesforce, Notion, AI workflow automation, systems integration, operational reporting, and adjacent business\-platform services.
* Legal \& Corporate Services: business law, corporate structuring, compliance, governance support, and related corporate\-service offerings.
* Advisory: PMO, operational advisory, transformation support, implementation oversight, and executive/project governance.
* Additional practice areas may be added organically or through acquisitions.


 Location
   

  

 Preferred location is Dubai, aligned with the future executive center of gravity for the Outpace platform.
   

  

 OPS will also consider exceptional candidates based in the US or Europe, provided they have strong overlap with North American clients, acquisition targets, vendors, and team operating hours.
   

  

 Travel is expected for client, vendor, acquisition, leadership, and integration needs across North America, Europe, and the Middle East.
   

  

 Reporting Line
   

  

 The Managing Director will report to Executive Leadership.
   

  

 Direct reports will include practice leaders or vertical managers across current and future practice areas.
   

  

 This role will work closely with sales leadership, delivery leadership, finance/admin, acquisition and integration stakeholders, and internal operating\-system owners.
   

  

 Core Mandate
   

  

 The Managing Director’s mandate is to help OPS become a scalable professional services platform rather than a founder\-dependent services business.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Building a repeatable multi\-practice operating model that can scale organically and absorb acquired practices cleanly.
* Creating a clear executive management layer between company strategy and day\-to\-day practice execution.
* Driving portfolio\-level performance across revenue, margin, delivery quality, client outcomes, and leadership accountability.
* Ensuring each practice has clear ownership, scorecards, operating cadence, growth plans, staffing visibility, and escalation discipline.
* Helping founders and senior commercial leaders spend more time on strategic relationships, capital allocation, major clients, vendor/channel partnerships, and acquisition opportunities.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Multi\-Practice P\&L Leadership
   

  

 Own portfolio\-level performance across current and future practices. Ensure each practice has revenue targets, margin targets, accountable owners, capacity plans, and weekly performance visibility.
   

  

 Growth Strategy
   

  

 Translate the company’s growth strategy and acquisition roadmap into practical operating plans, practice scorecards, integration requirements, hiring plans, and execution milestones.
   

  

 Practice Scaling
   

  

 Help each practice mature from founder\-led execution into a scalable professional services practice with repeatable offers, delivery standards, commercial playbooks, and client success routines.
   

  

 Acquisition Integration
   

  

 Prepare OPS to integrate new practices, founders, teams, clients, systems, financial controls, and reporting standards as the company grows through acquisition.
   

  

 Operating Cadence
   

  

 Run the weekly and monthly management rhythm across practice reviews, pipeline/revenue reviews, delivery reviews, client escalation reviews, finance/admin exception reviews, and executive scorecards.
   

  

 Delivery Governance
   

  

 Ensure work is scoped, staffed, managed, tracked, and escalated consistently across practices. Reduce dependency on ad hoc escalation, informal memory, or founder intervention.
   

  

 Client and Vendor Relationships
   

  

 Provide senior coverage for important clients, vendors, and ecosystem partners, including ERP, CRM, workflow automation, collaboration, finance/admin, and enterprise software partners.
   

  

 Systems Discipline
   

  

 Ensure the business uses the right systems of record for projects, delivery, timesheets, reporting, accounting workflows, support/helpdesk, purchasing, and execution management.
   

  

 Leadership Development
   

  

 Recruit, manage, and coach practice leaders. Set clear expectations for ownership, communication, commercial quality, delivery discipline, and executive readiness.
   

  

 Founder Leverage
   

  

 Reduce founder operational load by creating clean decision memos, dashboards, escalation rules, meeting cadences, and owner/date/action follow\-through.
   

  

 First 90 Days
   

  

 In the first 90 days, the Managing Director will be expected to:
   

  

* Map the current OPS operating reality, including revenue by practice, margin, pipeline, delivery capacity, leadership ownership, client risk, systems maturity, finance/admin exceptions, and acquisition\-readiness gaps.
* Define the practice operating model, including P\&L ownership, reporting lines, scorecards, weekly cadence, escalation thresholds, and decision rights.
* Create an executive dashboard covering revenue, gross margin, utilization/capacity, pipeline, project health, client escalations, acquisition/integration priorities, cash/admin risks, hiring needs, and system reliability.
* Identify the top operating constraints preventing OPS from scaling into a multi\-practice platform and assign owner/date/action plans.
* Clarify which workflows belong in core operating systems, which belong in CRM, and which should remain in communication or knowledge\-management tools.


 12\-Month Outcomes
   

  

**After 12 Months, Success Should Look Like**
* OPS has a working multi\-practice management model with named leaders, P\&L accountability, growth targets, and weekly operating cadence.
* Each practice has a clear commercial offer architecture, delivery model, staffing plan, margin view, and long\-term growth path.
* The company can integrate new practices or acquired businesses without reinventing systems, reporting, accountability, or delivery governance each time.
* Client outcomes and delivery quality are managed through consistent project controls, staffing visibility, status cadence, and escalation discipline.
* Executive leadership has better visibility, fewer operational escalations, and more leverage because the Managing Director owns the management system and leadership layer.


 Ideal Profile
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone With**
* Deep experience scaling professional services firms, ideally across consulting, systems integration, ERP/CRM implementation, legal/corporate services, advisory, or multi\-practice services organizations.
* Experience owning a meaningful P\&L, business unit, region, or operating platform with accountability for revenue, margin, delivery, client outcomes, and leadership performance.
* A track record of helping entrepreneurial or founder\-led organizations mature into disciplined operating companies without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Strong acquisition\-integration instincts, including the ability to assess operating gaps, integrate teams, professionalize reporting, and protect the value of founder, client, and vendor relationships.
* Commercial credibility with senior clients, vendors, investors, and practice leaders.
* Comfort with ERP, CRM, project systems, dashboards, operating metrics, financial controls, and executive communication.
* High ownership, low ego, direct communication style, and the ability to bring calm discipline into fast\-moving ambiguity.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* OPS becomes a scalable professional services platform rather than a single founder\-dependent services business.
* Each practice has clear leadership, P\&L accountability, margin discipline, growth plan, and client\-delivery standards.
* Executives spend more time on strategic relationships, acquisitions, capital allocation, vendor/channel development, and major client opportunities.
* Practice leaders operate with clearer accountability, better data, stronger cadence, and fewer unresolved escalations.
* The company is better prepared to scale organically and through acquisition.


**About Outpace Professional Services**
 OPS delivers enterprise\-grade ERP, automation, and sovereign technology solutions for ambitious businesses that need to move fast without sacrificing quality. From startups to large\-scale global operations, we provide the expertise clients need, when they need it, without the overhead of traditional consulting firms.
   

  

 Our team specialises in Odoo ERP, hyper\-automation, systems integration, and operational transformation, helping organisations build scalable, efficient, and fully controlled technology ecosystems.
   

  

 At OPS, we value agility, transparency, and excellence without ego. We move quickly, solve real problems and focus on delivering measurable impact for every client we work with.

data.jd_text:
**Your mission**
 We are seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking Project Director to lead the delivery of some of the most ambitious and innovative Spatial Experience projects in the region and beyond. This is not a traditional project management role \- it is a senior leadership position for someone who can drive complex turnkey projects with confidence, precision, and commercial clarity.
   

  

 You will take ownership of a portfolio of high\-profile international projects across museums, visitor attractions, cultural destinations, and large\-scale experiential installations. From tender strategy and planning through execution and close\-out, you will shape delivery standards, elevate performance, and ensure exceptional outcomes for both clients and stakeholders.
   

  

 Operational excellence is essential, but what sets this role apart is leadership. We are looking for a strategic decision\-maker and delivery\-driven leader who can build strong teams, manage complexity at scale, and consistently raise the bar in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment.
   

  

 Key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead a portfolio of complex international projects from tender stage through planning, execution, delivery, and close\-out, ensuring full project organization and control.
* Oversee the development of the master project schedule and ensure effective implementation across all phases.
* Monitor project performance with a strong focus on quality, deadlines, and cost control.
* Conduct project reviews and produce detailed reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, from pre\-construction through completion.
* Ensure strict adherence to ethics, compliance, and internal governance requirements at all times.
* Actively participate in the tender process, including design coordination, submission preparation, and tender review.
* Provide leadership in risk assessment, contract negotiations, fee structures, and pricing decisions.
* Tender, negotiate, and award supplier and subcontractor contracts.
* Collaborate with Crew Management on resource planning for assigned projects using EasyJob software.
* Coordinate with QHSE teams on\-site to ensure delivery in line with HSE and QAQC standards and compliance requirements.
* Build and maintain strong long\-term client relationships and actively expand the client network.
* Identify and secure growth opportunities, initiating and supporting new project development.
* Support Project Managers and project teams, proactively resolving escalated issues and ensuring smooth project delivery.


**Your profile**
* Proven experience in project management and delivery of turnkey projects (scenic, fit\-out, AVL) such as museums, visitor experience centers, EXPO pavilions, and other permanent or semi\-permanent installations within the entertainment and cultural sector.
* Degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Audiovisual Engineering, or a related field is highly desirable.
* Solid technical understanding of Audio, Video, Lighting systems, and control technologies, with experience in large\-scale installations (preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to develop, manage, and control large\-scale project budgets.
* Strong industry network within the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.
* Flexible and adaptable, with willingness to work according to project and industry requirements.
* Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and contractual interfaces across complex project environments.


**Why us?**
* Unified CAT A Silver Premium Medical Insurance provided as standard to all team members – yes, you read that correctly, we all enjoy the same insurance category benefits!
* Complimentary lunches provided daily in our Dubai office canteen.
* Team Engagement Initiatives – team\-building activities, health and wellness drives, etc.
* Team Socials – team BBQs, season opening and closing parties.
* Worker’s Compensation and Accident Insurance.
* Annual Flight Allowance.
* Recruitment Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful applicants for our open positions.
* Project Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful project leads.
* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.


**About Us**
 BeWunder is your turnkey partner specializing in Event Production and Spatial Experiences.
   

  

 We create inspiring and unforgettable experiences for our clients and their guests. Our renowned and highly\-skilled team of industry experts in both live events and permanent construction is well\-versed in bridging the gap between vision and reality. We design, deliver and service complex, challenging, and large\-scale projects in the field of museums and exhibitions, EXPO and brand pavilions, visitor and experience centers, digital art spaces, live events \- both corporate and sporting, as well as conferences and multimedia shows.
   

  

 Our passion lies in producing multisensory and immersive experiences, a perfect blend of new technologies and content, staged lighting and interactive elements.
   

  

 With our international track record in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we are perfectly positioned to realize exceptional projects for our clients around the globe, from initial concept design through to final installation and beyond!

**Job Title:** 
 SVP Head of Digital Channels \| Business Banking
 



**Job Purpose:** 




 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-driven digital leader to oversee the full digital ecosystem for Business Banking. This role owns the digital experience for SME and commercial clients — from digital onboarding and day\-to\-day servicing to platform partnerships, embedded finance, and next\-generation digital channels.
 



 The incumbent will lead multi\-disciplinary squads, shape the digital roadmap, and drive the evolution of our business banking platforms (web, mobile, API, and partner integrations). You will play a pivotal role in transforming how businesses interact with the bank, enhancing operational resilience, and accelerating digital acquisition and revenue growth.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Digital Strategy \& Channel Ownership** 



* Define and lead the end\-to\-end digital strategy for Business Banking across mobile, web, API, and ecosystem channels.
* Develop a multi\-year roadmap that enhances customer experience, drives digital adoption, and positions the bank competitively against fintech and neo\-bank offerings.
* Ensure alignment between digital journeys, product strategy, and business priorities



**2\. Customer Acquisition, Journeys \& Experience** 



* Own the full customer lifecycle across digital onboarding, activation, servicing, and cross\-sell touchpoints.
* Continuously optimise journeys to improve conversion, reduce friction, and enable straight\-through processing.
* Partner with Marketing on digital campaigns that drive acquisition, engagement, and product penetration.



**3\. Data, Insights \& Performance Management** 



* Build comprehensive dashboards and analytics frameworks to track usage, engagement, adoption, drop\-off, and channel performance.
* Use behavioural and transactional insights to guide prioritisation, product enhancements, and commercial decisions.
* Deliver regular reporting to senior leadership on performance, business impact, and future opportunities.



**4\. Operational Resilience \& Channel Reliability** 



* Serve as the business owner and escalation point for digital channel issues, ensuring swift triage, stakeholder communication, and resolution.
* Strengthen incident management processes and ensure alignment with IT, Architecture, Governance, and Cyber Security.
* Maintain high standards of availability, security, and regulatory compliance.



**5\. Product Delivery, Technology Collaboration \& Agile Leadership** 



* Lead cross\-functional product squads responsible for delivering new capabilities across onboarding, servicing, payments, lending, and ecosystem integrations.
* Prioritise the backlog based on customer value, commercial impact, and strategic objectives.
* Work closely with Technology, Architecture, QA, Infrastructure, and third\-party partners to deliver scalable and stable solutions.



**6\. Ecosystem, Embedded Finance \& API Expansion** 



* Build and scale new\-age business models through BaaS, Open Banking, embedded finance, and partner platforms.
* Drive API\-based integrations with accounting systems, HRMS solutions, fintech partners, and marketplaces.
* Identify opportunities to extend digital reach beyond traditional channels.



**7\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Champion digital\-first thinking, emerging technologies, automation, AI\-driven experiences, and cloud adoption.
* Introduce best practices from global SME digital banking, challenger banks, and fintech ecosystems.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, customer\-centricity, and rapid delivery.



  





**Qualifications**

data.jd_text:
**Why qlub**
 The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.
   

  

 From Pay\-at\-Table and Digital Menus to Order\-and\-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.
   

  

 We're a fast\-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e\& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.
   

  

**The role**
 qlub is scaling fast across markets worldwide, and we look for people who take real ownership of their work. As our next Operations Executive, you'll help drive our growth in Partner Success building, shipping, and delivering results from day one.
   

  

 You'll work closely with operators and partners to turn frictionless payments into real growth for restaurants. You'll also play a key role in ensuring new restaurant partners have a smooth onboarding journey and that existing partners maximize their adoption of Qlub solutions. From training restaurant staff to troubleshooting issues and driving re\-engagement, you'll be at the frontlines of ensuring our partners and their customers have the best possible experience.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast\-moving, build\-from\-scratch environment, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Onboarding \& Setup**
* Support the full onboarding journey of new restaurant partners, including account setup and system configurations when required
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Tech, Content, Procurement, and Account Management, to ensure a seamless go\-live experience
* Ensure all onboarding activities are completed accurately and on time to facilitate successful launches


**Training \& Enablement**
* Conduct in\-person and remote training sessions for restaurant staff to ensure smooth adoption of Qlub's solutions
* Organize and deliver retraining sessions when needed to address knowledge gaps and reinforce best practices
* Act as a trusted advisor for restaurant teams, helping them maximize the value of Qlub's products and features


**Performance Monitoring \& Adoption**
* Monitor partner performance metrics, including QR adoption rates and transaction trends, to proactively identify opportunities and potential issues
* Troubleshoot operational and technical challenges in collaboration with Account Management, Customer Support, and Tech teams
* Implement corrective actions and provide ongoing enablement to drive long\-term adoption and engagement
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and operational checks to ensure teams remain confident and effective in using Qlub solutions


**Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Feedback**
* Partner closely with Account Managers to share insights on partner performance and ensure timely communication with key stakeholders
* Gather feedback from restaurant partners and frontline staff to continuously improve processes, training materials, and the overall partner experience
* Collaborate with Product, Operations, and Tech teams to identify recurring challenges and contribute to scalable solutions and product enhancements


**What You’ll Own**
* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new restaurant partners, ensuring a seamless setup experience and building strong partner relationships from day one
* Drive adoption and engagement for newly onboarded partners, achieving and maintaining a target Qlub adoption rate of 45% across assigned accounts
* Monitor and manage the performance of existing partner outlets, proactively identifying opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and overall partner success


**Who You Are**
* You've done this before in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment
* You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information
* You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator
* You're energized by solving problems and creating exceptional experiences for restaurant partners and their customers
* You're highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail
* You enjoy working directly with customers, building relationships, and helping partners succeed


**What You'll Need**
* A valid driving license and access to a car are required
* 0–2 years of experience in customer onboarding, account management, training, customer success, or a similar client\-facing role
* Proven ability to deliver training sessions and engage diverse audiences effectively
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot issues and coordinate solutions quickly across multiple stakeholders
* Proficiency with digital tools such as CRM systems, Google Workspace, Excel, and Google Sheets
* Fluency in English is a must
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment where priorities can shift quickly


**Nice to have**
* Experience in hospitality, F\&B, SaaS, or technology environments is a strong plus
* Fluency in Arabic is a plus


**What We Offer**
* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast\-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest\-growing restaurant technology companies globally


**Ready to build?** 
 Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

 UAE or Remote

 Full\-Time

 Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
 


**About Forka** 

 Forka is a dynamic Food \& Beverage holding company dedicated to building, operating, and scaling exceptional hospitality brands. We drive growth across three core pillars: operating our own high\-performing restaurant venues, strategically investing in emerging F\&B concepts, and providing elite operational consulting to external clients.
 


**Role Overview** 

 The EBP is a dual\-mandate role acting as the ultimate right hand to the CEO. You are the gatekeeper to the CEO’s time and the architect of their public and corporate voice.
 



 This is not a standard administrative role. Half of your day will be spent on rigorous executive operations—managing a high\-stakes calendar, filtering complex communications, and holding the executive leadership team accountable to project deadlines. The other half will be spent on corporate communications—ghostwriting executive thought leadership for LinkedIn, managing Forka's employer branding, and drafting high\-level correspondence to investors, landlords, and external consulting clients.
 


**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. Executive Operations \& Administration (Protecting the CEO)** 



* **Ruthless Gatekeeping:** 
 Manage the CEO’s complex calendar, prioritizing high\-value meetings, scheduling internal cross\-functional reviews, and protecting the CEO from low\-level operational distractions.
* **Inbox \& Correspondence Management:** 
 Triage the CEO’s email inbox and LinkedIn messages. Draft highly professional responses on the CEO’s behalf to investors, partners, and internal staff.
* **Meeting Management \& Execution:** 
 Attend confidential executive board meetings, take meticulous meeting minutes, and relentlessly follow up with the Directors to ensure action items and deadlines are met.
* **Information Synthesis:** 
 Consolidate weekly department reports (Operations, Culinary, Brand, HR) into one clear, digestible executive summary for the CEO.



**2\. Executive Communications \& PR (Amplifying the CEO \& Company)** 



* **Executive Ghostwriting:** 
 Interview the CEO weekly to extract their strategic insights, and translate them into polished, high\-performing LinkedIn posts that position the CEO as a thought leader in F\&B operations and turnarounds.
* **B2B \& Investor Communications:** 
 Draft sophisticated pitch emails, corporate memos, and press releases regarding Forka’s new acquisitions, consulting services, and expansion plans.
* **Employer Branding \& Talent Attraction:** 
 Manage Forka’s corporate social media presence (LinkedIn/B2B platforms). Create behind\-the\-scenes content that showcases Forka’s rigorous kitchen culture and elite executive team, turning the company into a magnet for top\-tier hospitality talent.
* **Network Management:** 
 Track and nurture the CEO’s relationships with high\-net\-worth investors, elite chefs, and real estate developers, ensuring strategic follow\-ups are executed flawlessly.


**Qualifications \& Requirements** 
* **Experience:** 
 4–7\+ years of experience. The ideal candidate will have a background as a Strategic Executive Assistant, PR Account Manager, or a hybrid operational/communications role within a fast\-paced agency, startup, or corporate hospitality group.
* **Exceptional Writing Ability:** 
 You must be an elite copywriter capable of adapting to the CEO’s specific tone of voice.
 *(You will be asked to complete a writing test during the interview process).*
* **Administrative Rigor:** 
 Type\-A organizational skills. You are obsessed with structure, deadlines, and closing the loop on communications.
* **High Commercial Awareness:** 
 You understand B2B business dynamics. You know the difference between communicating with a line cook and pitching a private equity investor.
* **Tech Proficiency:** 
 Advanced skills in executive calendar management, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, CRM systems, and LinkedIn content strategy.
* **Discretion \& Trust:** 
 Absolute integrity in handling highly confidential financial data, HR issues, and proprietary business strategies.


**What We Offer** 
* Unprecedented access and mentorship directly from the CEO.
* A central, highly influential role in building a major regional F\&B holding group from the ground up.
* Competitive executive compensation with room to grow as the holding group scales.



**How to Apply:** 




 Please send your CV and a brief cover letter (written in the tone you would use if drafting an email on behalf of a CEO) to:
 **info@forka.com**

data.jd_text:
**About noon** 




 noon is the region's leading consumer commerce platform. Since its launch on December 12th, 2017, in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and its expansion into Egypt in February 2019, noon has grown into a diverse ecosystem spanning marketplaces for food delivery, quick commerce, fintech, and fashion. noon is a work in progress \- six years in, but only 5% done.
 



  





**noon’s mission:** 
 Ring every doorbell, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview \- Senior Security Program Manager** 




  





 Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.
 



  





 The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive\-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards
* Drive quarterly planning for the security roadmap including sequencing, resourcing assumptions, and critical path
* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams



  





**Who we need?** 




  




* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure\-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.



  





**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.



  





 Is this you?

You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.
   

  

 You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, provide leadership across multiple workstreams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Contract \& Scope
   

  

* Lead project set\-up, including contract finalisation, internal alignment and mobilisation of the team
* Fully understand and manage the contract, ensuring compliance with key obligations and deliverables
* Define, agree and manage scope across all disciplines, ensuring clarity of responsibilities
* Lead the appointment and coordination of sub\-consultants, including scope, fees and agreements
* Identify and manage changes to scope, leading variation preparation, negotiation and agreement with the client
* Ensure all deliverables meet WSP quality standards and client expectations


 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders
* Provide clear leadership, establishing a high\-performing “one team” culture
* Lead client engagement, workshops and presentations, including executive\-level reporting
* Manage complex stakeholder environments, including retail tenants, landlords, operators and authorities
* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)
* Ensure alignment between brand standards, operational requirements and technical design solutions
* Oversee design reviews, ensuring buildability, compliance and coordination across disciplines
* Drive high\-quality outputs through structured QA/QC processes
* Ensure coordination between landlord criteria and tenant requirements


 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management
* Identify key risks associated with retail phasing, tenant changes, authority approvals and programme constraints
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies
* Escalate critical risks to senior leadership and clients as required


 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance
* Lead preparation, negotiation and agreement of variations
* Provide commercial advice to clients, particularly relating to programme impacts and tenant\-driven changes


 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives
* Coordinate phased handovers, including base build and tenant fit\-out interfaces
* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 10\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
الهدف العام للوظيفة
 



 قيادة وتطوير استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة، وتحمّل المسؤولية المؤسسية عن تحقيق القيمة المضافة من خلال توظيف أصول بيانات الوزارة ومنظومة الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، وتحقيق الربط الفعّال بين التوجهات الاستراتيجية للوزارة وتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لقيادة مسيرة تبنّيه في مختلف قطاعاتها، وضمان توافق جميع المبادرات مع المعايير الأخلاقية ومتطلبات الحوكمة بما يعزز كفاءة اتخاذ القرار ويحقق أهداف التحول الذكي.
 



  





 المسؤوليات الرئيسية
 


* إعداد وقيادة استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي للوزارة بما يتوافق مع أهدافها المؤسسية والوطنية، وتطوير نموذج التشغيل اللازم لتنفيذها وقياس أثرها في تحسين الكفاءة واتخاذ القرار.
* قيادة مبادرات التحول الذكي في الوزارة بما فيها تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، واستثمار أصول البيانات المؤسسية لتحقيق قيمة مضافة قابلة للقياس.
* ضمان قابلية توسع نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وتكاملها مع سير العمل والأنظمة المؤسسية القائمة، مع ضمان جاهزية البيانات لمتطلبات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
* إنشاء وإدارة أطر حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة بما يشمل السياسات والمعايير ونماذج التشغيل، لضمان الاستخدام الأخلاقي والمسؤول وفق المعايير المحلية والدولية.
* تصميم وتطبيق إطار إدارة مخاطر الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تصنيف المخاطر وآليات التخفيف والمراقبة المستمرة لحماية الوزارة من الآثار السلبية المحتملة.
* الإشراف على تقييم واعتماد حالات استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان امتثالها لمتطلبات الخصوصية وحماية البيانات والاشتراطات التنظيمية المعتمدة.
* التنسيق مع قيادات الوحدات والإدارات لتعزيز القدرات الذكية عبر الوزارة، وبناء ثقافة مؤسسية تثق في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتوظّفه بصورة فعّالة.
* التعاون مع الفرق التقنية لضمان أن البنية التحتية وعمليات تقنية المعلومات وهندسة البرمجيات وإدارة البيانات تدعم تشغيل حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي واستدامتها.
* متابعة أداء وأثر مبادرات الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان تحقيق القيمة وفق مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية المعتمدة، وإعداد التقارير الدورية لقيادة الوزارة.
* تصميم وتنفيذ برامج التثقيف في الذكاء الاصطناعي وبناء القدرات التقنية لدى منسوبي الوزارة بما يضمن قدرتهم على التعامل مع أدواته وتطبيقاته بفاعلية.
* التواصل مع الجهات التنظيمية والشركاء الخارجيين والهيئات المعنية في شأن حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي واستراتيجيته.
* الإسهام في إعداد الخطط التشغيلية السنوية للقسم ومتابعة تنفيذها وضمان توافقها مع أولويات الوزارة الاستراتيجية.
* تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى يكلف بها مدير الإدارة في نطاق اختصاصه.



  





 المؤهلات والخبرة
 


* دكتوراه \- إحصاء / رياضيات تطبيقية / اقتصاد / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (بدون خبرة)
* ماجستير \- الذكاء الاصطناعي / علوم البيانات / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (3 سنوات)
* بكالوريوس \- علوم الحاسب / هندسة الحاسوب / هندسة البرمجيات / نظم المعلومات أو ما يعادلها (7 سنوات)



  





 الشهادات المهنية
 


* شهادة مهنية معتمدة في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة مثل Google Professional ML Engineer / AWS ML Specialty / Azure AI Engineer Associate
* شهادة في الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي ونماذج اللغة الكبيرة مثل LLMs DeepLearning.AI Generative AI Specialization
* شهادة في حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي وأخلاقياته مثل IAPP AI Governance Professional / ISO 42001 Lead Implementer
* شهادة في علم البيانات وتحليل البيانات المتقدمة مثل IBM Data Science Professional / Databricks ML Associate
* شهادة في تشغيل نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وعملياته مثل MLflow MLOps Certified / Kubeflow Practitioner
* شهادة في إدارة المشاريع والتحول الرقمي أو ما يعادله ا PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe
* شهادة في إدارة البيانات وهندستها أو ما يعادلها (CDMP)
* دورة في استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي وتطبيقاته في القطاع الحكومي
* دورة في أخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي والاستخدام المسؤول ومعالجة التحيز والشفافية
* دورة في قيادة التغيير وإدارة التحول المؤسسي باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي
* دورة في هندسة الطلبات وتطبيقات النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة (Prompt Engineering)



  





  





  





  





  





**Job Purpose** 




 Lead and develop the Ministry's Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy and assume enterprise\-wide responsibility for delivering measurable value through the effective utilization of the Ministry's data assets and AI ecosystem, including Generative AI applications. The role ensures the alignment of AI technologies with the Ministry's strategic objectives, drives AI adoption across all sectors, and ensures that all AI initiatives comply with ethical standards and governance requirements, thereby enhancing decision\-making efficiency and achieving the Ministry's smart transformation goals.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and lead the Ministry's AI strategy in alignment with its organizational and national objectives, including designing the operating model required for implementation and measuring its impact on operational efficiency and decision\-making.
* Lead smart transformation initiatives across the Ministry, including Generative AI applications, while leveraging enterprise data assets to create measurable business value.
* Ensure AI models are scalable and seamlessly integrated with existing enterprise systems and business processes, while ensuring data readiness for AI implementation.
* Establish and manage the Ministry's AI governance framework, including policies, standards, and operating models, to ensure ethical and responsible AI usage in accordance with local and international standards.
* Design and implement an AI risk management framework, including risk classification, mitigation mechanisms, and continuous monitoring to protect the Ministry from potential adverse impacts.
* Oversee the evaluation and approval of AI use cases, ensuring compliance with privacy, data protection, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with business unit and departmental leaders to strengthen AI capabilities across the Ministry and foster an organizational culture that trusts and effectively utilizes AI.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure that IT infrastructure, software engineering practices, and data management capabilities support the deployment, operation, and sustainability of AI solutions.
* Monitor the performance and impact of AI initiatives, ensuring value realization against approved Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and prepare periodic reports for the Ministry's leadership.
* Design and implement AI awareness and capability\-building programs to enhance employees' technical skills and effective use of AI tools and applications.
* Liaise with regulatory authorities, external partners, and relevant organizations on AI governance, strategy, and compliance matters.
* Contribute to the preparation of the department's annual operational plans, monitor their implementation, and ensure alignment with the Ministry's strategic priorities.
* Perform any other duties assigned by the Department Director within the scope of the role.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **PhD** 
 in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (no experience required).
* **Master's Degree** 
 in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (minimum 3 years of experience).
* **Bachelor's Degree** 
 in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (minimum 7 years of experience).



**Professional Certifications** 



* Professional certification in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, such as
 **Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer** 
 ,
 **AWS Machine Learning Specialty** 
 , or
 **Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate** 
 .
* Certification in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), such as the
 **DeepLearning.AI Generative AI Specialization** 
 .
* Certification in AI Governance and Ethics, such as
 **IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP)** 
 or
 **ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer** 
 .
* Certification in Data Science and Advanced Data Analytics, such as
 **IBM Data Science Professional Certificate** 
 or
 **Databricks Machine Learning Associate** 
 .
* Certification in AI Operations (MLOps), such as
 **MLflow MLOps Certified** 
 or
 **Kubeflow Practitioner** 
 .
* Certification in Project Management and Digital Transformation, such as
 **PMP** 
 ,
 **PRINCE2** 
 , or
 **SAFe** 
 .
* Certification in Data Management and Data Engineering, such as
 **Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP)** 
 .
* Training course in AI Strategy and its applications in the government sector.
* Training course in AI Ethics, Responsible AI, Bias Mitigation, and Transparency.
* Training course in Change Leadership and Enterprise Transformation using AI technologies.
* Training course in Prompt Engineering and Large Language Model (LLM) applications.

**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking an experienced and visionary leader to oversee the Ministry's Volunteer Management Department and drive the development of a sustainable and impactful national volunteer ecosystem. The role is responsible for shaping volunteerism strategies, fostering cross\-sector partnerships, enhancing community engagement, and leading initiatives that promote volunteer participation in alignment with national priorities. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening social responsibility, developing innovative volunteer programs, and driving measurable social impact across the UAE.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the development and implementation of the Ministry's volunteer management strategy, ensuring alignment with national priorities and organizational objectives.
* Develop policies, frameworks, and governance models to regulate and enhance volunteer programs across the UAE.
* Build and strengthen strategic partnerships with government entities, private sector organizations, non\-profit organizations, and community partners to expand volunteer opportunities.
* Oversee the planning, coordination, and delivery of national volunteer initiatives, campaigns, and community engagement programs.
* Develop and monitor performance indicators, impact assessments, and reports to measure the effectiveness of volunteer programs and social responsibility initiatives.
* Design innovative programs to attract, engage, develop, and retain volunteers while promoting a culture of volunteerism across society.
* Lead initiatives to match volunteers with suitable opportunities based on skills, competencies, and community needs.
* Oversee volunteer training, capability\-building, and awareness programs to enhance volunteer effectiveness and community impact.
* Drive continuous improvement by implementing best practices in volunteer management, stakeholder engagement, and service delivery.
* Manage departmental operations, including strategic planning, budgeting, performance management, governance, and resource allocation.
* Lead, develop, and mentor a high\-performing team while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Social Sciences, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree is preferred.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum
 **10 years of progressive experience** 
 in volunteer management, community development, corporate social responsibility (CSR), public sector management, or social impact programs.
* Minimum
 **5 years in a leadership role** 
 managing teams, strategic initiatives, and stakeholder partnerships.
* Proven experience in developing policies, strategies, and large\-scale community or volunteer initiatives.
* Strong experience building partnerships across government, private, and non\-profit sectors.
* Demonstrated experience in performance management, governance, and strategic planning.
* Experience working within the UAE Government or public sector is highly desirable.

data.jd_text:
**Summary** 




 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Technology Programme. This role will build Pearl Initiative’s thought leadership and impact in strengthening and enabling the technology and artificial intelligence sector in the GCC Region. Programming will especially focus on advancing corporate governance; ethical, strategic, and accountable decision\-making; transparency and disclosure; and governance\-enabled innovation amongst technology actors and investors. They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 



* Lead the design, development, planning, and budgeting of the programme strategically aligned with organisation goals and impact objectives ensuring cost\-effectiveness and efficient resource allocation.
* Drive programmatic innovation within existing offering, identifying opportunities to enhance programme effectiveness, efficiency, and impact.
* Identify and enable cross\-programmatic synergies, intersections, and collaborations.
* Identify and integrate subject matter experts, executive trainers and coaches, researchers, and any other third parties to co\-create programmatic projects and deliverables.
* Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.



  





**Business development, community enablement, and financial sustainability** 



* Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders' engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.
* Manage an annual market engagement calendar.
* Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.
* Explore and develop new revenue streams for the programme to diversify funding and enhance financial sustainability.
* Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
* Represent the organization by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
* Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.
* Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 



* Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
* Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
* Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
* Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.
* Run projects and initiatives with careful cost control and resource allocation to support efforts to achieve financial sustainability with long\-term working capital.
* Proactively communicate project and initiative updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with timely reports on progress, challenges, and successes.



  





**Expertise development and thought leadership** 



* Identify, study, and learn from market needs and pain points through research and stakeholder engagement to identify strategic opportunities for impact and growth.
* Lead the development of market\-driven solutions by translating identified market needs and pain points into actionable programme initiatives.
* Curate and convene the programme’s working group, bringing in together working group members and special guests.
* Monitor the market’s offering, notable trends, and any disruptions to consistently strategically position the programme.
* Produce a consistent pipeline of high\-quality, original bi\-lingual content (e.g., op\-eds, articles, blog posts, white papers, research reports, and working group position papers) that showcases expertise and generates meaningful conversations within the industry.
* Build a strong online presence by actively engaging in priority social media channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, industry\-specific forums) to share content, participate in discussions, and network with other thought leaders.
* Cultivate relationships with journalists, analysts, and other industry influencers to amplify thought leadership and reach a wider audience.



  





**Team mentorship and development** 



* Mentor and coach Programme Associate, providing timely and actionable feedback, creating teachable opportunities, and offering programme career guidance.
* Define and monitor the development plan of Programme Associate, with regular pulse checks, ensuring time and any needed resources are allocated for training.
* Enable career growth, including promotions, for Programme Associate.



  





**Impact measurement and reporting** 



* Co\-define quarterly and yearly key impact metrics and engagement KPIs for the programme, ensuring milestones are achievable and validated with feasibility assessments.
* Develop surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance based on impact strategy, methodology, and templates.
* Coordinate data collection of surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance.
* Analyze data of surveys and feedback forms to study and learn from achieved and non\-achieved programmatic impact and performance, based on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs identified in impact strategy.
* Develop an impact baseline assessment for the programme to measure progress towards meeting key market needs and addressing critical market gaps.
* Recommend and implement programmatic improvements, expansions, and other strategic directions from data and insights.
* Prepare impact reports and communicate findings on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs at key programme and project milestones.
* Curate, co\-author, and publish programme specific sections for the annual report.



  





**Tech\-enabled skills development** 



* Proficiently use tools and technology solutions to strengthen team productivity, project management, business development, and research through continuous learning and training.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme development, project management, impact management, storytelling and writing.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme and related special topics.



  





**Qualifications and experience** 



* A master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, and / or the social sciences, or a related discipline, with proven expertise and strong analytical skills.
* Additional certifications in project management, corporate governance, data governance, impact measurement, or technology management are highly desirable.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience in managing, coordinating, and executing programs, academic institutions, think tanks, research centers, member\-based networks/councils, or non\-profit organizations.
* Work experience in the private sector, including tech companies, startups, or entrepreneurial ventures is highly desirable.
* Work experience in governance in the tech sector is highly desirable, with a deep understanding of governance and impact frameworks, regulatory compliance, and sustainability practices in the industry.
* Demonstrated experience leading in business development, revenue generation, and / or fundraising for programmes, projects, and / or initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver programmes independently while managing and building relationships with multiple senior market stakeholders, partners, and vendors.
* Demonstrated acumen in AI governance, ethical AI, and emerging regulations in AI/technology, including familiarity with frameworks like ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System), GDPR, and responsible AI practices.
* Expertise in research, impact analysis, impact\-driven programme development, and curriculum design is highly desirable.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and a portfolio of published writings is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required.
* Fluency in Arabic is highly desirable.

data.jd_text:
**Posted on the Senna Private Equity Careers Network.**
**Overview**
 This Senior Project Manager role is based in Dubai, UAE, and sits within the project management function of a real estate company. The position carries direct accountability for the end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-disciplined real estate projects on behalf of clients, spanning planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout. The successful candidate will lead experienced project teams, manage complex stakeholder relationships, and ensure that budget, schedule, quality, and risk objectives are met across each engagement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage all facets of project management — budget, schedule, procurement, quality, and risk — across individual real estate projects from inception through closeout.
* Interface directly with clients to define project requirements; prepare scope of work, resource plans, cost estimates, budgets, cash flow projections, work plan schedules, milestones, quality controls, and risk registers.
* Read, interpret, and apply standards to complex project documents including contracts, agreements, leases, work letters, project charters, surveys, and architectural drawings.
* Identify and qualify project delivery resources; conduct requests for proposals, lead bid analysis, facilitate evaluation interviews, and recommend appointments to clients.
* Lead and provide direction to multi\-disciplined project delivery teams, guiding them toward defined project goals.
* Implement and maintain a structured communication plan, including regular meetings, written reports, and meeting minutes, to keep clients and project teams consistently informed.
* Ensure project documentation governance aligns with company and client requirements; maintain data integrity, accuracy, and timely coordination of all project records.
* Track project progress against approved goals, budgets, and timelines; report on status and variances; develop and execute action plans to address deviations.
* Manage change control processes — assess change requests, evaluate impacts on scope, budget, schedule, quality, and risk, secure client approvals, and issue change orders accordingly.
* Identify complex project risks, lead constructability reviews, and develop and implement risk mitigation and contingency plans.
* Apply understanding of business context — including business cases, economic implications, and risk — to project management decisions.
* Analyse inputs from the wider team and make recommendations with direct impact on project and business outcomes.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree (BA, BS, BEng, or BArch) in a technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Minimum of five years of directly relevant experience in the UAE.
* Demonstrated prior experience managing multi\-disciplined project teams in a similar senior role.
* PMP certification is required.
* MRICS designation is preferred.
* Full professional fluency in English, both written and verbal; Arabic or additional languages are advantageous.
* Valid UAE driver's licence.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings.
* Working knowledge of MS Project, lease structures, construction contracts, and construction practices.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills; ability to solve complex problems and evaluate multiple options in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to comprehend, analyse, and interpret complex business and contractual documents.
* In\-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles; ability to forecast, prepare, and manage budgets and conduct financial analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce reports and deliver persuasive presentations to senior stakeholders and client groups.
* Proven ability to motivate, influence, and negotiate effectively with key team members, senior management, and clients.


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

* Direct client\-facing accountability on complex, high\-value real estate projects across the UAE market.
* Opportunity to lead experienced, multi\-disciplined teams on projects spanning the full real estate lifecycle.
* A full\-time, permanent position within a structured and established real estate company operating in one of the world's most active real estate markets.


 Application Process
   

  

 This role was posted on 22 June 2026 with Job ID 282466\. Interested candidates should ensure they meet the mandatory PMP certification requirement and the minimum five years of UAE\-based experience before applying. Applications should be submitted through the relevant posting channel associated with this reference.
   

  

**About Senna**
 Senna is a careers platform for professionals pursuing opportunities in private equity. The platform brings together relevant roles, market context, and hiring signals to help candidates navigate the market with greater clarity. For more information, visit joinsenna.com.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Department \| Psychology**
**American University of Sharjah**
 The Department of Psychology in the College of Arts and Sciences at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applications for the position of Head of Department. The department seeks a collaborative and visionary leader with a record of excellence in teaching, research and service, and a strong commitment to student success and faculty development.
   

  

**About The Department**
 The department offers a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and contributes significantly to the university’s general education curriculum. Faculty members are engaged in diverse areas of research, including mental health and well\-being; cognitive psychology and psycholinguistics; organizational psychology; and social, cultural and personality psychology. The department values multidisciplinary collaboration and emphasizes both scientific rigor and applied engagement with the community.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Applicants must meet the following minimum qualifications:
   

  

* PhD in Psychology or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum rank of Associate Professor (Professor preferred).
* A record of effective and inclusive academic leadership, including experience in personnel management and decision\-making.
* Evidence of excellence in teaching, research and service.
* Experience with program accreditation, curriculum development and faculty evaluation.
* Familiarity with North American models of higher education.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 In addition to the above, the college will give preference to candidates who demonstrate:
   

  

* Experience as a department chair, program director or equivalent academic leadership role.
* Success in developing and supporting undergraduate and/or graduate programs.
* Commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration within the college and across the university.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor faculty, support student engagement and foster research productivity.
* A clear vision for the future development of the department, consistent with the strategic goals of the college and university.


**Responsibilities**
 The Head of Department will:
   

  

* Provide strategic leadership and foster a collegial and inclusive departmental culture.
* Foster and promote the professional growth of faculty in teaching and research.
* Oversee curriculum planning, program assessment and accreditation.
* Represent and advocate for the department within the college and university.
* Recruit and retain high\-quality faculty and students.
* Engage in teaching and scholarship at the undergraduate and/or graduate level.
* Participate in university service and governance.


**Date of Commencement**
 The position begins mid\-August 2026\.
   

  

**Application Procedure**
 Applicants should apply online at \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01");" rel\="nofollow"\>https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01\.
   

  

**Applicants Should Submit**
* A cover letter describing their research, teaching and administrative experience, and articulating their vision for how they can contribute to the department’s development and success.
* A current curriculum vitae.
* Names and contact information for three referees (references will be contacted only for shortlisted candidates).


*Additional materials may be requested from candidates advancing to later stages of the search.*
 Applications received by December 15, 2025, will receive full consideration; review will continue until the position is filled.
   

  

**About American University Of Sharjah**
 American University of Sharjah (AUS) is a comprehensive, independent, non\-profit, coeducational institution of higher education that promotes excellence in teaching, learning, research and creative work. AUS fosters a community that celebrates diversity and whose members are committed to the ideals of open intellectual inquiry, ethical behavior and civic responsibility.
   

  

 AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to approximately 6,000 students from over 100 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. Among the top 18 percent of ranked universities in the world (QS World University Rankings, 2026\), AUS is consistently among the top ten universities in the Arab region (QS Arab Region University Rankings, 2026\).
   

  

 AUS is located in the heart of Sharjah’s University City, adjacent to the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and just minutes from Sharjah International Airport and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The campus is situated in a vibrant and cosmopolitan area offering abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.aus.edu.

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior, hands\-on Project Manager to lead the delivery of a SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will take full ownership of a multi\-legal\-entity Finance and Supply Chain transformation — from Fit\-to\-Standard workshops through go\-live and hypercare — working at the intersection of our client's leadership and a hybrid onsite/offshore delivery team.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role within our Middle East practice. You will report directly to the Managing Director and act as the single point of accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction throughout the engagement.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 — End\-to\-end delivery of the S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition program using SAP ACTIVATE methodology, from Prepare through Run.
   

  

 — A delivery team spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Integration, Data Migration, and Training — coordinating onsite and offshore workstreams as one team.
   

  

 — The project plan, RAID log, budget tracking, and resourcing decisions across all phases.
   

  

 — Executive\-level reporting and steering committee facilitation with client leadership across 4 legal entities.
   

  

 — Scope governance and change request management, protecting both project quality and commercial margin.
   

  

 — Cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and hypercare oversight — ensuring the client lands the system successfully.
   

  

 — Coordination of ZATCA Phase 2 compliance milestones with the Finance workstream lead.
   

  

**Requirements**
 — 8\+ years of SAP project management experience, with full lifecycle accountability.
   

  

 — A minimum of 3 completed SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition go\-lives as lead Project Manager.
   

  

 — SAP ACTIVATE methodology certification.
   

  

 — Demonstrated experience managing multi\-legal\-entity SAP deployments within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 — Confident, polished stakeholder management with C\-level and finance leadership in Arabic\-speaking business environments.
   

  

 — A track record of holding scope, budget, and timeline discipline on fixed\-price or milestone\-based engagements.
   

  

**Preferred**
 — PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
   

  

 — Prior experience in trading, distribution, or manufacturing client environments.
   

  

 — Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite and BTP\-based integration landscapes.
   

  

**Benefits**
 — Work on flagship Cloud ERP transformations for some of the region's most respected enterprises, backed by a multi\-vendor partner ecosystem spanning SAP, ServiceNow, OpenText, BMC, Boomi, and Red Hat.
   

  

 — A Berlin\-headquartered firm with genuine regional depth — offices in Riyadh, Dubai, Cairo, and Casablanca, and an offshore delivery model that lets you focus on what matters most: the client.
   

  

 — Direct visibility and access to senior leadership — your impact on client outcomes is seen and valued, not buried in a large delivery hierarchy.
   

  

 — A culture that rewards ownership: you scope it, you lead it, you're credited for it.

**AI Capability \& Learning Enablement**
