data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Head of Project and Development Services (PDS), UAE**
 JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way
   

  

 We're JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 105,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 200 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That's why we're committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We're using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
   

  

**JLL REMS – Real Estate Management Services**
 JLL REMS partners with leading organizations across industry sectors, creating environments that achieve a more human\-centric, resilient, and responsible approach to shaping a better world of work. With more than 89,000 specialists globally, the team enables clients to enhance the performance of their real estate portfolios and people to realize their ambitions for a more sustainable built environment. Through technology enabled solutions, REMS creates safe and inspiring spaces around the world for people to collaborate, innovate, and drive meaningful change anywhere that work is performed. JLL manages over 1\.6 billion square feet of real estate and has averted more than 112,700 metric tons of CO2 emissions by advising clients on renewable energy projects. Primary service offerings include facilities management, sustainability initiatives, project \& development services, transactions management, occupancy planning, and lease administration. Our vast multi\-year relationships span clients across all industries including technology, industrial, financial services, public institutions, life sciences, and healthcare.
   

  

**What This Job Involves**
 Leading the UAE Project and Development Services (PDS) business, owning the business strategy, annual budget and the allocation of capital and OpEx to deliver the growth plan. There is an expectation that the business organically grows greater than 10% each year and establishes a market leading position across the UAE by 2026\. The role will lead the creation and implementation of strategic and operational business plans for UAE PDS, aligned with JLL PDS globally and JLL REMS regional goals, combined with leading the development of global and local PDS products to support the growth and development of the business.
   

  

 Key to success will be attracting, leading and coaching a team of industry leading professionals while developing the next generation of PDS leadership. Operating as an integral member of the regional JLL REMS and Global PDS leadership, the role will be responsible for connecting with colleagues from across JLL to sell the value of PDS to other parts of the business, combined with driving scale and efficiency through the UAE and Global PDS operating platform. Importantly, the role will navigate and resolve local and regional conflicts. Thinking big and getting the difficult things done are pre\-requisites.
   

  

 As the Head of UAE PDS, you will have the opportunity to lead, shape and execute business operations across the UAE market, reporting into the Head of PDS.
   

  

**What Your Day\-to\-day Will Look Like**
**Strategic Leadership \& Business Performance**
 Overall accountability for the UAE PDS business strategy and annual plan, including the allocation of capital and operational expenditure. Chair the UAE PDS leadership forum, owning its purpose and creating an effective forum of leaders to drive the business forward. Develop and deliver a clearly defined business strategy for PDS growth in the UAE, and thereafter execute through the UAE PDS leadership team. Own and execute the UAE PDS capital and M\&A plan.
   

  

**Client Relationships \& Business Development**
 Nurture, develop and maintain new business relationships with external clients across the UAE market. Drive new sales and business development by generating and exploiting market opportunities. Work closely with local transactional sales specialists as well as the JLL REMS sales and solutions development team. Lead the development and engagement with the JLL Product team to ensure relevant PDS products are developed and scaled across the market.
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Talent Development**
 Lead a team of high\-performing project, construction and design professionals to deliver on our strategy. Coach and develop the next generation of leaders while engaging and motivating a diverse workforce. Attract external talent to JLL and role model inclusive leadership across the organization.
   

  

**Operational Excellence \& Integration**
 Connect UAE PDS seamlessly across the firm, working with multiple stakeholders within a matrixed environment. Break through operational silos to achieve business and client goals. Drive digitization of the business through embedding digital and technology solutions and data analytics for enhanced productivity and client service.
   

  

**Sustainability \& Safety**
 Embed sustainability within PDS's operating framework, tools and technologies to support JLL's sustainability ambitions. Champion health and safety in all aspects of our work, driving a culture of high integrity that upholds JLL's strong ethical standards.
   

  

**Knowledge**
 Deep understanding of the real estate sector, project and construction management processes, and the JLL REMS business. Up to date working knowledge and analysis of the competitive landscape within the UAE. Expertise in PDS governance and contracts, ethical and commercial considerations (profitability, margins) and effective risk management. Understanding of regional macroeconomic trends and their impact on the market (political, social, economic, technological, legal, environmental). Knowledge of One JLL structures, strategic priorities, and ways of working.
   

  

**Desired Experience**
 Proven professional project manager with a record of delivering significant projects within the UAE or broader Middle East region. P\&L responsibility with experience across both upside and downside market conditions. Experience leading a large team, ideally across multiple locations, and a track record of developing high performing teams and nurturing top talent. Operational experience in project and resource management, in particular managing and deploying human resource capacity to client delivery demand. Experience within a large, matrixed organization.
   

  

**Attributes we are looking for**
 Comfortable with uncertainty with the ability to adapt and remain resilient in dynamic environments. Passion to embrace change and new learnings to stay nimble and future\-ready. Culturally sensitive and adept at working at the local level within the UAE market context. Driven, goal\-oriented and self\-confident with strong collaborative and interpersonal skills. Tech and digital savvy with enthusiasm for innovation and emerging solutions.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Our values define who we are, underscore our commitment to clients, and provide direction for everything we do:
   

  

**Inspire –** 
 We are humble, inclusive, and energize people to follow our lead
   

  

**Win Together –** 
 We work across JLL to deliver the best solutions to our clients, community, and planet
   

  

**Simplify –** 
 We move fast by reducing complexity and setting clear direction
   

  

**Be Intentional –** 
 We are courageous, decisive, resilient, and hold ourselves accountable
   

  

**Be Future Ready –** 
 We are curious, agile, and resourceful to stay relevant and future\-ready
   

  

**Location**
 UAE
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Us**
 You'll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together—across the desk and around the globe. Where like\-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. We'll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package.
   

  

 Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sight and imagine where JLL can take you..

 The Com
data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
   

  

 The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

* Meeting clients/sponsors.
* Originating, structuring and executing new deals along with the coverage \& credit team.
* Thoroughly review the existing CRE loan book and identify opportunities to secure existing loans business through a combination of refinance and restructuring.
* Build a platform for growth to support new business initiatives across the FAB footprint.
* Working with other market leaders on transactions and further enhancing FAB’s international profile.

* Working on internal reporting, MIS requirements and support the Head of REF in strategic initiatives.

 Supervise and provide inputs in the preparation of timely and accurate sub\-departmental statements and reports (esp. the Underwriting \& Sales Report) to meet FAB’s and departmental requirements, policies, and standards.

data.jd_text:
**Client Background**
 The client is a privately owned, independent specialty chemical group headquartered in Dubai, UAE, a leading distributor and manufacturer of specialty chemicals serving customers across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa through a buy\-and\-resell distribution model. It operates from 150\+ strategically located sites (sales offices, warehouses, and laboratories), with 1300\+ employees across 40\+ countries, organised along five business units: Coatings, Construction \& Inks; Food Ingredients; Life Sciences; Oil, Gas, Petrochemicals \& Mining; and Plastic, Rubber \& Advanced Materials, and represents many internationally known chemical manufacturers. The group consists of 50\+ subsidiaries.
   

  

 The organisation is independently owned, with no public reporting obligations. It operates a Quality Management System certified to ISO 9001:2015, is SGS\-certified, and complies with Responsible Care®. Its sustainability plan covers environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors, with auditable KPIs linked to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide independent oversight and constructive challenge to the executive on financial and strategic matters.
* Chair the Audit Committee: set its agenda, lead oversight of financial\-reporting integrity and internal control, and own the relationship with the internal and external auditors.
* Oversee risk management and the effectiveness of internal control across the organisation.
* Uphold the highest standards of governance, integrity, and independence.
* Contribute to board discussions on strategy, drawing on senior financial\-leadership experience.


**Sector / Industry Experience**
 Chemicals \& Specialty Chemicals; Chemical Distribution (coatings, construction \& inks; food ingredients; life sciences; oil, gas, petrochemicals \& mining; plastics, rubber \& advanced materials)
   

  

**Level Of Experience**
 Executive (Partner level, C\-suite, \>30 years)
   

  

**Time Commitment**
 Approximately four board meetings per year, plus Audit Committee meetings; an estimated 8 to 12 days per year including preparation and travel. The range is indicative and open to discussion at the interview stage.
   

  

**Work Arrangement**
 Remote. In\-person attendance is required for board meetings in Dubai (approximately four per year); the appointee need not be UAE\-based and may be based outside the region (e.g. Europe).
   

  

**Must\-Have Experience And Skills For Acceptance**
* Current or recent service as a Non\-Executive Director, including as Chair of an Audit Committee.
* Former Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of a multinational of approximately US$1 to 5 billion in annual revenue.
* Financial expertise sufficient to serve as the Audit Committee's designated financial expert: current, demonstrable command of accounting standards, financial reporting, and internal control.
* Sector experience in chemicals, specialty chemicals, or chemical distribution.
* International / multi\-region: significant experience across emerging markets in at least two of the following regions: Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America, combined with senior experience in European corporate environments. GCC experience preferred but not required.
* \>30 years of total work experience.


**Education Level**
 Undergraduate Degree; Postgraduate Degree
   

  

**Other Certifications \& Qualifications**
* A professional accounting or finance qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA, CIMA) or clearly equivalent credentials.
* Membership of a recognised professional accountancy body, strongly preferred.
* A corporate\-governance or director credential (such as IoD Chartered Director, or GCC Board Directors Institute certification), advantageous.


**Specific Client Or Work Experience**
 Board service in a privately held or family\-owned group.
   

  

**Specific Geographic Experience**
 International / multi\-region, significant experience across emerging markets in at least two of the following regions: Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America, combined with senior experience in European corporate environments. GCC experience preferred but not required.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

****Job Description****
 The Senior Director, Visa Global Processor Partnerships, is responsible for executing business development strategies through partnership to grow our business and drive innovation adoption with processor partners located in Visa’s CEMEA Region (Central Europe, Middle East, and Africa). These clients are third party issuer processors (TPP\\’s).
   

  

 This person will work with CEMEA Processing Head in CEMEA region and provide operational support, strategic analysis, sales analysis and technical expertise. The result of these efforts will be increasing strategic value to the client, identifying new uses cases, and delivering Visa innovation across the ecosystem including processing (Issuer), program management, BIN sponsorship and core solutions.
   

  

 The Senior Director will also directly develop the portfolio of issuer processors and processing resellers in the CEMEA region.
   

  

 The role requires a deep understanding of the payments ecosystem, its players, and payment technologies. The Senior Director is required to say abreast of global payment trends and technologies that may affect client strategies.
   

  

 This position is full\-time and located in Dubai.
   

  

 As the Senior Director for Global Processor Partnerships, you will:
   

  

* Head the development and execution of all related sales activities with all Issuer processor in CEMEA region
* Work with product and processing teams to identify and prioritize the implementation of Visa solutions (tokenization, push payments, installments, digital issuance, risk and dispute solutions) for TPP integration and distribution.
* Identify and eliminate friction points that limit our ability to innovate and drive brand outcomes
* Oversee the development and management of the reporting of CEMEA Processing Partnership sales plans, including relevant metrics. Review KPI’s regularly with Processing Head to identify variances and work with the RPS team to address them.
* The person will be directly responsible for all issuer processor relationships and business development activities:
* Deliver on specific and aggressive processor account plans focused on Visa processing products and services, including traditional products, emerging digital solutions, white\-labeled services, and/or open platform extensions to processors
* Identify strategic opportunities through a strong understanding of clients’ businesses, including payment processing strategies aligned with Visa’s overall strategy
* Build and deepen relationships/partnerships with processor executives
* Prepare proposals, RFP’s, and negotiate contractual relationships with various internal and external stakeholders
* Participate on relevant cross\-functional teams (internal / external) that include representation from Product, Technology, Corporate Strategy, Digital Innovation, Operations, Marketing, Risk and Market Research groups


 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
   

  

****Qualifications****
* Strong knowledge of issuer processing, trends, and dynamics including ability to technically assess and engage with processors, fintech clients, neo\-banks, and all related technology players
* Strong knowledge of the CEMEA TPP landscape and the comparative position of regional ecosystem enablers
* 12\-15 years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8\-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6\+ years of work experience with a PhD
* 10 years Pre\-Sales or business development experience with related TPP sales and relationship management experience in the payments industry; issuer/acquirer processing experience/functional processing understanding is critical.
* Demonstrated track record of providing guidance and influence across multiple levels within a client organization, including senior executive management
* Background in planning, managing and closing complex sales efforts
* Background with Processing products and Platforms and its nuances
* Ability to implement strategic initiatives, including market sales plans, policies, and operational decisions
* Proven technical/operational project management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to establish effective relationships with all levels, including senior management
* Excellent strategic thinking and analytic skills and a proven track record of creating solutions that increase revenue
* Ability to manage \& grow internal and external resources and cross\-functional relationships
* Proven ability negotiating business agreements and ability to enhance existing and develop new business partnerships

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

data.jd_text:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and the cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Technical Program Manager/Scrum Master – Global Data Center Segment.** 
 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation
   

  

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Data Center Teams, or solution teams, ensuring consistent application of Scrum events, roles, and artifacts in alignment with Eaton’s Scrum framework.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, fostering transparency, focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.


 Impediment Removal \& Flow Optimization
   

  

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to escalate and resolve systemic issues impacting team flow and predictability.


 Product \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

* Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and alignment to Global Data Center Segment objectives, including safety, scalability, and reliability expectations.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and global stakeholders, enabling clear communication and shared understanding of delivery commitments.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility
   

  

* Support coordination across multiple teams or workstreams contributing to Gray Space UL deliverables.
* Contribute to broader Agile maturity and ways of working improvements across the Global Data Center organization, consistent with Eaton’s global operating model


**Qualifications**
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, with demonstrated ability to apply them pragmatically in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with the data center or IT industry at senior levels.
* Experience working with cross functional global teams, including engineering, compliance, and operations.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from an accredited institution.


**Skills**
* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SM, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience supporting data centers, power systems, electrical infrastructure, or regulated product development preferred.
* Familiarity with UL certification processes or safety‑critical product development.
* Experience operating within large, global enterprises.


**What We Offer You**
* Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry
* Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system
* Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide
* Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally
* Strong processes and state\-of\-the\-art systems and tools
* Detailed induction support and well\-structured onboarding
* Balance your work and life with a hybrid worktime model


 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

*Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management!*

data.jd_text:
Our client is an agency with over a decade of experience delivering world\-class brand events, runway shows, product launches and immersive experiences for the world's most prestigious fashion, beauty and lifestyle houses across the Middle East and beyond.
 



 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an exceptional
 **Events / Project Director** 
 to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-profile productions — someone who brings both creative sensibility and operational precision, and who understands what it means to work at the luxury standard.
 



**The Role** 




 Reporting to senior leadership, you will own the full lifecycle of multiple simultaneous projects — from brief and concept through to flawless on\-site execution. You will be the central point of contact for clients, creative partners and suppliers, and the person ultimately accountable for delivery.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Lead the production of luxury events including runway shows, brand activations, VIP experiences, product launches, store openings and private client events across the UAE and regionally
* Manage client relationships at a senior level, acting as the primary day\-to\-day contact from brief to debrief
* Build, lead and motivate project teams — internal staff, freelancers and specialist suppliers — across creative, technical, logistics and on\-site functions
* Own project budgets from AED hundreds of thousands to multi\-million dirham productions, ensuring financial rigour without compromising on quality
* Drive timelines, critical paths and risk management across concurrent projects
* Collaborate closely with creative directors and designers to ensure production brings the vision to life with precision
* Negotiate and manage supplier contracts, ensuring relationships that serve both quality and commercial outcomes
* Travel regionally as required for site visits, recces and event delivery
* Mentor and develop junior producers and coordinators within the team



**What We're Looking For** 



* Minimum 10 years of experience in luxury event production, with a strong portfolio spanning fashion, beauty, jewellery, hospitality or lifestyle brands
* Proven track record of directing large\-scale, complex productions end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced agency environment
* Deep understanding of what luxury means in execution — the details, the pace, the client expectations
* Strong commercial acumen with experience owning and managing significant budgets
* Excellent relationship management skills — calm, confident and authoritative with senior clients
* Experience working within the Middle East market; UAE experience strongly preferred
* Fluent in English; Arabic is a plus
* Willingness to work non\-standard hours around event schedules

data.jd_text:
**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.
* Manage contractual, commercial, and technical matters arising under the EPC Contract and WTA, in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
* Review, evaluate, and provide recommendations on change orders, variations, and claims submitted by contractors and service providers.
* Lead resolution meetings for technical and construction issues encountered on\-site and off\-site during execution.
* Lead QA/QC oversight and manage the SPV engineering teams including the Owner's Engineer  to witness, verify, and document key inspections and tests in accordance with the approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and project requirements.
* Lead risk assessment and risk identification workshops with the EPC Contractor and Owner's Engineer, ensuring all project risks are identified, formally recorded in the risk register periodically, and supported by clear mitigation and action plans.
* Interact with Sponsors, Lender's Engineer, Insurance Advisers, and O\&M teams.
* Issue progress reports and technical memoranda as required.
* Supervise milestone completion certificates, invoices, and mechanical completion certificates.
* Lead/participate as required in technical review committees as they may be defined during the construction period with sponsors.
* Facilitate the handover of the Project to the O\&M Team.
* Host visitors at the site and manage communications with stakeholders.



**Contractual/Commercial** 



* Timely reporting of contractual/commercial variances and proposing mitigation or alternative solutions.
* Assist in writing contractual letters to stakeholders.
* Identify and anticipate deliverables to relevant parties.
* Coordinate progress of commissioning and testing with Off\-taker and Dispatch Control Centre.
* Assist in claims management with Contractors and Service Providers.



**Qualifications \& Skill Sets** 



* University Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
* Additional qualifications (project management/Construction Management) are preferred
* 15 \+years of project and site experience in large scale power projects, some in CCGT projects.
* Extensive knowledge of utilities and construction of Combined Cycle Power Plants.
* Experience in large infrastructure project execution.
* Experience with Turnkey EPC contractors. (with Chinese EPC contractor preferred)
* Strong technical knowledge and understanding of construction processes, contracts, and international standards.
* Contract/claim management and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with BOO project structures, project finance documents, EPC contracts, PPAs.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead teams.
* Strong ethical standards.

**Role:** 




 An Associate Director in Financial Crime Risk in Supervision is responsible for executing the Financial Crime Risk Team’s work plan. The Associate Director must ensure that a risk based, proportionate and efficient approach is maintained towards all the team’s supervisory activities.
 



  





 An Associate Director is expected to oversee assigned regulatory projects related to financial crime risk and relevant business model within the team, across the Supervision Department and the DFSA, as well as supporting on related policy work.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 The Associate Director is expected to devote the majority of his/her time towards managerial and operational level tasks, as well as support policy development. The Associate Director will assist the Director and contribute to the work of the team with the following key responsibilities:
 



  






 Technical Guidance
 



* Act as a technical expert in respective risk area and provide internal trainings as needed.
* Provide guidance to the team in all aspects of financial crime risk for regulated entities in order to ensure delivery of effective and efficient risk\-based supervision.
* Support DFSA Divisions by providing guidance in all aspects of financial crime risk in line with the DFSA’s objectives.
* Monitor developments in relevant international and regional regulatory standards and in the financial services industry and provide inputs and updates.



  






 Strategy Formulation, Implementation, Planning and Projects
 




  




* Contribute to DFSA\-wide and Supervision Division\-wide strategic direction, business planning and policy formation. Ensure effective cascading of approved strategy, business plans and policies into the day\-to\-day management of the team.
* Participate in the development and implementation of supervision strategy for the team, consistent with the DFSA\-wide goals and objectives.
* Ensure DFSA\-wide projects as captured in the Business Plan relevant to the AD are completed effectively, on\-time and within budget.
* Be expected to devote a considerable level of time toward managerial, policy, outreach and other assigned projects.



  






 People Management
 



* Manage and support the effective achievement of the objectives of respective areas of focus through setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, provision of formal and informal feedback and appraisal in order to maximize subordinate and the overall performance.
* Ensure the key performance indicators, performance reviews, leave approvals and timesheets are completed in an accurate and timely manner for self and team members.
* Support the professional development programs of the DFSA through program development, delivery and participation. Support and contribute to the DFSA graduates training program.
* When requested, effectively lead the team in the absence of the Director.



  





**Educational Background** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management or Economics. A post graduate degree in similar fields would be considered as an advantage.
* Evidence of continuing professional education relevant to target position.
* Professional qualifications in finance, risk management, quantitative analysis, etc. such as ACAMS, CFA, FRM, PRM, etc. would be considered as a plus.



  





**Professional Experience** 



* 10\+ years of regulatory, compliance or risk management experience required in a broadly equivalent financial services regulator and/or a regulated entity, with a minimum of 2 years in managerial/ supervisory roles in one or more of these functions being desirable. Managerial roles might include project leadership / management roles or equivalent with a demonstrated ability to mentor and motivate staff.
* Experience in dealing with financial services regulators, standard setters and members of Board of Directors and senior executives.
* Preferably experience in the development and implementation of regulatory standards and policy analysis.
* Experience of country self\-assessments against the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) 40 recommendations; national risk assessments pursuant to FATF Recommendation 1; and involvement with a FATF country mutual evaluation would be considered an advantage.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 



* Strong and up to date knowledge and technical expertise in dealing with financial services regulations and relevant international standard setters.
* Robust understanding of the responsibilities/role of the regulator and of what it means to be a risk\-based regulator.
* An in\-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and its unique characteristics with proven technical knowledge and understanding of the key risks in the sector.
* Deep understanding of current and emerging risk management trends/issues.
* Appreciation of the unique features of the regulatory regime in the DIFC and understanding of the nature of the financial service activities offered by Authorised Firms operating in the DIFC.
* Strategic vision, strong analytical thinking and creativity; capacity to clearly articulate options and trade\-offs and ability to apply judgment.
* Influential skills and ability to lead meetings and deliver difficult messages, when necessary.
* Excellent people leadership, planning, organisation and time management skills embodied in a professional, diplomatic and ethical attitude.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to address senior executives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including ability to engage effectively and confidently with international counterparts.
* Capacity to deliver high quality work to demanding timescales.
* Be able to work flexibility, autonomously, and co\-operatively in a collaborative team environment.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 This role is for someone who wants real ownership.
   

  

 You’ll be the right hand to the Network Health and Trust \& Safety leadership, owning complex, high\-impact programs that protect customers, partners, and the business. This is not a reporting or coordination role. You will identify risks before they escalate, turn ambiguity into clear execution plans, and drive programs that balance safety, compliance, and operational reality.
   

  

 You’ll work across teams that don’t naturally align, often without direct authority. Your job is to connect the dots, make hard calls, and ensure the right things get done on time, at scale, and with measurable impact.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving messy problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and building mechanisms that last, this role will stretch you in the best way.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end Trust \& Safety and Network Health programs from problem definition to execution and sustained outcomes
* Identify systemic risks and compliance gaps; design scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Drive execution across multiple teams with competing priorities
* Set clear goals, milestones, and success metrics for complex initiatives
* Act as a thought partner to senior leadership on risk, safety, and long\-term strategy
* Build simple, durable mechanisms to track progress and enforce standards
* Raise the bar on how programs are designed, reviewed, and communicated


 A day in the life
   

  

**On a Typical Day, You Might**
* Deep dive into data to understand where risks are emerging and why
* Align with product, operations, legal, and analytics partners on priorities and trade\-offs
* Challenge unclear plans and push for sharper problem statements and success metrics
* Review program progress, unblock teams, and escalate when needed
* Translate complex issues into clear updates for senior stakeholders
* Improve existing processes so teams spend less time reacting and more time preventing issues


 Your internal stakeholders include operations leaders, product teams, analytics partners, and legal or policy counterparts.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Network Health (NH) and Trust \& Safety (T\&S) teams work together to protect Amazon’s Last Mile operations by driving compliance, partner accountability, and safety across the AMET region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey).
   

  

 Network Health owns the end\-to\-end compliance and enforcement lifecycle for Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) — from risk identification and MEP (Monitoring \& Enforcement Plan) management to exit governance and performance reviews. The team ensures that all DSPs operate safely, ethically, and in alignment with Amazon’s Supply Chain Standards and local labor regulations.
   

  

 Trust \& Safety complements this work by focusing on driver\-level safety, identity verification, and incident resolution programs such as ID Check, APEA, and DAF, ensuring that both DSPs and drivers uphold Amazon’s zero\-tolerance standards on compliance and worker welfare.
   

  

 This role operates at the intersection of both functions, helping deliver secure, compliant, and sustainable operations in one of Amazon’s fastest\-growing regions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

 **2027/28 academic year** 
 .
 



 The appointed
 **School Director / Principal** 
 will join Ignite School during the
 **2026/27 academic year** 
 and will play a key leadership role in preparing the new campus for a successful opening. Working closely with the
 **Board of Trustees, KHDA, and the existing school leadership team** 
 , the Director will ensure that all regulatory, operational, staffing, and educational requirements are completed in line with approved standards and timelines.
 



 This role offers a unique opportunity for an experienced and visionary educational leader to help establish the culture, systems, policies, and learning environment of a new early years and elementary campus from its inception.
 



 The new
 **820\-seat campus** 
 has been designed to provide a modern, student\-centered learning environment that supports inquiry, collaboration, creativity, and early childhood development. Facilities will include dedicated learning spaces, specialist teaching areas, a parent and staff café, and extensive outdoor play and exploration areas.
 



**Role Overview** 




**The School Director / Principal will be responsible for the overall strategic direction, leadership, management, and efficient operation of the new campus. The role includes ensuring KHDA compliance, leading operational readiness, supporting student recruitment and enrolment growth, overseeing staff planning and recruitment, and ensuring a smooth transition for students, families, and staff into the new facility.** 




**As the KHDA\-nominated Principal, the Director will serve as the main point of contact for KHDA communications, compliance matters, inspections, and regulatory visits. The Director will also be ultimately accountable for the campus’s health, safety, wellbeing, standards, performance, and continuous improvement.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**New Campus Development and Opening Readiness** 



* Lead the planning and preparation required for the successful opening of the new Pre\-K to Grade 1 campus.
* Work closely with the Board of Trustees and KHDA to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.
* Develop, adapt, and implement campus policies, procedures, systems, and operational readiness plans.
* Support the transition of staff, students, and families to the new campus.
* Oversee student recruitment, admissions planning, and enrolment growth for the new campus.
* Ensure the campus is fully prepared across academic, operational, staffing, compliance, facilities, and parent communication areas.



**Strategic Leadership and School Management** 



* Lead the implementation of the school’s mission, vision, and approved education plan.
* Provide clear strategic direction and ensure effective organizational management.
* Monitor school performance through key performance indicators and improvement targets.
* Ensure high standards in teaching, learning, student wellbeing, safeguarding, and operational delivery.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and culturally respectful school environment.
* Maintain a strong focus on Emirati culture, Arabic language, Islamic values, and UAE national priorities.



**KHDA Compliance and Regulatory Accountability** 



* Serve as the KHDA\-nominated Principal on the school’s Educational Services Permit.
* Act as the main point of contact for KHDA communications, inspections, visits, and compliance matters.
* Ensure all school records are accurate, updated, and available to KHDA when required.
* Ensure full compliance with KHDA, UAE regulatory requirements, safeguarding standards, health and safety expectations, and internal school policies.
* Oversee the implementation of policies related to admissions, health and safety, inclusion, wellbeing, safeguarding, curriculum, assessment, teaching, complaints, and student support.



**Teaching, Learning, and Student Outcomes** 



* Ensure high\-quality teaching, learning, and educational provision across the campus.
* Monitor student progress, achievement, wellbeing, and engagement.
* Ensure the needs of all students are met, including Emirati students, students of determination, high\-performing students, and students requiring additional support.
* Lead the continuous improvement of curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and learning outcomes.
* Support the development of a child\-centered learning environment that promotes inquiry, creativity, collaboration, and early childhood development.



**Parent Partnership and Community Engagement** 



* Build strong, positive relationships with parents and the wider school community.
* Promote effective communication between the Director’s office, families, staff, and stakeholders.
* Lead parent engagement initiatives, meetings, events, and service recovery discussions when required.
* Use parent feedback, surveys, and evaluation data to support timely school improvement.
* Strengthen parent satisfaction, loyalty, and student re\-registration.



**Operational and Financial Management** 



* Ensure effective use of school resources to support educational and operational priorities.
* Manage campus operations in line with approved budgets and school expectations.
* Support enrolment targets, re\-registration, fee collection, and efficient resource allocation.
* Monitor facilities, health and safety, and service quality to ensure a safe and high\-quality school environment.
* Identify operational challenges and allocate resources effectively to support school success.



**Staffing, Performance, and Human Resources** 



* Lead the recruitment and appointment of suitably qualified staff in line with KHDA and school requirements.
* Support the formation and development of the campus leadership and administrative teams.
* Oversee staff performance management, probation reviews, annual evaluations, and professional development.
* Promote staff retention, accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
* Manage staff\-related matters in line with school HR policies, including performance concerns, disciplinary matters, grievances, and allegations against staff.



**School Improvement and Accreditation**

data.jd_text:
**About Dubai Holding Hospitality:** 




 Dubai Holding Hospitality encompasses a diverse range of assets, including luxury hotels, resorts, and a full\-service F\&B portfolio. The company operates and manages several hotels, resorts, and residences across the Middle East, Europe, and Asia, maintaining a reputation for unmatched luxury and service quality.
 



  





**About the Job:** 



* Ensure the supervision consultants are discharging their onsite duties in accordance with their contracted services.
* Together with the supervision consultants, review and comment on contractor programes, logistics plans, method statements and ensure they are aligned with the business requirements.
* Attend scheduled and ad\-hoc meetings and ensure the supervision consultant chairs the meetings and issues minutes of meetings in a timely manner. In the absence of a supervision consultant, Senior Manager is to perform the same tasks.
* Follow up on open or unresolved items raised by the contractor (RFI’s) with the responsible party to ensure the project is not unnecessarily delayed.
* Monitor the project expenditure to ensure it is aligned with the agreed and approved project budget.
* Provide early warnings of possible variations / additional expenditure requirements.
* Suggest to management mitigation strategies for potential project program delays or cost over\-runs.
* Review interim payment applications and make recommendations for approval and / or deductions.
* Review the consultants and contractors’ quality procedures to ensure works are executed correctly, in accordance with good engineering practice and avoiding abortive works.
* Ensure all project participants adopt best practice HSE protocols.
* Coordinate onsite witness testing and inspections as required.
* Ensure the supervision consultants inspect all aspects of the contracted Works and issue a comprehensive punch / snag list.
* Prepare and coordinate preliminary hand\-over inspections and witness testing.
* Coordinate final hand\-over inspections.
* Coordinate with the Operator / end user training procedures.
* Review and approve final hand\-over inspections.
* Ensure the supervisions reviews for completeness the As\-Built information together with the Operation and Maintenance manuals issued by the contractor.
* Coordinate with the relevant stakeholders in obtaining the necessary NOC’s from utility providers and government authorities.
* Coordinate pre\-opening activities with the Operator.
* Inspect the Works during the Defects Notification Period and make recommendations for any contract adjustments.
* Provide a recommendation for the Final Payment Certificate.



  





**About You:** 



* Minimum 10 years’ experience in the construction industry from either a developer or consultancy background.
* At least 5 years focused on project delivery, preferably within a top tier developer international project management firm with specific experience on luxury hospitality.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related discipline
* Proven experience delivering hospitality led refurbishments or luxury hotel projects
* Experience working within live operational assets is essential
* Budgeting: Commercially aware of construction costs and the impact of the decision\-making process on budgets. Able to manage and control costs and offer direction on cost effective solutions inc. leading value engineering processes.
* Stakeholder Management: Establish and maintain relationships with project stakeholders from operational teams, consultants, contractors, authorities and those with project influence. Proactively engaging to foster effective communication.
* Project Management: Able to implement Project management processes.
* Sustainability: Experience of sustainable construction, renewable technology and construction best practice.
* Programmes: Able to prepare and advise on programme impact relative to the overall project delivery objectives and to mitigate the impact of project delays on the overall schedule.
* Quality Control: Able to manage and advise on quality control procedures on site to achieve an exemplary product.
* Project Reporting: Able to prepare and present reports for the wider organisation to update progress on projects status
* Risk Management: An appreciation of risks and understanding of how to document them, including mitigation plans to ensure projects are delivered within their respective constraints.
* Must be proficient in MS Office suite of tools.



  





**About the Benefits:** 




 At Dubai Holding, we're committed to nurturing the success and well\-being of our colleagues. Join our dynamic and diverse team, and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive compensation, career development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment. We strongly believe in creating an empowered workforce that will help us build a connected city for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting the brightest minds and nurturing the most pioneering candidates who desire to make a great impact on the future of Dubai.

data.jd_text:
Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
   

  

**What You Do As a Director Advisory Group**
 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
   

  

 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
   

  

 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

* P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement: Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.
* Stakeholder management: Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.
* People management: Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.


* Project Delivery (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:
+ Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
+ Driving Financial performance
+ Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.


 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
   

  

**Where will you work**
 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
   

  

 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
   

  

* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders


**What we offer**
 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
   

  

* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance


**Are you our new colleague?**
 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
   

  

 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
   

  

 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
   

  

 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
   

  

***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our
 **Agile Delivery** 
 team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

 The
 **Agile Delivery Manager** 
 is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead supplier engagement and governance, including defining SoWs, monitoring SLAs/KPIs, and managing vendor performance to support successful programme delivery. * Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.

 We are building trust infrastructure for device financing in emerging markets — where millions of customers finance smartphones but do not trust banks, services, or promises.
 



 Care\+ is not a warranty department.
 



  





 It is an ecosystem of trust around the device: replacement, refurbishment, anti\-fraud, service operations, and lifecycle management.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — a founding\-level operational leader who will build and scale the entire after\-sales infrastructure across multiple countries.
 



  





 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.

 🔧
 **Device Certification** 




 — Practical experience in smartphone/consumer electronics certification in China
 



 — Real experience working with factories, certification labs, ODMs, and engineering teams

 — Experience with local device certification in Africa / SEA / LATAM countries
 



 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦
 **Spare Parts and Service Infrastructure** 




 — Deep understanding of spare parts movement and after\-sales logistics
 



 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)

 — Understanding of local logistics reality in emerging markets, not only processes “on paper”
 



  





 🌍
 **Remote Management and Operational Audit**

 — Experience investigating:
 


* inventory leakage

* fake parts
* grey market devices
* device swapping
* fake repairs



 — Ability to see the difference between reports and field reality
 



  





 👥

 — Experience hiring first\-level local Service / After\-Sales Managers
 



 — Ability to identify strong local operators “on the ground.”
 



 — Experience managing managers who work locally in\-country but functionally report to HQ
 



 — Experience building a controllable regional structure
 



 — Own network of service / after\-sales contacts in Africa or SEA is a major advantage
 



  





 📋
 **Standardization and Operational Discipline** 




 — Experience building standardized operational frameworks for multi\-country operations
 



 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure
 



 — Process discipline and reporting culture are non\-negotiable
 



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 — Experience working in the Dubai HQ of international companies
 



 — Experience working in: Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Côte d’Ivoire, and other African countries
 



 — Experience in organizations such as Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, realme, Huawei, HMD/Nokia
 



 — Understanding of how emerging markets operations really work outside corporate presentations
 



 — Experience in device financing / BNPL / smartphone financing ecosystems is a major advantage
 



  





**Basic Requirements** 




 — 8\+ years of experience in service / after\-sales / operations management
 



 — Multi\-country operations experience
 



 — Experience building and scaling teams
 



 — Strong analytical and operational mindset
 



 — English fluent (mandatory)
 



 — Willingness to travel: approximately 6–10 days/month during launch phase, with gradual reduction of travel load as operations scale
 



  





**Area of Responsibility** 




 — Building and managing the Care\+ ecosystem
 



 — Device certification in new markets
 



 — Development of service center network
 



 — Spare parts and refurbishment operations
 



 — Hiring, training, and functional management of local Service Managers
 



 — Anti\-fraud strategy and operational audit
 



 — Distributor and ASC relationship management
 



 — Building scalable operational infrastructure across multiple countries
 



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




 — Senior\-level compensation structure discussed individually based on interview results
 



 — Includes fixed base, transparent KPI bonus structure, and long\-term participation opportunity
 



 — Transparent KPI mechanism
 



 — Grace period during the first 2 months
 



 — Dubai HQ leadership role
 



 — International multi\-country scope
 



 — Long\-term leadership growth opportunity within the ecosystem
 



  





**Career Path** 




 Year 1–2: Head of Care\+ Ecosystem
 



 Year 2–3: VP Care\+ Operations
 



 Year 3\+: COO\-track / senior ecosystem leadership
 



  





**What is Important for This Role** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 



 — understands the difference between reports and reality
 



 — knows how to build controllable operations
 



 — is capable of building discipline and standards
 



 — can operate in the complex field reality of emerging markets
 



 — can simultaneously manage people, processes, and risks
 



  





 If you know how to build a controllable after\-sales infrastructure in environments where processes on paper and processes in reality are two different things, we would like to speak with you.
