data.jd_text:
**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 Have a central role in designing and implementing the Fulfillment \& Logistics capabilities whilst aligning with the leadership of Operations vertical and other business partners on what matters most. Lead the business case creation and capability development prioritization with a three\-year horizon in close collaboration with the Head of Capability Development and Chief Logistics and Fulfillment Officer. Maintain an understanding of advancements in process, technology and other innovations which are happening across the supply chain \& logistics ecosystem within the retail industry.
   

  

 In their endeavor to excellence, the fundamental values all our employees must possess are Commitment, Integrity, Empathy and Flexibility
   

  

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Design and deliver the logistics \& fulfillment capabilities simultaneously driving insights into actions by evaluating and understanding operational and business needs.
* Develop detailed business cases to initiatives and lead prioritisation of capabilities utilising business case information to trade\-off decisions.
* Navigate and influence complex organizational structures and align the cross\-cultural, cross\-functional teams including leadership in the capability roadmap prioritization.
* Implement the prioritised capabilities across the end\-to\-end fulfillment and logistics processes assisting the local teams.
* Apply programme management principles and tools to ensure capabilities are delivered at speed, adopted and sustained within the group.
* Build and manage highly effective teams to help design and implement capabilities, with a strong focus in developing the junior colleagues.
* Be a servant leader and great teammate able to navigate a matrix work environment and excel as a self\-directed influencer and leader.
* Be highly analytical and data driven to make informed decisions.
* Balance multiple deadlines and priorities along with communication to the related stakeholders.
* Identify leading, innovative and practical ideas \& solutions fit for purpose for Chalhoub's logistics and fulfillment capabilities.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
 To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
 It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
   

  

 We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

**Job Description**
**Director Advisory Group Water \& Maritime Middle East**
 Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
   

  

**What You Do As a Director Advisory Group**
 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
   

  

 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
   

  

 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
   

  

**Key Performance Indicators**
* P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement: Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.
* Stakeholder management: Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.
* People management: Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.
* Project Delivery (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:
* Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
* Driving Financial performance
* Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.


 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
   

  

**Where will you work**
 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
   

  

 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
   

  

* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders


**What We Offer**
 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
   

  

* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.

Our client is a global industrial services organisation operating across critical infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, technology and complex project environments. With operations spanning multiple continents and a reputation for delivering mission\-critical solutions, the business is entering an ambitious phase of growth across one of its most strategically important regions.
 



 The organisation is seeking an exceptional People leader to partner directly with the Managing Director of a substantial regional business employing several hundred people across multiple countries. The business has ambitious growth plans and is focused on building a high\-performance culture that combines commercial success, operational excellence and strong leadership capability.
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



 This is not a traditional HR role.
 



 The successful candidate will be a highly commercial People leader who believes that the best people decisions are made by understanding the reality of the business on the ground. You will be expected to spend significant time alongside leaders and teams, understanding how the operation works, how customers are served, how revenue is generated and where barriers to performance exist.
 



 You will build credibility by being visible within the business, developing a deep understanding of its commercial drivers, operational challenges and growth opportunities. Using those insights, you will influence organisational design, talent strategy, leadership effectiveness, workforce planning and culture to improve business performance.
 



 As a key member of the leadership team, you will act as a trusted advisor to the Managing Director and senior leaders, providing support, challenge and perspective to ensure people decisions create tangible commercial outcomes.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Partner with the Managing Director and leadership team to shape and execute business strategy.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the commercial and operational realities of the business through regular engagement with frontline teams, operational leaders and commercial functions.
* Translate business insight into practical people solutions that improve performance, productivity, engagement and growth.
* Lead organisational design, workforce planning and capability\-building initiatives that support long\-term expansion.
* Coach, challenge and support senior leaders to create a culture of accountability, inclusion and high performance.
* Use people and business data to identify risks, opportunities and future capability requirements.
* Drive leadership succession, talent development and employee engagement strategies.
* Lead significant change and transformation programmes across a complex multi\-country environment.
* Act as the senior interface between the business and specialist people functions, ensuring solutions are aligned to business priorities.



  





 The Individual
 



 We are seeking a commercially minded People leader who is naturally curious about how businesses operate.
 



 You are likely to have built your career partnering senior operational and commercial leaders in complex, fast\-paced environments where growth, transformation and performance matter.
 



  





 The successful candidate will bring:
 


* A proven track record operating as a trusted advisor to senior executives.
* Deep experience within large, complex, multi\-country organisations.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect people strategy directly to business performance.
* A reputation for spending time in the business rather than observing it from a distance.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders through insight, credibility and challenge.
* Demonstrated success leading change, organisation development and growth initiatives.
* Strong understanding of operational and frontline environments.
* Exceptional relationship\-building and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Experience across the Middle East region would be highly advantageous.
* Arabic and English language capability would be beneficial.



  





 Why This Role?
 



 This is an opportunity to influence a significant regional business at a pivotal point in its growth journey.
 



 The successful individual will work alongside an ambitious Managing Director and leadership team, playing a central role in shaping organisational capability, leadership effectiveness and culture while helping deliver ambitious commercial objectives.

data.jd_text:
Celeros Flow Technology, LLC For over 140 years our products have helped ensure the safe, reliable operations of key industries. With a passion for precision and partnership, Celeros Flow Technology continues this heritage of high performance and dependability, providing mission critical, sustainable flow control solutions for our customers around the globe.
   

  

 Celeros Flow Technology is looking for individuals with a voice and a vision. We embrace change, diversity and promote new ways of looking at old ideas. We seek talented professionals to join our world\-class team of innovators in a global, collaborative \& multi\-cultural environment, where you will be challenged, supported, and inspired to be extraordinary.
   

  

**General Summary**
 The Regional Sales Manager will be responsible for the sales and business development of the of assigned brands / products / services to key Power \& Energy End Users, within the assigned Middle East territories:
   

  

**Pumps – UAE and Qatar**
 The Regional Sales Manager – Pumps Aftermarket (UAE \& Qatar) will be responsible for driving profitable growth of the Pumps Aftermarket business, with a strong emphasis on expanding the service portfolio across UAE and Qatar. The role will focus on developing long term customer relationships, identifying service opportunities throughout the installed base, and increasing market penetration for repairs, field services, upgrades, reliability solutions, and long term service agreements.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to proactively engage with end users, maintenance teams, and asset owners to position the company as the preferred lifecycle partner for rotating equipment. This role requires a strong hunter mentality with the ability to identify, develop, and convert service opportunities into sustainable revenue streams while supporting the growth of spare parts, replacement pumps, and engineered solutions.
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
* Lead the growth of the Pumps Aftermarket business across UAE and Qatar, with a primary focus on expanding service sales and lifecycle solutions.
* Develop and execute a regional service growth strategy targeting Oil \& Gas, Power, Water, Petrochemical, and Industrial customers.
* Identify and convert opportunities for:
+ Pump repairs and overhauls
+ Field services and site support
+ Installation and commissioning services
+ Pump performance assessments and reliability studies
+ Engineered upgrades and retrofits
+ Reverse engineering solutions
+ Long\-Term Service Agreements (LTSA)
+ Shutdown and turnaround service opportunities

* Build and maintain strong relationships with maintenance, reliability, operations, and asset management personnel within key customer accounts.
* Drive installed base penetration by identifying ageing equipment, recurring maintenance requirements, and replacement opportunities.
* Develop account plans for strategic customers with a focus on increasing service contract coverage and recurring aftermarket revenue.
* Work closely with service operations and engineering teams to develop tailored service offerings that address customer reliability and operational challenges.
* Promote condition assessment programs, asset health checks, and reliability improvement initiatives to position the company as a trusted service partner.
* Maintain a robust pipeline of service opportunities and ensure accurate forecasting of service revenue and order intake.
* Support channel partners and service providers in developing local service opportunities and enhancing customer engagement.
* Achieve annual sales targets for service, repairs, upgrades, spare parts, and replacement equipment while maintaining profitability objectives.
* Sell and promote Celeros Flow Technology assigned products, spares and services in assigned territories, either directly to the Customer or via Local Agents / Distributors (where necessary).
* Where Local Agents / Distributors are necessary ensure the appropriate procedures are followed and the required ongoing support is provided. When engaging with a new Local Agent / Distributor ensure the due diligence documents are completed and approved by the Legal Department. Continue to manage and support the Local Agents / Distributors – provide technical and commercial support, provide training and guidance, make joint visits to key Customers as necessary, set KPI’s, monitor and evaluate performance, provide feedback / escalate as necessary.
* In close consultation with the Commercial Tendering Team and where necessary the Engineering Team, review and interpret Customer enquiries. Analyze the requirements in line with data sheets, specifications, P\&IDs, plans, and other project specific documents. Design, size and select suitable solution as per the Customers requirements and support the Tendering and Engineering Team to develop an appropriate proposal / quotation.
* Secure the necessary approval to quote for all opportunities above a Company defined threshold limit by seeking approvals as per the Company established approval matrix
* For both the Company and the Customer coordinate the technical and commercial review of the quotation and assist with the negotiations for the same.
* Once quotation negotiations have concluded, prior to receiving the Customers PO, secure the necessary approval as per Company established approval matrix for all orders above Company defined threshold limit and for all orders that stipulate exceptional T\&C’s.
* Organise and drive the preparation of bids and contracts.
* Coordinate with the Finance / Accounts team and be aware of and problems with Supplier and Customer accounts.
* Coordinate and actively participate in the order hand over meeting with the Manufacturing Facility, Project Manager and Supply Chain Team. Provide clarification on any specific project requirements and on any technical or commercial queries.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, review the market potential for assigned products in the assigned territories and compile a strategy and action plan in order to maximize market potential and achieve targets. Continue to develop and recommend innovative ideas and tactics to increase market share and increase sales.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, evaluate and determine optimum route to market, including a pricing and marketing strategy and identify suitable partnership Companies to sell Celeros Flow Technology products and services.
* Execute agreed action plans to achieve targets for assigned products in the assigned territories.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity in the assigned region on a regular basis. Report any concerns and suggested solutions and any opportunities and suggested action plans to the Line Manager / Regional Director.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports (forecast, customer visit report, etc.) showing sales volume including potential sales, monitored against the budget, with action plans to address variations.
* Prepare and deliver sales presentations and technical presentations to internal and external stakeholders.
* Participate in trade shows, exhibitions and seminars either directly or in conjunction with Local Agents / Distributors.
* Represent the Company in a professional manner aligned to the Celeros Flow Technology Values and ensure all activities comply with both legal and ethical standards.


**Successful Profile**
 The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in developing rotating equipment service businesses, securing maintenance and service contracts, driving installed base growth, and creating long term customer partnerships. Experience selling value added engineered solutions and reliability solutions within the Oil \& Gas, Power, Water, or Industrial sectors will be highly advantageous.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Thinks both creatively and commercially; has in\-depth engineering knowledge to identify technical risks, solve problems and provide solutions but also has in\-depth commercial knowledge to identify risks within contracts.
* Analyses and interprets common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Must be able to define the problem, assess the risks, and develop recommendations for action plans. Furthermore, must be able to execute the action plan, focus and guide others to accomplish the plan and drive change where necessary.
* Encourages others to seek opportunities for different and innovative approaches to addressing problems and opportunities; facilitates the implementation and acceptance of change within the workplace.
* Displays exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, even when handling multiple demands and has a proven track record of meeting high performance standards.
* Responds professionally to all inquiries and complaints and remains calm and composed when under pressure.
* Communicates effectively, effortlessly tailoring the approach to the audience and the level of technical competence.
* Possesses the ability to prepare and deliver both sales and technical presentations and to train and transfer technical knowledge to internal and external stakeholders.
* Clearly and succinctly conveying information and ideas to individuals and groups in a variety of situations; communicating in a focused and compelling way that drives others’ thoughts and actions. Engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.
* Uses appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance of ideas and plans; modifying one’s own behaviour to accommodate tasks, situations, and individuals involved.
* Exhibits confidence with negotiations and possesses the power to influence.
* Is well organized, structured and methodical.
* Is self\-motivated, works independently with little supervision, positively establishes relationships across multiple locations and copes well with working remotely from the team and other departments.
* Is an effective team player (committed, reliable, responsible, flexible, helpful, supportive, active listener / communicator).
* Communicates fluently (verbal and written) in English \- essential, in Arabic – advantageous
* Possesses a valid Driving Licence converted for use in the Middle East – essential


**Education And Experience**
* Degree in an Engineering discipline (Mechanical, Chemical, Manufacturing, Production, Fluid Power Technology) and ten years related experience.
* Five years’ experience in the oil \& gas / power \& energy market – essential
* Relevant experience of Centrifugal Pumps, API 610, 614, 682 International Standards and major Pump end user’s within the middle east region (ADNOC, ADWEA, Qatar Petroleum, QEWC, KOC, KNPC, MEW, PDO ETC.) – essential
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft packages including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Project.


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**
 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

* Required daily to stand, sit, walk, talk, hear, and see (specific close vision abilities are required to perform computer work)
* Required occasionally to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl
* Required daily to use hands and fingers and arms to reach (to operate a computer and telephone)
* Required occasionally to lift and/or move objects that are light to moderate
* Required occasionally to travel (usually by air or road so may be required to sit for extended periods)


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

* Ability to work with moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phone, and printers, etc.)
* Ability to work in an open planned office / individual office
* Ability to sit at a computer terminal for extended periods
* Ability to sit in a car or on a plane for extended periods


**DISCLAIMER**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**CELEROS FLOW TECHNOLOGY VALUES**
 All Celeros divisions are committed to the effective use of the Celeros Values. It is important that all employees understand and utilize these values when performing the duties of his/her position.
   

  

**INTEGRITY:** 
 We work safely and respect our employees, business partners \& environment. We always lead by example.
   

  

**SPEED:** 
 In our mission to bring mission\-critical flow control equipment to the world, energy in our actions \& urgency.
   

  

**ACCOUNTABILITY:** 
 We stand behind our actions and deliver on our promises.
   

  

**PARTNERSHIP:** 
 We collaborate across our teams \& our customers to win together. We rely on each other to deliver the best outcome \& celebrate successes.
   

  

**EXCELLENCE:** 
 We are passionate about being the best at engineering, manufacturing \& maintaining mission\-critical equipment. We seek quality \& community improvement in every interaction.
   

  

**QUALITY**
 Quality encompasses all aspects of Celeros’ business, and every employee shares the responsibility to prevent the occurrence of any nonconformity relating to product, process and the quality system. All employees have an obligation to identify and record any such nonconformity, and through designed channels, initiate and recommend solutions.
   

  

**CELEROS Flow Technology is an equal opportunity employer.**

data.jd_text:
**About Faux Consultancy.** 




 Founded in 2011, Faux is the Middle East’s leading Public Relations and Events Consultancy, working in partnership with global brands and the region’s most exciting independent concepts. Based in Dubai and working actively across the whole of the GCC, Faux is a trusted on\-the\-ground partner for brands focused on amplifying their visibility and commercial success in the region. Faux’s client divisions focus solely on Fashion and Beauty, spanning the luxury and niche sectors. This sharp focus, along with the agency’s legacy of over a decade of innovative brand representation, allows for a level of experience and insight that is unmatched. We are committed to providing the most qualitative, thoughtful and effective representation for our brands.
 



  





 The Account Director is a central leadership role within Faux, spanning key pillars of strategic development and project implementation for both local and international clients. Working in direct collaboration with the Senior Management team, this is a position that involves engagement in both day\-to\-day Account Direction and team management, as well as high\-level strategic planning and the opportunity to be involved in Business Development.
 



  





 Overseeing a portfolio of Beauty brands, the Account Director is responsible for leading a team of employees in the successful management and representation of their ‘team portfolio’, ensuring a qualitative approach to Public Relations in the GCC, and achieving certain KPIs associated with the accounts.
 



 The Account Director ensures that best\-practice standards are always in place, from strategy development through to campaign execution, and enjoys a level of autonomy in the management of their ‘working group’ to best utilise and develop the talents of their team.
 



  





 This role requires significant industry experience in a similar Senior PR position, working specifically across Beauty clients, preferably with experience or insight into the GCC Market. The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong sense of self\-direction and a desire to take on a top leadership role within a market\-leading, fast\-paced and dynamic agency.
 



  





 Innovation, professionalism, and a qualitative approach to Public Relations lie at the heart of Faux's approach to client representation, and these qualities will be reflected in the successful candidate, in terms of their previous success and future goals.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Development and implementation of innovative and effective GCC\-wide strategies for PR clients, spanning Press, Influencer, VIP and CRM Relations
* Leadership of a dedicated team within the company, providing structure, mentorship and guidance to ensure smooth workflow and delivery
* Securing qualitative, high\-value PR coverage and other results in line with allocated KPIs, always aiming to exceed targets
* Demonstrate strong leadership skills, including allocation of tasks, mentoring of direct reports, and providing clear, critical feedback
* Responsibility for the successful delivery of organic and commercial PR projects carried out on behalf of clients, including planning, implementation, and post\-activity analysis
* Work in partnership with the Faux Events team to effectively plan and host events, activations, and other concepts for agency clients
* Provide active contribution to the business development goals of the agency, participating in the development and presentation of pitches for new business
* Maintain a strong awareness of industry trends, talents, and other movements, to provide the best possible insight to clients, GCC\-wide
* Planning and negotiation of commercial talent and media deals on behalf of clients, including advertorials, ambassadorship deals, and paid campaigns
* Local content creation: show expertise and ease in handling production and post\-production of localised campaigns, which are specifically targeted to the GCC market
* Daily budget management, including the responsible planning, spending, and tracking of client budgets
* Team management to ensure the accurate data gathering, analysis and client reporting are carried out within the provided deadlines
* Active contribution to the development of a positive workplace culture, collaborating and sharing suggestions with Senior Management on ways to best motivate and reward the team.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* A bachelor's or master’s degree in public relations, communications or other relevant discipline
* **At least 8 years of PR industry experience, including in the role of Public Relations / Communications Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **At least 3 years in a similar role or as a Senior PR Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **A strong media and influencer network across the GCC is an essential requirement**
* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to confidently guide, motivate and manage a team
* A creative thinker who values innovation, bringing to the table fresh ideas and strategies
* Proven success in a previous senior PR role, including the securing of high\-value coverage and the generation of market\-leading ideas
* Excellent regional networks with the leading press, influencers, stylists and celebrities
* A positive and engaged attitude to relationship development in the region
* An awareness and understanding of regional market nuances, and their impact on Beauty brand management
* A keen interest in social media trends and a keen interest in staying ahead of the curve, always to nourish our clients with fresh concepts and locally relevant and time\-sensitive social listening ideas
* Strong multi\-tasking and organisational skills, to thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment where many projects are carried out in parallel
* High level of organisation and experience in complex workflow management, with the ability to hit strict deadlines and KPIs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into engaging stories
* Ad\-hoc regional and international travel will be required.

**Dubai\-based. Part of a newly formed specialist construction legal team within DAMAC Digital.**

data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.
* **A Fluent Arabic Speaker** 
 required for this role.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Staff Management, Mentoring and Training**

Support staff writing technical notes from these training opportunities and/or project experiences

**Project Management**




 The Associate will provide leadership to ensure the efficient and profitable completion of all tasks and projects under their control whilst ensuring the allocation of adequate resources, excellent technical standards and client satisfaction including:

* Undertake or assist the project leaders with negotiation of fees and contracts where appropriate to ensure financial targets are achieved
* Manage business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to the signing contracts
* Allocate and manage project personnel to suit programs and project budgets
* Project lead internally with respective team colleagues to allow deliverables to be issued to client
* Coordinate and work with the design team to deliver project deliverables

* As Project Leader, monitor and report on team performance against agreed timelines, and fees/budgets
* Oversee the work of Sub Consultants/Contractors and review outputs produced by them

**Consultancy Function**




 The Associate shall assist in the consultancy functions including:
   

  




* Preparation and coordination of expressions of interest, tender submissions and similar consulting proposals
* Maintain a hands\-on approach to the provision of design and engineering, and assist in the co\-ordination of other disciplines.
* Contribute and monitor the design and engineering of curtain wall and cladding systems, as well as specialty systems (i.e., structural glass, cables, ETFE etc.)

data.jd_text:
**Senior Technical Project Manager – Thermal Generation** 




**Project Development and New Technologies, AMEA** 









**Objective** 




  





 The Senior Technical Project Manager (STPM) \- Thermal Generation Projects and New Technologies leads the technical development of large power projects and supports the decarbonization initiatives of the thermal generation fleet in Asia, Middle East and Africa region (AMEA). The STPM will be responsible for supporting the extensions of PPAs of existing thermal assets, development of greenfield thermal power projects (OCGT and CCGT), asset decarbonization initiatives and projects, assessment of new technologies in collaboration with the ENGIE Group Research and Innovation ecosystem, and management of third party engineering consultants. S/he may from time to time also be involved in Hydrogen and Battery Energy Storage projects.
 



  





**Job responsibility** 




  





**Technical Project Management (Thermal Generation Greenfield Projects and Extensions)** 



* Provides the technical definition of the project and manages the selection of technologies, specifications, configuration, performance analysis, availability, outages, and evaluation of innovative technology solutions.
* Assure safety operability and maintainability is careful considered in new plant designs.
* Manages/Reviews all project related studies during bidding/development phase till hand\-over to execution: pre\-feasibility studies (if any), feasibility studies (if any), ESIA studies…
* Leads the technical development and documentation of the contractual agreements during development/bidding and negotiation stage: EPC, PPA, electricity connection agreement, LTPRA, LTSA, O\&M Contracts etc...
* Contributes to the technical qualification of EPC Contractors
* Manages the main equipment supplier’s selection with the EPC contractor.
* Animates and manages several technical review meetings with the EPC contractor to optimize the plant design.
* Manages the technical mark up and proposed deviations (if any) of bidding documents.
* In narrow coordination with Procurement proposes and defines technical\-commercial optimizations with the contractor(s).
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares the technical related part of the project execution and operation.
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares all Construction technical and O\&M related documents for the proposal/bid: EPC Term sheet and/or EPC Contract, O\&M Term Sheet and/or contract, OM organization chart, including Guarantees and testing procedures, O\&M philosophy...
* Based on technical assumptions develop the CAPEX and OPEX cost for the project.
* Liaises with the lenders and the Lender's Engineer for the establishment of their due diligence report prior to Financial Close.
* Ensures detail coordination with all internal stakeholders: BD, Construction, Operation, Legal, Finance and Procurement teams
* Contributes to the internal approval process (for Bid submission including Construction, Technical and O\&M) until Financial Close. Ensures adequate internal reviews.
* Support the negotiations with the contractors.
* Punctually provides support to construction and operation activities.
* Prepares the technical hand\-over for execution stage.
* Ensures experience capitalization and REX integration.



  





**New Technologies and Decarbonisation Lead** 



* Acts as a SPOC for the ENGIE Group Research \& Innovation (R\&I) programmes and community
* Leads on implementation of decarbonisation initiatives or projects and supports other team members with decarbonisation topics
* Maintains a technology watch
* Fosters the innovation culture by coordinating and animating knowledge sharing



**Lead on Engagement of Third\-Party Engineering Consultants** 



* Keeps a market watch on engineering consultants (technical advisors)
* Leads the qualification, tendering, selection and management of technical consultants: Bid Technical Advisor, Owners’ Engineer, Lenders’ Technical Advisors, ESIA Consultant… on various AMEA projects



**Qualification/Experience** 



* Engineering degree, with a minimum of 15 years of experience.
* Experience in projects technical development.
* Experience in bid preparation.
* Experience in thermal power generation projects (preferably CCGT).
* Excellent capability in interpreting and optimising power plant design and performance; experience using Thermoflow software is a plus.
* Good understanding of thermal generation decarbonisation technologies, including renewable gases, CCUS…
* Experience in engaging and working with engineering consulting firms.
* Experience in preparing and negotiating contractual documents: WPA, PPA, PWPA, EPC, EPCM, subcontractors, O\&M, LTSA, LTPRA, consultants’ contracts...
* Experienced in interfacing with BD team, legal team, finance team, construction team, operation team.
* Experience in managing and coordinating research and innovation programmes will be an advantage.
* Experience in desalination will be an advantage.
* Experience within ENGIE Group will be an advantage.



**Character and Skills** 



* Pro\-active, autonomous, taking ownership of issues and drive to resolve them
* Organized and rigorous
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills
* Able to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders from different backgrounds
* Languages: fluent English. Arab or French will be an advantage.



  





  





 ENGIE group is a global reference in low\-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon\-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers.
 



 ENGIE’s Business Unit for the Asia Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is headquartered in Dubai. The region has activities in large scale power generation, water desalination, district cooling, energy solutions and renewables including green hydrogen, wind and solar. We act throughout the value chain: strategy, design, engineering, energy\-efficient asset construction, digital platforms, operations management, financing syndication and outcome assurance. And, by using globally leading technologies, we create innovative energy and smart solutions that help to make the world a better place.

We are retained by a leading infrastructure operator in the UAE to appoint an experienced Project Manager / Expert to join a major programme management consultancy (PMC) environment.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 Lead the delivery of major railway infrastructure and construction packages across the organisation's programme, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with technical, contractual, and stakeholder requirements.
 



 The role will provide strategic leadership across construction, engineering, project controls, commercial, HSE, quality, and stakeholder management functions for complex rail and transportation infrastructure projects. The orhanisation is responsible for the development, construction and operation of the UAE's national railway network, including major civil, systems and passenger rail infrastructure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of major rail infrastructure and construction projects.
* Manage EPC contractors, consultants and key stakeholders.
* Ensure programme milestones, budgets and quality objectives are achieved.
* Provide strategic oversight of construction methodologies, logistics and execution plans.
* Lead project governance, reporting and risk management processes.
* Drive HSE performance and ensure compliance with UAE and international railway standards.
* Manage interfaces between civil, track, systems, stations, depots and operational stakeholders.
* Lead commercial reviews, variation management and claims resolution.
* Chair senior project and progress meetings with executive stakeholders.
* Support procurement, tender evaluations and contractor performance management.
* Ensure successful project handover to operations and maintenance teams.



  





**Requirements** 



* Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management or related discipline.
* 20\+ years' experience delivering major infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 10 years in senior leadership positions (Project Director, Construction Director, Delivery Director, Programme Manager).
* Extensive experience on rail, metro, high\-speed rail, transportation or mega infrastructure projects.
* Proven track record managing projects exceeding AED 1 billion in value.
* Strong experience managing international contractors and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience within GCC preferred.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, MRICS, CEng or equivalent preferred.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Finance Manager – Project Accounting (Real Estate Development)**
**Location:** 
 UAE
   

  

**Department:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Chief Financial Officer (CFO) / Finance Director
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Finance Manager – Project Accounting will be responsible for overseeing the financial management of real estate development projects from feasibility assessment through project completion. The role requires strong expertise in project accounting, financial modeling, project finance, escrow management, budgeting, cost control, and stakeholder management with banks, investors, consultants, contractors, and regulatory authorities. The incumbent will play a key role in ensuring financial viability, funding availability, compliance with UAE real estate regulations, and accurate financial reporting of development projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Feasibility \& Financial Analysis


 Prepare and review project feasibility studies for new real estate developments. Develop detailed financial models incorporating sales projections, construction costs, financing costs, cash flow forecasts, and profitability analysis. Conduct sensitivity analysis and scenario planning for project viability assessment. Evaluate investment returns including IRR, NPV, ROI, and project margins. Support management in investment decision\-making and project acquisitions.
   

  

* Fund Raising \& Project Financing


 Lead debt and equity fund\-raising initiatives for development projects. Prepare financial information packages, presentations, and lender information memorandums. Liaise with banks, financial institutions, investors, and advisors for project financing requirements. Coordinate due diligence processes with lenders and investors. Negotiate financing terms, covenant requirements, and facility documentation in coordination with management and legal teams. Monitor compliance with financing agreements and reporting obligations.
   

  

* Banking \& Financial Institution Management


**Requirements**
 Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions. Coordinate project finance drawdowns and utilization of facilities. Monitor loan covenants and reporting requirements. Facilitate issuance, renewals, amendments, and cancellations of:
   

  

* Performance Guarantees Advance Payment Guarantees Retention Guarantees Corporate Guarantees Other banking instruments
* Escrow Account Management


 Ensure compliance with UAE Real Estate Regulatory Authority (RERA) and escrow regulations. Coordinate with project auditors, consultants, and escrow banks for fund release approvals. Review and submit payment release applications from escrow accounts. Monitor escrow collections and utilization against approved project budgets. Maintain accurate records and reconciliations of escrow transactions. Liaise with regulatory authorities and escrow agents on project\-related matters.
   

  

* Project Budgeting \& Cost Control


 Develop project budgets and cash flow forecasts. Monitor actual expenditures against approved budgets. Analyze cost variances and recommend corrective actions. Review commitments, contracts, and purchase orders to ensure budget compliance. Support value engineering initiatives to optimize project profitability. Prepare monthly project cost reports and management dashboards.
   

  

* Payment Certification \& Contractor Management


 Review interim payment applications submitted by contractors and consultants. Verify payment certifications against approved contracts and project progress reports. Coordinate with project management and consultants to validate work completion. Ensure timely processing and release of payments in accordance with contractual terms. Monitor retention, advance recoveries, and variation orders.
   

  

* Project Accounting \& Financial Reporting


 Maintain complete accounting records for development projects. Ensure proper allocation and capitalization of project costs. Manage project\-wise revenue recognition and cost accounting. Prepare monthly project profit and loss statements. Monitor project cash flows and funding requirements. Ensure compliance with IFRS and company accounting policies. Support annual audits and statutory reporting requirements.
   

  

* Financial Planning \& Cash Flow Management


 Prepare short\-term and long\-term project cash flow forecasts. Monitor funding requirements throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure adequate liquidity for project execution. Optimize utilization of debt and equity financing.
   

  

* Stakeholder Coordination


**Liaise With**
* Banks and Financial Institutions Investors and Shareholders Project Auditors Escrow Banks Consultants and Contractors Legal Advisors Regulatory Authorities Internal Project and Sales Teams


 Provide financial insights and reports to senior management.
   

  

* Governance, Compliance \& Risk Management


 Ensure compliance with UAE regulations, escrow requirements, financing agreements, and company policies. Monitor project financial risks and recommend mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal controls over project expenditures and funding utilization. Support implementation of ERP and project accounting systems.
   

  

* Taxation \& Statutory Compliance


 Ensure timely VAT compliance on project transactions, including output VAT on sales and recovery of input VAT on construction costs. Ensure compliance with UAE Corporate Tax requirements, including registration, computation, and filing for project entities. Coordinate with tax consultants and auditors on tax planning, assessments, and clarifications. Maintain proper tax records, documentation, and reconciliations for development projects.
   

  

* Team Leadership \& Development


 Lead, mentor, and develop the project finance and accounting team. Allocate responsibilities and review the work of project accountants and finance staff. Set performance objectives and support training and capability building within the team.
   

  

* Insurance Management


 Coordinate project and construction insurance cover (e.g., Contractor All\-Risk, third\-party liability) with brokers and insurers. Ensure adequate insurance is maintained throughout the project lifecycle and renewed on time. Manage insurance claims and recoveries in coordination with project and legal teams. Verify that insurance requirements under financing agreements and contracts are met.
   

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
 Accuracy of project feasibility and financial models. Timely closure of debt and equity funding requirements. Compliance with financing covenants and escrow regulations. Budget variance management. Project cash flow accuracy. Timely release of escrow funds. Project profitability achievement. Accuracy and timeliness of project financial reporting. Effective management of bank guarantees and financing facilities.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
 Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or related field. Professional qualification preferred:
   

  

* CA ACCA CPA CMA


**Experience**
 8–12 years of finance experience, with at least 5 years in UAE real estate development. Strong experience in:
   

  

* Project Finance Real Estate Development Accounting Financial Modeling Feasibility Studies Escrow Management Debt and Equity Fund Raising Project Budgeting and Cost Control Bank Guarantee Management RERA and Escrow Compliance


 Experience dealing with UAE banks for project financing is essential.
   

  

**Technical Skills**
 Advanced Financial Modeling (Excel) Project Feasibility Analysis Project Accounting IFRS Knowledge Cash Flow Forecasting ERP Systems (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Yardi, Property Developer ERP, etc.) Power BI and Financial Reporting Tools Banking and Treasury Management Commercial Awareness Analytical and Problem\-Solving Ability Stakeholder Management Leadership and Team Management Strong Communication and Presentation Skills
