Inhabit is a unique, multi\-disciplinary team of professionals who are passionate about making a positive contribution to our built environment.
   

  





 We are a collective of experienced architects, designers, engineers and detailers who work both independently and in partnership to form a holistic approach to the services that we offer. We believe that our respective areas of expertise can be integrated to allow seamless interdisciplinary synergy to create buildings that are more relevant to our evolving society.
   

  





 We are focused on design\-led engineering, providing technical and comprehensive solutions that thoughtfully and creatively consider aesthetics, engineering, cost, procurement, and sustainability driving towards a building that is sensitive and inspirational within its socio\-cultural context.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**List of Responsibilities**




 The Associate Director forms part of the engineering team within the global structure of the company and assumes responsibilities that pro\-actively contribute to the growth of Façade Engineering and specialist design and engineering team within the global structure of the Inhabit and Egis company structure.
   

  





 The role assumes both KPI based and general responsibilities that actively contribute to project technical and commercial delivery, compliance, functional wellbeing, advancement and growth of facade discipline and all other specialist and general disciplines.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for all design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken for façade and all other disciplines. You will lead, develop, and manage a team of approx. (5\-10\) direct reports. You may also need to fulfil any legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for team engagement and growth, technical excellence, ethics, project leadership, design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken by the facade team. You will also need to fulfill legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 The following is an overview of responsibilities and performance standards required of the Associate Director:
   

  




* Major Function
* Project Operation / Management
* Strategic Management
* Financial Management
* Marketing and Business Development
* Staff Management, Mentoring and Training
* Client Management
* Project Management
* Consultancy Function
* Technical Excellence
* Personal Growth



**Major Function**




 Duties include but not limited to:
   

  





  

  




* Represent Inhabit on projects with clients and provide technical leadership and assistance to ensure projects meet high quality standards and are managed in accordance with timeframes and budget parameters
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Create, build and maintain business opportunities
* Manage projects and resources to ensure professional services are achieved and deliver high quality focused services on projects to ensure client satisfaction and repeat business
* Participate in a yearly management meeting to develop and contribute to strategic business planning and to set personal KPI’s relevant to your role
* Report to the Director on your performance and the performance of the team as directed
* Attend meetings with clients to manage projects according to Inhabits scope of services
* Provide training and mentoring to the team as the need arises always promoting inclusion and growth for all staff under your leadership
* Prepare project proposals including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines and report these bids / wins / losses to the Director
* Maintain regular contact with existing or prospective clients for establishing potential future work
* Active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions to enhance the professional image of Inhabit
* Assist the Director with staff performance reviews
* Carry out research on potential materials and share knowledge and update technical library
* Keep up to date with relevant design software and products new to the market that will help develop our business
* Maintain an intimate knowledge of relevant codes and standards
* Continually strive to improve technical knowledge and encourage team technical discussions
* Evaluate opportunities for improved efficiencies and effectiveness in consultation with the Director including identifying, developing and implementing standards, systems, tools and processes to support improvement within the business
* Take an active interest in the other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc.) to further develop your specialist skills



**Project Operation/ Management**




 You shall be responsible for profitable completion of all projects and tasks under your control whilst maintaining excellent technical standards and client satisfaction. Detailed responsibilities and/or targets include:
   

  




* Assist in the management of the project team in terms of time and cost
* Cost planning and outputs required to meet project budgets
* Business Development and marketing material preparation
* Managing clients to secure work, marketing and fee proposals
* Updating of the administrative systems for recording proposal activities
* Allocation and management of time to suit programs and project budgets
* Ensure projects are completed on\-time and without cost overrun
* Ensure high technical standing on the project such that client complaints do not arise.



**Strategic Management**




 The Associate Director will contribute to short and long\-term regional planning and assist in driving forward the strategy that embodies Inhabit’s values, vision, mission and objectives to successfully grow the business including:
   

  




* Assist in developing the regional business plan aligned to Inhabit strategic plan to be approved by the Regional Manager. Assist in setting regional objectives and in preparing and implementing strategies to achieve the business plan. Ensure staff are well informed and up to date on developments that affect them
* Assist in undertaking regional future workforce planning and projects with an emphasis on growth and innovation.



**Financial Management**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the proper financial management including:
   

  





  

  




* Assist in the development and implementation of annual budgets and ensure that adequate internal control mechanisms are in place
* Monitor financial aspects of projects including monthly invoicing to ensure the accuracy and debtor collection
* Follow up with clients on overdue fees for debtors greater than 90 days
* Assist in reviewing and monitoring monthly financial reports
* Assisting in managing business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to signing (and following award of) any consulting commission



**Marketing and Business Development**




 The Associate Director shall actively participate in the marketing of the practice as a multi\-disciplined engineering company and shall achieve agreed targets in all aspects of practice development, including:
   

  




* Maximise cross\-selling opportunities for Inhabit and prepare project proposals to support profit targets including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc)
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Raise any challenges in competitive pricing across the region with the Regional Manager and propose solutions
* Build and expand the client base of Inhabit based on both established, prospective and new client relationships that you secure in the region
* Network within the Industry to develop industry intelligence, define and implement strategies to meet any challenges
* Ensure active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions, networking events, conferences, seminars, committees etc. to enhance the professional image of both the Associate Director and Inhabit



**Staff Management, Mentoring and Training**




 The Associate Director is responsible for ensuring staff are managed and supported effectively including:
   

  




* Encourage and role model respectful, supportive and positive engagement and interactions across disciplines/support functions and all other Inhabit offices to support positive culture and drive engagement
* Identify the deliverables, tasks and activities required for workload throughout all phases of the project to ensure adequate staff resourcing and tools are available to meet project deliverables and expectations
* Recruitment activities (with prior approval from the Regional Manager and Regional Director, Australia and New Zealand) in accordance with company procedures
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, mentoring and support and build and oversee staff technical development to maintain standards and to operate efficiently
* Ensure staff are following Inhabit’s quality management system
* Hold regular meetings with the Technical Team to discuss scheduling of work in a planned manner including distribution of workload, resources etc. to meet deliverables
* Assist in setting objectives and standards for the expected performance of staff and encourage regular feedback discussions on project successes and challenges to capture lessons learned
* Assist in conducting regular and effective Performance Reviews in accordance within Inhabits’ review system for your direct reports and provide ongoing/regular feedback to foster work performance improvements and promote professional growth of staff
* Identify training needs of the team to increase their skill level, development and growth
* Identify training opportunities, both internally and externally including seminars, events, conferences, talks, university lectures, factory visits, construction phase training etc., to assist with the development of the team and to address any knowledge and skill gaps. Support staff writing technical notes from these training opportunities and/or project experiences
* Encourage and promote Inhabit online materials, technical notes, technical library
* Communicate regularly and proactively with Senior Management as required to assist the process of managing your work/lifestyle balance and of your team
* Ensure staff adhere to and are familiar with all Health and Safety requirements and safe work practices



**Client Management**




 The Associate Director shall continually strengthen client loyalty and gain repeat business by ensuring high quality service and creative (‘Leading Edge’) solutions to clients by way of:
   

  




* Communicate with clients to establish their needs and maintain a dialogue throughout the project
* Monitor feedback from clients and develop and implement action plans for continuous improvement
* Identify and implement ways to enhance current service offerings, systems and processes from a client and business perspective to maximise Inhabit’s competitive advantage
* Identify and implement ways to enhance internal systems, processes and procedures to improve client satisfaction
* Be a role model for exceptional favourable record in client response to timeliness, quality of work and high technical standing on projects and manage in conjunction with Project Director/Leader any client complaints
* Continually aim for repeat and new business from all clients in contact with Inhabit



**Project Management**




 The Associate Director will provide leadership to ensure the efficient and profitable completion of all tasks and projects under their control whilst ensuring the allocation of adequate resources, excellent technical standards and client satisfaction including:
   

  




* Provide overall strategy and technical solutions as required for project challenges
* Undertake or assist the project leaders with negotiation of fees and contracts where appropriate to ensure financial targets are achieved
* Manage business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to the signing contracts
* Allocate and manage project personnel to suit programs and project budgets
* Project lead internally with respective team colleagues to allow deliverables to be issued to client
* Coordinate and work with the design team to deliver project deliverables
* Help solve client/project team’s problems by lateral thinking and creating innovative solutions
* Ensure quality outputs and agreed cost/scheduled delivery time frames are met
* Manage projects, site meetings, design workshops and site inspection as required and/or as project planning stipulates
* As Project Leader, monitor and report on team performance against agreed timelines, and fees/budgets
* Oversee the work of Sub Consultants/Contractors and review outputs produced by them
* Ensure project sheets for each project are undertaken for compliance with project and office QA procedures



**Consultancy Function**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the consultancy functions including:
   

  




* Preparation and coordination of expressions of interest, tender submissions and similar consulting proposals
* Maintain a hands\-on approach to the provision of design and engineering, and assist in the co\-ordination of other consultancy inputs in relation to BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS on an as needs basis
* Contribute and monitor the design and engineering of curtain wall and cladding systems, as well as specialty systems (i.e., structural glass, cables, ETFE etc.)
* Oversee engineering computations and structural façade analysis, advice and reporting
* Meet with architects to develop façade design concepts, detailing, specifications, and engineering feasibility and coordinate with other project consultants such as Builders, Contractors and Sub Contractors to determine best practice façade design outcomes
* Write and review specifications and schedules to inform and respond to site and construction related queries
* Review and comment on sub\-contractor’s shop drawings \& calculations, BD submission drawings, fabrication drawings \& material submission
* Follow the general drawing protocols and cad file system set by Inhabit
* Provide assistance during construction of façade systems including attendance mock\-up testing, shop drawing reviews and conduct factory \& site inspections



**Technical Excellence**




 The Associate Director shall assume full responsibility for work quality undertaken and ensure quality is adhered to by performing regular checks of your direct reports work and a senior peer review role on projects, including:
   

  




* Ensure project specific technical duties including engineering, design and project lead roles are effectively managed
* Identification of technically complex projects and problems that require high level input
* Undertake provision of concept design, peer review and checking services on projects to assist in maintaining high standards
* Provide technical assistance and grow the team’s capability relating to the weatherproofing and installation of various façade systems

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

data.jd_text:
As the Director of Technical Services, you will be responsible for the strategy and execution of technical services by employees of the Services Department in various FreeBalance Customer locations throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Key to this position is the ability to supervise and provide technical advice to the Vice President of Global Services department who oversees all FreeBalance customer project implementations worldwide. Responsibilities include building technical strategies, models, and approaches with team members operating out of the Headquarters of FreeBalance in Ottawa and ensuring its implementation and execution with all FreeBalance Technical Consultants overseas. This position is part of the Services Leadership team that works with the Solution Team in Ottawa and overseas (mainly in the EMEA region) alongside the individual project managers who manage the entire lifecycle of the implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite that addresses the Public Financial Management reform that FreeBalance customers undertake and implement.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Preparation of strategies and design for data migration that can be implemented by the FreeBalance Technical Consultants at a client location.
* Build tools and models for the Installation and Deployment of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite that can be leveraged for project deliveries.
* Collaborate with the Research and Development Team to design the interface components during the implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite.
* Collaborate with the Technical and Functional Consultants to create the training curriculum that can be delivered to the customers.
* Manage the day\-to\-day tasks of the team.
* Work with the Project Managers to design the rollout of the system for decentralized operations.
* Managing the Operations \& maintenance team in EMEA and provide management oversight to the remote team worldwide.
* Manage the technical tools and research and develop new tools for use by the Technical Consultants.
* Build scalable models for implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite at the Data Centre and Disaster Recovery Sites where the software is hosted.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure consistency, quality and timeliness of customer deliveries, internal policies and communications.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Extensive travel is required


**Qualifications**
* University degree in Information Technology.
* Proven experience reviewing and developing Support and Maintenance policies and procedures.
* 5 years of experience successfully managing an internationally dispersed Services and Support Team
* Project Management experience a must
* Ability to clearly articulate at meetings with all levels of management and stakeholders.
* Experience with goal\-setting frameworks like Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).
* Experienced in working with open\-source software components such as Tomcat, BIRT and commercial middleware such as MS SQL and Oracle databases with Windows Operating Systems
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Able to travel internationally.
* PMI Certification
* Other IT certifications


 We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. FreeBalance is an inclusive employer dedicated to building a diverse workforce to increase the representation of the designated groups based on each country’s legislation. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective labour law throughout all stages of the recruitment process.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.jd_text:
**Position: Procurement Manager / Assistant Procurement Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Nad Al Hammar, Dubai, UAE
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time (Head Office in Dubai)
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Direct Procurement** 



* Source and procure fragrance oils, alcohol, chemicals, and production raw materials.
* Manage sourcing of packaging materials including bottles, caps, pumps, labels, cartons, gift boxes, and display packaging.
* Develop and maintain relationships with local and international suppliers.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, contracts, and delivery schedules.
* Identify alternative suppliers and implement cost\-saving initiatives.



**Supply Chain \& Planning** 



* Prepare procurement plans based on sales forecasts, production schedules, and retail replenishment requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and maintain optimal stock to avoid shortages or excess inventory.
* Coordinate closely with Production, Warehouse, Sales, Retail Operations, R\&D, and Finance teams.



**Import \& Export Logistics** 



* Manage international shipments from purchase order to final delivery.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, and customs brokers.
* Handle import/export documentation including commercial invoices, packing lists, Bills of Lading, Air Waybills, Certificates of Origin, and customs clearance requirements.
* Optimize freight costs and ensure timely deliveries.



**Indirect Procurement** 




 Manage procurement for:
 


* Office stationery and general office supplies
* IT equipment, POS systems, and accessories
* Warehouse and facility consumables
* Maintenance and service contracts
* Retail operational supplies
* Corporate gifts and promotional merchandise



**Marketing \& Visual Merchandising Support** 




 Support the Marketing and Retail teams by sourcing:
 


* Visual Merchandising (VM) materials
* POS displays and window displays
* Exhibition and event booths
* Promotional items and giveaways
* Shopping bags, gift boxes, and packaging
* Marketing collateral and branded materials



 Ensure timely procurement for:
 


* Product launches
* Retail campaigns
* Brand activations
* Trade exhibitions
* Corporate events



**Supplier \& Contract Management** 



* Evaluate supplier performance based on quality, cost, delivery, and service.
* Maintain supplier contracts and procurement records.
* Conduct periodic supplier reviews and identify opportunities for improvement.



**Cost \& Compliance** 



* Drive procurement cost savings without compromising quality.
* Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and approval processes.
* Support inventory audits and procurement reporting.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field.
* Minimum
 **7 years** 
 of relevant procurement experience, with at least
 **3 years in a managerial role** 
 handling a team
* Experience in
 **perfume, cosmetics, personal care, manufacturing** 
 is highly preferred.
* Proven experience in sourcing fragrance oils, packaging materials, and managing import/export logistics.
* Hands\-on experience in demand planning and inventory management.
* Experience handling indirect procurement, including office, IT, and marketing purchases.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and supplier management skills.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, or similar) and advanced Microsoft Excel.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Knowledge of international sourcing and Incoterms.
* Experience managing freight and customs clearance.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-site retail and manufacturing environment.

data.jd_text:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The People Team at Agoda is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent from across the globe. We work to create an inclusive, high\-performing, and engaging environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and do their best work. Through a strong focus on people experience, service quality, and business partnership, we help Agoda scale while preserving what makes our culture distinctive.
   

  

 Within the People Team, the
 **People Experience and Services** 
 function is responsible for designing and delivering critical people experiences, services, and operating foundations that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle. This includes enabling smooth onboarding and mobility experiences, delivering effective workplace and office services, and ensuring employees have access to timely, trusted, and high\-quality support when they need it.
   

  

 At the center of this model sits
 **People Services \& Help Desk** 
 — Agoda’s front door for People support — supported by specialist service teams such as
 **People Relations Services** 
 . Together, these teams play a critical role in how employees and managers experience the People function day to day: through clear guidance, responsive support, effective issue resolution, and trusted handling of sensitive people matters.
   

  

**Opportunity**
 We are looking for an
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 to lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People service delivery model across
 **People Help Desk / Tier 1 support** 
 ,
 **Tier 0 / self\-service foundations** 
 , and
 **Global People Relations Services** 
 .
   

  

 This is a key leadership role within People Experience and Services, responsible for shaping how employees and managers access support across a wide range of People topics — from day\-to\-day HR questions and lifecycle support to more complex and sensitive employee matters requiring specialist intervention.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for:
   

  

* People Help Desk / Tier 1 services
* Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge foundations
* Global People Relations Services, including case governance and specialist support for complex employee relations matters


 You will own the effectiveness of Agoda’s People support model from the employee and manager perspective, ensuring it is clear, trusted, scalable, and increasingly insight\-driven. This includes strengthening service standards, improving routing and handoffs across teams, enabling greater self\-service, and ensuring sensitive employee matters are handled with appropriate quality, consistency, and governance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a leader who combines strong service delivery and operational leadership with sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to build a modern, scalable People support model in a global, fast\-moving organization.
   

  

 This position is based in
 **Bangkok** 
 . Agoda provides relocation support for successful candidates who are not currently located in Bangkok. Please note that we are
 **not open to remote work** 
 or the possibility of being based in other locations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Lead Agoda’s People Services front door and employee support model**
* Lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People Services model across Tier 1 Help Desk support, Tier 0 self\-service, and the interface into specialist support teams.
* Define and evolve how employees and managers access support across People topics, ensuring a clear, seamless, and trusted experience.
* Establish strong service principles, operating rhythms, and leadership across the teams responsible for day\-to\-day People support and complex employee issue resolution.
* Ensure Agoda’s People support model scales effectively with organizational growth, complexity, and global reach.


**Lead the People Services \& Help Desk team**
* Lead, manage, and develop the People Services \& Help Desk team to deliver high\-quality, consistent, and empathetic Tier 1 support across core HR topics such as policies, processes, employee data, benefits, onboarding, leaves, mobility, and general employee lifecycle support.
* Set service standards, KPIs, quality expectations, and operating controls to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant case handling.
* Build a strong service culture with clear accountability for employee experience, right\-first\-time resolution, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and prioritization across service demand, seasonal peaks, and new People initiatives.


**Lead Global People Relations Services**
* Lead the Global People Relations Services team, ensuring high\-quality and well\-governed support across complex employee matters such as performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, involuntary exits, and employee matters arising from organizational change.
* Ensure clear service ownership, escalation pathways, and governance across People Relations case handling.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure people relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, pragmatically, and in line with internal policies and local legal requirements.
* Drive high standards in case management, documentation, risk identification, and decision quality across the People Relations team.
* Use case trends and themes to inform improvements in manager guidance, policy design, service processes, and broader practices.


**Own the operating interfaces across Tier 1, People Relations, and specialist teams**
* Serve as the senior operational owner for how work flows between Help Desk / Tier 1, People Relations Services, and other Tier 2 / specialist teams across the People organization.
* Define and continuously improve routing logic, escalation models, intake criteria, handoffs, service ownership, and resolution pathways.
* Ensure employees and managers experience a joined\-up service model even when multiple People teams are involved.
* Clarify roles and interfaces across Help Desk, People Relations, Payroll, Rewards, Mobility, People Partners, CoEs, and other specialist teams.


**Build Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge management foundations**
* Develop and execute Agoda’s roadmap for Tier 0 / self\-service, moving the organization toward more proactive, intuitive, and self\-directed resolution of common People queries.
* Own and strengthen the People knowledge ecosystem, including FAQs, help content, decision trees, agent guidance, and employee\-facing support materials.
* Partner with policy owners and People SMEs to simplify complex topics into clear, scalable, and user\-friendly content.
* Drive case deflection, knowledge reuse, content governance, and self\-service adoption through disciplined measurement and continuous improvement.


**Enable digital, conversational, and AI\-supported service delivery**
* Partner with Product, Tech, Systems, and Data teams to improve People support platforms, workflows, and user journeys across self\-service and case management.
* Identify and help shape practical use cases for conversational and agentic AI within People Services, ensuring they enhance employee experience and complement human support.
* Provide leadership input into the design, testing, rollout, and continuous refinement of AI\-enabled and digital service solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls, privacy, escalation paths, and trust mechanisms are in place for all digital and AI\-supported support channels.


**Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement**
* Monitor and improve key service performance metrics across Help Desk and People Relations Services, such as case volume, first contact resolution, time to resolution, service quality, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, re\-open rates, and self\-service deflection.
* Lead ongoing improvements in workflows, playbooks, standard responses, training, quality assurance, and reporting.
* Partner with People Service Excellence and other stakeholders to simplify processes, remove friction, and improve end\-to\-end employee and manager experiences.
* Ensure effective controls, compliance, documentation standards, and data privacy practices are embedded across service operations.


**Lead through insight, stakeholder partnership, and change**
* Act as the senior People Services contact for service performance, priorities, risks, and transformation opportunities.
* Provide regular insight and reporting to People leaders on service trends, root causes, organizational pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Communications and relevant People teams to coordinate messaging around policy changes, process updates, and new tools or services.
* Support broader People transformation by bringing an employee\-service lens to operating model design, simplification, and capability building across the function.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Operations, Law, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience across HR shared services, employee services, People operations, employee relations, HRBP, service delivery, or related functions, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and/or multiple service teams in a complex, matrixed, and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience running a service or support function with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, service design, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tier service delivery models, including Tier 0 / self\-service, Tier 1 support, and specialist / Tier 2 case management.
* Meaningful exposure to employee relations or complex people issue resolution, with sound judgment on sensitive matters and a strong appreciation for governance, risk, and consistency.
* Strong skills in service design, operating model improvement, process improvement, and cross\-functional workflow design.
* Experience with HR technology platforms and service tools such as HRIS, case management systems, knowledge bases, and digital support tools.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify themes and root causes, and drive prioritization and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across leaders, specialist teams, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching leaders and managers, building team capability, and creating a high\-performance, service\-oriented culture.
* Comfort operating in a global, evolving, and ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for execution, improvement, and scale.


**It’s great if you also have**
* Experience in a global or regional HR shared services / People services environment.
* Experience leading both broad employee support teams and specialist employee relations or case management teams.
* Experience in knowledge management, service content strategy, and self\-service adoption.
* Hands\-on exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or workflow automation in HR or customer support environments.
* Experience improving employee experience through service redesign, process simplification, or digital product thinking.
* Experience in a high\-growth tech, internet, or digital business.
* Familiarity with global organizations operating across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.


**Why this role matters**
 This role is a unique opportunity to shape how Agoda employees and managers experience People support at scale. From everyday HR queries to more complex and sensitive employee matters, the teams in this scope play an important role in making sure our people feel supported, informed, and able to navigate key moments in their Agoda journey with confidence.
   

  

 As
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 , you will help build a more connected, scalable, and future\-ready support model, improving service quality, strengthening self\-service, and ensuring complex cases are handled with care and consistency. Your work will directly influence employee experience, manager effectiveness, and how the People function continues to evolve as Agoda grows globally.

data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure
* Federated model coordination strategies, including coordination sequencing, trade\-specific clash priorities, and progressive coordination approaches
* 4D scheduling integration (Navisworks Timeliner, Synchro) for construction sequencing visualization
* Understanding of data center monitoring systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS) and BIM coordination with operational systems
* Experience supporting construction phase information delivery and commissioning coordination
* Mentoring capabilities with experience guiding junior BIM coordinators and modelers
* Project management skills including planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast\-paced environments while maintaining quality standards


**What We Offer**
* Clear career progression with increasing leadership responsibilities as the department and BIM maturity expand
* Exposure to diverse mission critical projects across EMEA, working with leading hyperscaler operators and regional data center developers
* Direct reporting to Head of Mission Critical with significant autonomy to shape BIM processes, standards, and digital design delivery
* Hands\-on involvement with cutting\-edge data center projects including campus\-scale developments, high\-density AI infrastructure, and liquid cooling implementations
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
* Professional development opportunities including training, industry conferences, and certifications

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Vice President – Digital Engineering** 
 within the
 **Information Technology Department** 
 at Dubai Holding Corporate. The role holder is responsible for defining and executing the Group\-wide Digital Engineering and Platform Strategy, with direct accountability for the design, build, and scaling of enterprise technology capabilities across AI, ERP platforms, Integration Services, Digital Products, and Service Orchestration.
 



  





 The role ensures that enterprise technology platforms are strategically aligned with Dubai Holding’s business priorities, enabling scalable growth, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer experiences. A key focus is the governance and execution of integrated product and platform roadmaps across these domains to drive long\-term value creation.
 



  





 The role acts as a strategic partner to the Group CTO and business leadership, translating technology strategy into integrated, platform\-driven capabilities that accelerate growth, efficiency, and enterprise value.
 



  





**Role Relationships:** 




  




* Group CTO, Group and Vertical Technology Teams, Strategy \& Value Creation, Business Verticals, Technology Vendors, System Integrators, Cloud \& Platform Providers
* 4\-5 Direct Reports



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Group Digital Engineering \& Platform Strategy** 




  




* Define and own the enterprise\-wide Digital Engineering strategy aligned to Group and vertical priorities
* Establish strategic direction across core domains: AI \& Data Platforms, ERP \& Enterprise Systems, Integration \& APIs, Digital Products, Service Orchestration
* Drive platform consolidation, standardisation, and reuse across business units
* Translate business priorities into coherent cross\-domain platform strategies



  





**Product Roadmap Ownership \& Strategic Alignment** 



* Own definition, governance, and execution of product and platform roadmaps
* Align technology investments with business value creation objectives
* Prioritise initiatives based on ROI, strategic importance, and enterprise impact
* Eliminate duplication and fragmentation through centralised roadmap governance



  





**AI \& Intelligent Platform Enablement** 




  




* Define and execute the Group AI strategy across enterprise platforms
* Identify and scale high\-value data and AI use cases (automation, personalisation, analytics)
* Establish AI platform capabilities including data foundations, model lifecycle, and MLOps
* Drive enterprise adoption of AI\-enabled services



  





**ERP \& Core Enterprise Platforms** 




  




* Own strategy, operation and transformation of ERP platforms (Oracle) and adjacent systems
* Lead consolidation, simplification, and standardisation across business entities in line with Enterprise Architectural patterns
* Ensure ERP technology\-stack supports scalable, integrated, and efficient business operations
* Review and align ERP roadmap with business capability needs



  





**Integration Services \& Enterprise Connectivity** 




  




* Define and lead Group\-wide integration strategy (APIs, middleware, event\-driven architecture)
* Build, operate and scale integration platforms (API gateways, iPaaS) (Informatica, Frends)
* Establish standardised integration patterns to eliminate complexity
* Enable seamless interoperability across enterprise and vertical systems



  





**Digital Products \& Services** 




  




* Lead strategy and delivery of Group IT digital product platforms
* Define product operating models, lifecycle management, and engineering frameworks
* Drive development of scalable, reusable digital services
* Align digital product outcomes with growth, engagement, and customer experience
* Evaluate, implement and scale blockchain and tokenisation platforms to support digital asset enablement, new business models, and ecosystem partnerships with Strategy \& Value Creation



  





**Service Orchestration \& Platform Operating Model** 




  




* Define and implement service orchestration capabilities (ServiceNow)
* Enable end\-to\-end service delivery across ERP, integration, and digital layers
* Establish frameworks to unify fragmented workflows and services
* Drive adoption of platform\-based operating models



  





**Engineering Excellence \& Delivery** 




  




* Establish best\-in\-class engineering practices (DevSecOps, CI/CD, agile delivery)
* Drive engineering quality, productivity, and scalability
* Lead complex transformation programmes across multiple entities
* Ensure delivery aligns with strategic priorities and roadmap commitment



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication** 




  




* Act as a trusted advisor to Group CTO and senior leadership across the Group
* Translate technology strategies into clear business outcomes
* Align stakeholders across technology, product, and business domains
* Provide executive\-level communication and reporting



  





**Vendor \& Partner Ecosystem** 




  




* Define and manage strategic partnerships (ERP, cloud, AI, platforms)
* Oversee system integrators and delivery partners
* Ensure vendor accountability, performance, and value realisation
* Continuously scout market for potential future technologies and partners to support the long\-term Group IT Strategy



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




  




* 12–15\+ years in large\-scale enterprise technology delivery and operations
* 8–10\+ years in senior leadership roles managing large engineering and product organisations
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation programmes
* Experience in complex, multi\-entity organisations (real\-estate, hospitality, construction or similar sectors preferred)



  





**Education/Professional Certification:** 









**Minimum requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field
* Master’s Degree (MBA or MSc) strongly preferred
* PMP / PRINCE2
* ITIL v4
* TOGAF or Enterprise Architecture certifications
* Agile / SAFe certifications
* 



**Technical Competencies:** 




  




* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Evolved organisational awareness and stakeholder management



  





 Deep expertise across:
 



  




* AI \& Data Platforms (Foundry, MS Fabric, MLOPs)
* ERP Systems (Oracle)
* Integration Architecture (APIs, middleware, event\-driven systems)
* Digital Product Platforms (Webflow/Acquia)
* Service orchestration and platform operating models (ServiceNow)
* Experience blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and tokenisation frameworks, including their integration into enterprise platforms and digital product ecosystems
* Strong knowledge of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, and DevSecOps
* Ability to define and execute multi\-domain enterprise platform strategies



  





**Behavioural Competencies:** 




  




* Strong executive presence and influence at C\-suite level
* Strategic thinking with strong execution capability
* Ability to operate in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills
* Results\-oriented with high accountability
* Proven ability to build and lead high\-performing teams



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.**

data.jd_text:
**Confidential Opportunity – Head of Risk (UAE Regulated Financial Services)** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced Head of Risk to join a growing regulated financial services organization in the UAE.
 



  





 This is a unique opportunity for a risk leader who enjoys building, shaping, and scaling risk functions within a fast\-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall risk management framework of the business while remaining closely involved in the operational execution of risk management activities.
 



 The role is subject to regulatory approval and fit\-and\-proper assessment by the relevant UAE regulatory authority. The successful candidate will serve as the designated Head of Risk and principal risk management officer for the organization
 



  





 Unlike larger financial institutions with extensive risk departments, this position requires a balance of strategic leadership and hands\-on execution. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating at Board and regulator level while also driving the day\-to\-day development and enhancement of the risk function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and continuously enhance the Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERM)
* Develop and maintain risk governance structures, policies, and reporting frameworks
* Establish and monitor risk appetite statements, risk registers, and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
* Lead enterprise\-wide risk assessments across operational, regulatory, technology, strategic, and emerging risks
* Prepare and present risk reporting to Executive Committees, Risk Committees, and Board\-level forums
* Act as the primary risk management contact for regulatory engagement and supervisory reviews
* Provide effective challenge and risk oversight across business functions
* Build and develop the Risk function in line with the organization's growth trajectory
* Support the development of a strong risk culture across the organization



  





**Required Experience** 



* 8\-15 years of progressive risk management experience within regulated financial services
* Experience leading or owning an Enterprise Risk Management Framework
* Strong understanding of risk governance, risk appetite, risk assessments, and Board reporting
* Experience within fintech, payments, banking, EMI, acquiring, issuing, lending, or other regulated financial services environments
* Demonstrated experience engaging with regulators, executive management, and governance committees
* Ability to operate effectively in a growth\-stage environment where strategic and operational responsibilities coexist



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 You will be a strong match if you have:
 


* Previously held a Head of Risk, Risk Director, Senior Risk Manager, or equivalent position within a regulated financial services environment
* Experience building or enhancing risk frameworks rather than simply maintaining mature structures
* The credibility and capability to satisfy regulatory fit\-and\-proper requirements for a Head of Risk appointment
* A pragmatic and commercial approach to risk management
* The willingness to remain involved in operational delivery while leading the strategic direction of the function


- 


**Please Note** 




 This role is best suited to candidates who enjoy combining strategic leadership with hands\-on execution. Individuals whose experience is limited to highly specialized risk functions within large organizations, or whose background is primarily audit, compliance advisory, assurance, or consulting without direct ownership of enterprise risk management, may find the scope and nature of this position less aligned to their experience.
 



 All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence

data.jd_text:
Are you ready to lead a busy Operations Control Centre that coordinates operational safety, efficiency and resilience across our network? At
 **SolitAir** 
 , we’re seeking an experienced and adaptable leader to establish and head the Integrated Operations Control Centre (IOCC). This role will set the strategy, build the team, and oversee integrated operational control functions that ensure safe, compliant and on\-time service delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
 As Head of IOCC, you will:
   

  

* Establish and operationally manage the IOCC, including staffing, processes, tools and performance metrics to deliver 24/7 operational control.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between flight operations, maintenance control, ground operations, cargo planning, safety, and regulatory liaison to resolve disruptions and maintain continuity.
* Drive problem solving for complex operational events by applying structured analysis, root cause identification, and timely corrective actions to minimise impact on safety and schedule.
* Develop flexible operating procedures and escalation frameworks to respond to dynamic operational conditions, including irregular operations, AOG events and severe weather.
* Implement and maintain integrated systems and dashboards that provide real\-time situational awareness and decision support for IOCC staff and senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, training requirements and process enhancements to reduce recurrence of operational disruptions.
* Ensure all IOCC activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements and company policies, and coordinate timely reporting to regulators and stakeholders as required.
* Provide clear, effective communication in English across internal teams and external partners during normal and contingency operations.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Experience: Proven background in airline or aviation operational control roles, with significant experience leading operational teams and managing irregular operations.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical capability and structured problem solving skills, able to lead investigations, define root causes and implement robust corrective actions.
* Flexibility: Demonstrated adaptability to changing priorities and operational pressures; comfortable leading a 24/7 function with variable hours and rapid decision\-making demands. This means you are likely to work over weekends and/or evenings as operational demands require.
* English: Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear reports, brief senior leadership and communicate effectively across diverse teams.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong people leadership skills, able to recruit, develop and motivate a high\-performing, inclusive team; confident at stakeholder engagement and crisis communication.
* Systems \& Data: Comfortable with operational control systems, real\-time dashboards and data\-driven decision making; experience with industry tools is desirable.
* Qualifications: Relevant degree or professional qualifications in aviation, operations management or related field preferred.


 At SolitAir, every role contributes to shaping the future of cargo aviation. We welcome applicants who bring practical experience, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to operational excellence. This is a gender neutral role and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for all candidates.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* An inclusive workplace with opportunities for professional growth and development.
* The chance to build and lead a new, and growing, high\-impact operational function at the heart of our business.
* A role that offers visibility and cross functional problem solving \- at SolitAir you'll be able to see the difference you make to the success of our business


 If you are an experienced operational leader with strong problem solving skills, flexibility and excellent English communication, we encourage you to apply and help shape SolitAir’s operational future.

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
 



  





 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
 



  





***Roles and Responsibilities***




  





**Executive Support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Proactively manage the Head's complex, high\-volume diary, scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones and senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Act as gatekeeper, triaging meeting requests, queries and issues, and redirecting them appropriately while ensuring matters are resolved effectively.
* Prepare agendas, attend meetings the Head is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and follow up with action owners to ensure timely completion.
* Attend meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head where appropriate, independently managing follow\-up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
* Prepare briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to support strategic and commercial decision\-making.
* Anticipate information needs and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams ahead of key meetings or decisions.



  





**Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation** 



* Arrange end\-to\-end complex travel, including multi\-destination international itineraries, transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
* Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction\-specific requirements.
* Provide strategic input into travel planning, combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
* Liaise with colleagues across offices and functions to ensure a joined\-up, firm\-wide approach that maximises the value of each trip.
* Manage last\-minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently.
* Prepare detailed post\-trip reports covering meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities and next steps, and ensure all follow\-up actions are diarised and progressed.



  





**Marketing \& Business Development Support** 



* Manage speaking engagements and thought\-leadership commitments, tracking deadlines, coordinating research, and drafting materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
* Arrange briefing meetings ahead of panels, speaking slots or publications to ensure the Head is fully prepared.
* Liaise with the Knowledge team and internal stakeholders to obtain research and background material, ensuring contributions are accurate and high quality.
* Register the Head for events and prepare comprehensive pre\-event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives.
* Work with the Head and Business Development teams to maintain up\-to\-date client target lists, tracking status and ensuring assigned actions are progressed.
* Provide regular status updates on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against objectives.



  





**Billing, Finance \& Expenses** 



* Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head's matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
* Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance, and issue final invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
* Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head.
* Oversee expense submissions, liaising directly with vendors to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where needed.
* Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget\-holder approval in line with firm policy.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding invoices and payments, keeping the Head and the Billing and Finance teams fully informed.



  





**Performance \& People Processes** 



* Support the Head throughout the performance review process, scheduling review meetings in line with firm\-wide deadlines.
* Prepare review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
* Monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
* Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head during discussions.
* Support completion of post\-meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, and maintain oversight of outstanding actions.
* Maintain close, regular communication with HR throughout the review cycle, confirming deadlines and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.



  





**CRM \& Relationship Management** 



* Maintain and update the Head's contacts and relationship data in InterAction, accurately recording activities, meetings and notes.
* Support the Head in managing effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers across jurisdictions.
* Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring they are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
* Ensure referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow\-up on agreed actions and opportunities.



  





**Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison** 



* Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and updating the Head regularly.
* Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations) to ensure strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of regional initiatives.
* Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings to keep all functions informed, aligned and engaged, agreeing deliverables and capturing activities, deadline changes and requirements for the Head's radar.
* Ensure key outputs feed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings.



  





**Person Specification** 



* Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or in a similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi\-time\-zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
* Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi\-destination itineraries, visas and short\-notice changes.
* Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparing draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
* Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
* Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
* Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to draft correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
* Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
* Professional, client\-focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior stakeholders and clients.
* Fluent written and spoken English.
