data.jd_text:
Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.
   

  

 CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022\.
   

  

 As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people \- your colleagues and our customers \- and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 Build and manage outbound Tele Sales unit engaging in multi\-product sales and proactive retention. Responsible to drive key customer life cycle activities of credit card customers which include growing Inorganic Portfolio (BT, COC, EPP, FPP) along with CLI’s, insurance products and supplementary cards.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities:**
* Responsible for managing large tele sales unit working on portfolio growth strategy via cross sales of products such as Balance Transfers, Cash on Call, Supplementary card, Insurance and credit shields, Easy payment plan, Full payment plan, Card limit increase, card activation, spend campaigns etc.
* Generating organic/inorganic spends and revenue per customer, proactive Retention of card cancellation and dormant cards.
* Maintaining productive Headcount, supervising training models, Quality assurance and complaint management.
* Handling customer life cycle, increasing the revenue and stickiness of portfolio, active participant in discussion of pricing, segmentation and forecasting activities.
* Handling first level complaints and retention activities on Credit card, NPS management and driving the team towards a higher score above market standards.
* Focusing on Core Cross sales, ensuring maximum conversion ratio whilst maintaining highest NPS and continue to mitigate customer attrition.
* Develop and implement strategies to arrest latent attrition to competition, proactively identify and implement opportunities as well to boost Cross Sell Numbers and generate incremental revenue.
* Work closely with channels including digital, contact center, product and marketing teams to drive inorganic bookings.
* Ensure adherence to the regulatory requirement of Consumer protection and other circulars issued by Central Bank.
* Extend full support in periodic audit and timely closure of all open points identified as an observation part of the audit review.
* Work closely with Client engagement team and other product managers to prepare an action plan as an outcome of the periodic customer complaint review.
* Work closely with other stakeholders (Credit, Operation, Risk etc.) to ensure credit strategy and risk management measures are performed.
* To ensure customer satisfaction \& timely resolution of customer complaints related to Cards business.
* Engagement – Assist all Cards business channels in various business functions ranging from selling balance build products including Contact Centre/DSA – training/process optimization/sales promotions etc.
* Accuracy\-Ensuing the team are updated with Product related information and are always available for customers.
* Communication\- Ensure the team are kept informed and trained on new product/process/system related changes and updates.
* Deliver\- Support Cards and Payments Head in seamless delivery of day\-to\-day Cards business activities.s while answering prospect customers’ inquiries and deepen existing customers’ relationships by Cross Selling and generating sales leads


 Requirements:
   

  

**Education And Experience**
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree
* Decision Management experience will be a plus
* Minimum 10 years of Banking experience with knowledge in Cards and portfolio management

data.jd_text:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 "At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our
 **Asset Management department** 
 would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Senior Associate** 
 in our office in
 **Dubai** 




 This role supports the ongoing oversight and development of a multi strategy investment platform, covering both third party fund selection and internally managed portfolios and strategies.
 



 The individual will be responsible for monitoring performance, analyzing portfolio positioning, assessing risk, contributing to portfolio construction and allocation decisions, and directly managing or co\-managing internal investment strategies.
 



 The role requires prior portfolio management or direct investment decision making experience, enabling the individual to interpret investment strategies, challenge assumptions, and contribute meaningfully to investment outcomes across the platform.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Investment Oversight and Performance Analysis** 



* Conduct detailed performance analysis and attribution across all funds on the platform shelf
* Assess consistency of returns relative to benchmarks and peers across equity, fixed income, multi asset, and alternative strategies
* Identify performance drivers and sources of risk at the fund and portfolio level
* Monitor ongoing alignment between fund positioning and stated mandates across the feeder fund universe



  





**Portfolio Management and Internal Strategies** 



* Support portfolio construction and strategic asset allocation decisions across the platform
* Contribute to tactical allocation discussions informed by macroeconomic and market developments
* Evaluate trade offs across asset classes, geographies, and strategies within the multi asset framework
* Manage or co manage internal portfolios and strategies, including shadow portfolios and proprietary funds
* Provide input into positioning for the target risk advisory models underpinning the platform
* Execute rebalancing and allocation changes as directed by the Head of Asset Management



  





**Risk and Style Monitoring** 



* Monitor volatility, drawdown, and factor exposures across the fund shelf and internal portfolios
* Identify style drift, unintended concentration risk, and deviations from stated mandates
* Assess portfolio balance and risk contribution at the strategy and aggregate level
* Provide forward looking risk insights to support allocation and oversight decisions



  





**Portfolio and Holdings Analysis** 



* Analyse holdings level data and allocation shifts across funds and internal portfolios
* Evaluate alignment between portfolio positioning and stated investment strategy over time
* Track changes in sector, geographic, and factor exposures across market cycles
* Contribute to due diligence by grounding analysis in security selection and bottom up positioning



  





**Manager Oversight and Engagement** 



* Engage with third party fund managers as a credible and informed investment counterpart
* Challenge portfolio positioning, strategy consistency, and investment decision making in manager interactions
* Prepare detailed questions and investment insights ahead of manager meetings and due diligence calls
* Assess quality and consistency of manager decision making over time and across market environments



  





**Platform Level Investment Intelligence** 



* Maintain and develop internal dashboards covering performance, risk, positioning, and cost analysis
* Evaluate share class efficiency, fee structures, and total cost of ownership across the fund shelf
* Support fund selection and comparative analysis across managers for new fund onboarding
* Contribute to the development of investment views, house positioning, and thematic research



  





**Governance, Reporting, and Regulatory Alignment** 



* Prepare investment committee materials, portfolio reviews, and board level reporting
* Maintain documentation and reporting aligned with SCA regulatory requirements and governance standards
* Support prospectus preparation, cell supplement reviews, and regulatory submissions where applicable
* Ensure all investment activity is documented in line with the governance framework



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




**Technical Skills** 



* Deep understanding of strategic and tactical asset allocation, portfolio construction, and risk budgeting
* Strong capability in performance attribution, factor analysis, and risk decomposition
* Ability to interpret holdings level data, exposure analysis, and portfolio analytics
* Proficiency in Bloomberg and similar investment platforms
* Advanced Excel required for financial modelling, performance tracking, and scenario analysis
* Python, SQL, or similar data tools preferred for automation and analytics



  





**Competencies** 



* Strong investment judgment and independent thinking with the ability to form and defend views
* Ability to engage with and challenge portfolio managers with credibility and substance
* Clear and structured articulation of investment views in both written and verbal form
* High ownership, accountability, and comfort operating in a lean, fast moving team
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex investment concepts into
 **accessible language**








**Experience Requirements** 



* 5 to 8 years of experience in asset management, institutional investing, or portfolio management
* Prior experience in portfolio management, co\-management, or direct investment decision making is essential
* Demonstrable experience across multi asset portfolios, fund selection platforms, or fund of funds structures
* Familiarity with UCITS, SICAV, or similar regulated fund structures is highly preferred
* Experience working with global custodians, fund administrators, and transfer agents is an advantage
* CFA Level III candidate preferred
* Relevant graduate degree in finance, economics, or a related discipline is an advantage



  





  





**Perks** 




 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 


* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
 We are the real estate subsidiary of a well\-established, diversified business group with interests across multiple industries in the GCC. Our business focuses on the development, ownership, and management of a diverse portfolio of residential, commercial, mixed\-use, and retail real estate assets. With capabilities spanning the full real estate lifecycle—from project development and construction to leasing, property management, and asset operations—we are committed to delivering high\-quality developments and creating long\-term value for our stakeholders.
   

  

 As we continue to expand our portfolio and strengthen our market presence, we are seeking an accomplished Finance Director to lead our finance function and play a pivotal role in shaping the company’s financial strategy and supporting sustainable growth.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Finance Director will provide overall financial leadership, governance, and strategic direction across the organization. Reporting to senior executive management, you will drive financial performance, capital efficiency, and disciplined investment decision\-making across a diversified real estate portfolio.
   

  

 You will oversee both development and operational real estate assets, ensuring strong financial control across project delivery, leasing operations, property management, and investment activities. This role requires a strong combination of strategic vision, technical finance expertise, and hands\-on leadership within a complex real estate environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Financial Strategy \& Leadership
   

  

* Lead financial planning, forecasting, and performance management across the business.
* Support executive leadership in evaluating investments, acquisitions, and development opportunities.
* Provide financial insights to drive profitability, capital efficiency, and long\-term value creation.


 Development \& Asset Finance
   

  

* Oversee financial management of development projects from acquisition through completion and stabilization.
* Manage project budgets, cash flows, escrow accounts, and contractor/consultant payments.
* Monitor financial performance across leasing, property management, and retail assets.


 Treasury \& Funding
   

  

* Manage liquidity, cash flow planning, and banking relationships.
* Lead negotiations for project finance, banking facilities, refinancing, and restructuring.


 Financial Planning \& Analysis
   

  

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning.
* Develop financial models and feasibility studies for new developments and investments.


 Commercial \& Investment Support
   

  

* Review and support negotiation of key commercial contracts and agreements.
* Provide financial input into investment structuring and strategic decision\-making.


 Governance \& Controls
   

  

* Ensure compliance with IFRS and internal control frameworks.
* Oversee audits, statutory reporting, and financial governance processes.
* Strengthen financial policies, systems, and controls across the organization.


 Leadership \& Team Development
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing finance team.
* Build strong finance capability across development and operational business units.
* Foster a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CMA) preferred.
* 15\+ years of progressive finance experience, ideally within real estate development and asset management.
* Strong experience in development finance, including project cash flows, escrow structures, and contractor payment processes.
* Strong financial modelling, feasibility analysis, and investment evaluation skills.
* Experience across both development and operational real estate portfolios, including leasing, property management, and retail assets.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in contract review and investment decision support.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 Join a leading real estate company within a diversified group, where you will play a key role in shaping financial strategy, enabling major developments, and driving long\-term value creation across a growing portfolio.
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://www.qureos.com/ Job Function: Finance Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: IT Services and IT Consulting

**Role Overview** 




 The Regional Real Estate Portfolio Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing the Client’s real estate portfolio across the Middle East region. This role ensures strong commercial oversight, governance, and relationship management with landlords and stakeholders while adapting leasing strategies to regional market dynamics, regulatory frameworks, and cultural considerations.
 



 The role requires fluency in Arabic and English to effectively manage negotiations, documentation, and stakeholder engagement across diverse Middle Eastern markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Lease Portfolio Oversight:
 


* Manage and maintain an accurate portfolio of lease agreements across multiple Middle Eastern jurisdictions.
* Monitor lease compliance, key terms, and obligations in line with local property laws and practices.
* Provide structured portfolio reporting including rent levels, tenancy terms, and occupancy metrics.



 Invoice and Financial Validation:
 


* Review and validate lease\-related invoices from landlords or property managers.
* Investigate billing discrepancies and coordinate with landlords to ensure corrections are implemented.
* Ensure alignment with agreed commercial terms and local tax considerations (e.g., VAT variations across GCC countries).



*Note: The role does not include authority to process or execute payments.* 




 Critical Date \& Lease Event Management:
 


* Track and manage critical lease dates (renewals, break options, expiries, rent reviews).
* Provide proactive alerts and strategic recommendations to support occupancy and cost decisions.
* Deliver periodic (quarterly) portfolio reviews with regional stakeholders.



 Lease Administration \& Transaction Support:
 


* Coordinate administrative processes related to lease lifecycle events (new leases, amendments, renewals).
* Gather required documentation for internal approvals in line with governance processes.
* Support site acquisition activities where needed, in collaboration with internal teams and external brokers.



 Lease Renewal \& Renegotiations:
 


* Lead lease renewal negotiations with landlords following internal alignment on commercial strategy.
* Benchmark market rental values across key Middle Eastern cities to support decision\-making.
* Negotiate improved commercial terms in response to market conditions, supply\-demand dynamics, or operational needs.
* Provide advisory input on lease terms, considering regional legal frameworks and customary practices.



 Site Exit and Lease Termination Management:
 


* Manage lease exits including notice coordination, landlord engagement, and exit negotiations.
* Coordinate pre\-handover inspections and assess reinstatement obligations in line with lease terms.
* Negotiate exit conditions to minimize financial and operational exposure.



*Note: Execution of physical reinstatement works is outside the scope.* 




 Stakeholder and Relationship Management:
 


* Act as the primary interface with landlords, property managers, and external advisors across the region.
* Support internal stakeholders (finance, legal, operations) on real estate matters.
* Facilitate resolution of disputes, claims, or legal matters in collaboration with internal and external counsel.
* Maintain culturally appropriate and effective communication across diverse markets.
* Build relationships in a relationship\-driven business culture where trust and local presence are critical.



 Facilities Management Coordination:
 


* Manage the contractual side of FM service providers, in coordination with local stakeholders
* Participate in / Animate QBR with key FM service providers
* Suggest action plans when service level deviates from expectations
* Liaise with local teams to gather quality indicators



 Ad hoc Support:
 


* Additional support may be required across the Otis account, if necessary.



  





**Skills \& Experience** 




  





**Essential** 



* Fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken).
* Proven experience in commercial real estate portfolio or lease management (multi\-country preferred).
* Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated ability to deliver commercial value.
* Understanding of Middle East real estate markets and leasing practices.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across different countries and cultures.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.



  





**Desirable** 



* Experience working across GCC countries or wider Middle East region.
* Familiarity with real estate legal frameworks in UAE and neighbouring countries.
* Experience in large corporate or multinational portfolio environments.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Commercial acumen
* Stakeholder management
* Negotiation and influencing
* Attention to detail
* Cultural awareness
* Problem\-solving



  





**Additional Notes** 



* The role requires occasional travel across the Middle East.
* The successful candidate must be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-jurisdictional environment.

data.jd_text:
**Managing Director, Coverage \& Origination** 




 Ladd \& Co. · Dubai · Full\-time
 



  





**Firm** 




 Ladd \& Co. is a private advisory firm advising entrepreneurs, principals, and multi\-generational families on mergers and acquisitions, capital placement, co\-investment, and international structuring. The firm operates across New York, Palm Beach, George Town, London, Zürich, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Sydney, serving ultra\-high\-net\-worth families, single and multi\-family offices, private holding companies, and institutional investors.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Ladd \& Co. is appointing a Managing Director in Dubai to originate and lead client relationships across the firm's advisory mandates. This is a senior coverage role: building and holding relationships with business owners, family offices, and institutional principals, and leading engagements from origination through to close alongside the firm's execution teams.
 



  





 You represent the firm at the senior table, source mandates, and stay close to clients through completion. Structuring, legal coordination, investor access, due diligence, and transaction execution are provided by the firm.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Originate advisory mandates across M\&A, capital placement, co\-investment, and international structuring
* Lead senior relationships with ultra\-high\-net\-worth families, family offices, founder\-led enterprises, and institutional investors in the Dubai market and adjacent jurisdictions
* Manage engagements from first meeting through to close, coordinating the firm's deal teams
* Represent the firm at the principal level in client and counterparty settings
* Maintain and grow referral relationships across legal, tax, and private banking professionals



  





**What You Will Bring** 



* 12 to 20 years of experience in M\&A advisory, capital placement, investment banking, private banking, or family\-office advisory at a credible institution
* Managing Director or equivalent standing, with a record of originating and leading senior engagements
* An established personal network of business owners, family offices, or senior referral professionals capable of generating institutional\-quality mandates
* Sound commercial judgment and the seniority to represent the firm independently
* Comfort operating within a performance\-based compensation structure



  





**Compensation** 




 This is a senior, performance\-based role. Compensation is structured around direct participation in the advisory fees on engagements you originate and lead, and is discussed in detail with qualified candidates. The structure is designed so that senior coverage professionals are compensated in line with the mandates they bring to the firm.
 



  





**Confidentiality** 




 All enquiries are treated in strict confidence. Ladd \& Co. considers all qualified candidates on the basis of experience and capability.

data.jd_text:
Independent Food Company is home to some of the region's most recognised hospitality concepts, including SALT, Somewhere, Parker's, Shalwa, Somewhere, and Public. We are a fast\-growing organisation with an expanding portfolio of concepts, an active acquisition strategy, and ambitious plans for growth across new and existing markets. As we scale, the quality of our people remains central to everything we build. That is where you come in.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 The Director of Real Estate is responsible for managing and expanding the organization’s retail property portfolio, including site selection, lease negotiations, budget analysis, and store openings across the UAE and franchisees. This role requires strategic leadership to develop and implement real estate strategies aligned with the company’s vision, while building strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensuring compliance with industry standards. The Director will lead a team and work closely with operations, project managers, and developers to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and achieve sustainable expansion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Planning and Market Analysis:** 




 • Conduct in\-depth market and competitive analysis to develop independent expansion plans, either in house or outsourced.
 



 • Prepare and submit annual business plans to the board, ensuring equal growth opportunities for all brands.
 



 • Create and implement real estate strategies tailored to each brand’s demographics, pricing, and product range.
 



 • Present brand market potential and expansion capacity for the next 3 years.
 



 • Conduct Real Estate Market Mapping and Sales Forecasting.
 



 • Develop and present detailed feasibility studies, including financial projections and market analysis, prior to obtaining site approvals
 



  





**Existing Portfolio Management, Renewals, and Crisis Resolution** 




 • Portfolio Oversight \& Performance Tracking: Proactively manage and monitor the performance of the existing real estate portfolio, conducting monthly reviews of asset performance, rent\-to\-sales ratios, and location viability.
 



 • Lease Renewals \& Restructuring: Oversee the end\-to\-end lease renewal pipeline, evaluating historical store performance to determine whether to renew, renegotiate terms, relocate, or exit properties.
 



 • Crisis Management \& Landlord Relations: Act as the primary point of escalation and resolution for property crises (e.g., operational disruptions, landlord\-tenant disputes, mall maintenance issues affecting sales, or unexpected economic downturns). Lead rent\-reduction or lease\-restructuring negotiations during operational crises to safeguard company margins.
 



  





**Site Selection and Management** 




 • Aggressive Location Scouting: Lead hands\-on, ground\-level field scouting and site mapping to uncover premium, off\-market, or high\-potential spaces (malls, high\-streets, cloud kitchens, and standalone spots) tailored to specific brand concepts.
 



 • Conduct comprehensive site assessments, traffic counts, visibility analyses, and accessibility mapping to guarantee optimum footfall and brand exposure.
 



 • Investigate, evaluate, and identify potential sites, markets, towns, and competition for new store locations.
 



 • Manage schedules for projects and oversee processes to obtain permits and approvals.
 



 • Prepare detailed project estimates and reports for management review.
 



  





**F\&B Project Development** 




 • Oversee the development of F\&B projects, including feasibility studies, design monitoring, and financial analyses.
 



 • Develop and implement strategies to expand and improve F\&B offerings in retail locations, aligning with company goals and market trends.
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align F\&B goals with overall business objectives.
 



 • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
 



 • Provide insights and guidance on food and beverage (F\&B) operations, including labor optimization, supply chain logistics, and customer service standards, to ensure successful project execution.
 



 • Ensure properties and real estate strategies aligned with delivering exceptional guest experiences, prioritizing innovation, quality, and service excellence
 



  





**Team Development and Risk Management** 




 • Recruit, manage, and develop a high\-performing team, including managers and supervisors, to build a reliable and effective department for market mapping and research.
 



 • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards in all property dealings. • Identify and mitigate risks, including regulatory and financial risks, through effective risk management strategies.
 



 • Foster a positive and collaborative team culture, aligned with the company’s core value
 



  





**Contractual \& Commercial Lease Terms Governance** 




 • Legal \& Commercial De\-risking: Direct the drafting, review, and structuring of all legal lease agreements, ensuring all commercial and operational terms protect the company's long\-term interests.
 



 • Clause Enforcement: Secure favorable legal clauses, including but not limited to: Exclusivity/Non compete protections within specific developments, clear termination and break\-clauses, realistic force majeure terms, and capped annual rent escalations.
 



  





**Landlord Negotiations \& Deal Structuring** 




 • Deal Sourcing \& Commercial Pitches: Lead high\-stakes commercial negotiations with major developers (e.g., Emaar, Nakheel, Majid Al Futtaim, Merex) and private landlords to secure highly competitive rates and preferential positioning.
 



 • Financial Terms Optimization: Strategically negotiate base rents, turnover rent percentages, rent\-free periods (fit\-out periods), key money, and landlord fit\-out contributions to maximize early\-stage ROI and reduce capital expenditure.
 



  





**Business Development and Relationship Management** 




 • Create, pitch, and build new leads with developers, investors, and local authorities.
 



 • Develop business and market plans for all brands acquired or franchised by the company.
 



 • Address stakeholder concerns and collaborate on approvals and permits.
 



 • Stay updated on industry trends, demographic shifts, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and recommend strategies for sustainable growth.
 



 • Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity by understanding local customs, preferences, and business practices in the Middle East, ensuring alignment with regional expectations
 



  





**Other Duties:** 




 Perform other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by management from time to time.

data.jd_text:
**Job Requisition ID:** 
 178944
   

  

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day
   

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
* The Head of Data Science \& Asset Risk holds a pivotal role within Al\-Futtaim's financial services division, responsible for overseeing analytics, forecasting, and risk intelligence. The key purpose is to optimize the company’s automotive and financial services portfolio using data\-driven insights. This role combines financial control, risk management, and analytics leadership to support executive and board\-level decision\-making. Key responsibilities include maintaining market indices and price curves, defining asset risk frameworks, providing risk\-driven inputs to capital planning, and acting as the technical authority on asset valuation and risk. Success is measured by the ability to turn data and AI into explainable, regulator\-ready financial outcomes and to influence strategic decisions that impact P\&L, balance sheet, and return on assets.The position operates at the intersection of CFO\-level financial control, CRO\-level risk management and CDO\-level analytics leadership, supporting executive and Board decision\-making across the group.


**What You Will Do:**
* Own end\-to\-end analytics, forecasting, and risk intelligence for the automotive and financial services portfolio.
* Turn data, AI, and market intelligence into financial outcomes that drive pricing, leasing, provisioning, capital allocation, and portfolio strategy.
* Maintain authoritative market indices, price curves, and forward\-looking scenarios for all brands, powertrains, and segments.
* Define and enforce the Asset Risk Framework covering market risk, EV transition risk, concentration risk, and volatility.
* Provide risk\-driven inputs to IFRS9, provisions, ECL, and capital planning.
* Ensure all models are auditable, explainable, and regulator\-ready.
* Act as the single source of truth for portfolio value, forward price risk, stress scenarios, and financial impact of market movements.
* Chair the Residual Value \& Risk Committees and translate complex analytics into clear financial actions for CFO, CRO, and Executive Management.
* Influence vehicle pricing and lease structures, portfolio profitability and risk appetite, provisioning and capital allocation, OEM negotiations, and product launches.
* Own the AI\-driven asset intelligence platform including data pipelines, forecasting, valuation, and risk models.
* Lead a senior team of Data Scientists and Analytics specialists.


**Required Skills To Be Successful:**
* Advanced expertise in data science and statistical analysis.
* Proficient in risk management and financial modelling.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills for executive\-level reporting and committee participation.


**What Qualifies You For The Role:**
* 10\+ years of experience in statistics, data science, risk management, pricing, forecasting, or financial modelling.
* Experience in automotive, asset finance, banking, insurance, or management of large portfolios.
* Demonstrated ownership of models crucial to P\&L impact.
* Strong background in IFRS9, ECL, stress testing, or portfolio risk management.
* Comfortable operating at CFO, CRO, and board level interactions.


**About Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate**
 The real estate development and operations arm of Al\-Futtaim, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high\-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega\-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years.
   

  

 Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
   

  

 AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Malls**
 Al\-Futtaim Malls provides development and asset management expertise, specializing in building retail\-led super regional malls in prime locations across MENA and beyond. With a proven track record of creating both sustainable revenue growth and value enhancement for tenants, Al\-Futtaim Malls delivers exceptional experiences and exciting shopping environments for customers.
   

  

 Part of the Al\-Futtaim Group, Al\-Futtaim Malls leadership team brings more than 30 years of experience and a deep understanding and knowledge of the retail sector, both from a shopper’s point of view but as curators of space or landlords to other brands. The company has a directly managed portfolio including over 9 million sqft of retail space across four malls in the MENA region and two under development. Malls under the Al\-Futtaim Malls portfolio include Dubai Festival City Mall and Festival Plaza in the UAE, Cairo Festival City Mall in Egypt, Doha Festival City in Qatar and Zenata Mall, Morocco.
   

  

 Leveraging on the expertise of its parent company, Al\-Futtaim Malls established PLEX Management Services offering a full array of services including asset management and development, leasing, and brand experience expertise to shopping mall landlords and retail organizations globally. Implementing global best practice and deploying Al\-Futtaim Mall’s deep understanding of mall management and retail dynamics, PLEX promises to deliver continuous growth and long\-term value for its partners.
   

  

 For more information on Al\-Futtaim Malls, please visit https://www.al\-futtaimmalls.com/
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies**
 Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies offers customers complete engineering and systems integration solutions.
   

  

 The Engineering arm operates in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt providing a wide variety of products and services from air conditioning, scaffolding and access solutions, elevators and escalators, control and life safety, facilities management, building products, MEP, Energy Management, Technology Infrastructure and Digital Transformation.
   

  

 The Technologies division provides complete business solutions to large, medium and small customers that include, contact centre solutions, business applications, business intelligence, data management, advanced analytics amongst others. The IT infrastructure portfolio comprises IP telephony, ELV systems, networking solutions, professional audio\-visual solutions and managed services.
   

  

 These solutions are further complemented by services that include project management, installation, testing, commissioning and after\-sales maintenance contracts.

**Overview**
 This global portfolio operations team is seeking an experienced Executive Director to play a key leadership role within a rapidly growing investment platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for originating, evaluating, executing, and managing investments across multiple asset classes while contributing to portfolio strategy, capital allocation decisions, and overall business growth.
   

  

 Working closely with senior leadership, the Executive Director will lead transaction execution, manage stakeholder relationships, mentor investment professionals, and help shape the long\-term investment strategy of the platform.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Management**
* Support the development and execution of investment strategy across targeted sectors, geographies, and asset classes
* Identify investment themes, market trends, and emerging opportunities aligned with strategic objectives
* Provide recommendations on capital allocation, portfolio construction, and risk management
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend value creation initiatives


**Deal Origination \& Execution**
* Source and originate investment opportunities through established industry networks and strategic relationships
* Lead all stages of the investment process, including opportunity assessment, financial analysis, valuation, structuring, due diligence, negotiations, and execution
* Prepare investment memoranda and present recommendations to senior management and investment committees
* Coordinate with legal, tax, technical, commercial, and financial advisors throughout transaction processes


**Asset Management \& Value Creation**
* Work closely with portfolio companies, operating partners, and management teams to drive performance improvement and strategic initiatives
* Support business transformation, operational optimisation, growth strategies, and capital planning across investments
* Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and report on portfolio developments


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, financial institutions, advisors, developers, operators, and strategic partners
* Represent the organisation in negotiations, industry events, and key stakeholder meetings
* Mentor and develop junior investment professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with finance, legal, risk, treasury, and business leadership teams


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Ensure all investments adhere to internal governance frameworks, investment policies, and risk management standards
* Present investment opportunities and portfolio updates to governance committees and senior leadership
* Maintain high standards of compliance, transparency, and fiduciary responsibility


**Skills \& Experience**
**Essential Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Real Estate, or related discipline
* 12\-18\+ years of relevant experience in private equity, sovereign wealth funds, investment management, principal investing, infrastructure, real estate, private credit, or investment banking
* Demonstrated track record of leading complex transactions from origination through execution
* Strong financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, and investment analysis capabilities
* Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to investment committees and boards
* Excellent commercial judgement and strategic thinking skills
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing teams
* Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA, CFA, CAIA, or other relevant postgraduate qualification
* Experience investing across real estate, infrastructure, private equity, credit, or alternative investments
* Exposure to large\-scale investment platforms and institutional capital deployment
* Experience operating in international markets with strong understanding of regional investment dynamics
* Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities in a fast\-paced environment


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

 This position offers the opportunity to shape investment strategy and drive value creation across multiple asset classes within a rapidly growing platform. The role provides significant exposure to senior leadership, complex transaction execution, and the chance to mentor and develop investment professionals while contributing to long\-term strategic objectives.
   

  

**About Senna**
 Senna is a careers platform for professionals pursuing opportunities in private equity. The platform brings together relevant roles, market context, and hiring signals to help candidates navigate the market with greater clarity. For more information, visit joinsenna.com.

 **Finance Director**

 The successful candidate will combine strong financial stewardship with commercial acumen, providing insight\-driven leadership to support profitability, growth, and long\-term value creation.

**The Company** 




 The Mauritius Commercial Bank Ltd (MCB) is the leading financial institution in Mauritius and a key player in the African banking landscape. As part of the largest banking group in Mauritius (MCB Group) and with over 187 years of history, MCB has built a strong reputation for innovation, customer\-centric solutions, and financial stability.
 



  





 Under its Vision 2030 strategic plan, MCB is pursuing a deliberate strategy of focusing on specialized, high\-expertise niche segments across the African continent while also leveraging on its hubs in Nairobi, Johannesburg, Lagos, Paris and Dubai.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 As
 **Head of Digital Assets and Emerging Technologies** 
 , you will embark on a journey with our
 **Customer Experience \& Marketing SBU** 
 , where the shared ambition is to craft a brand that deeply resonates with its audiences, providing them with a simple, personalized, and meaningful experience.
 



  





 You will report directly to the Chief Customer Experience Officer (CXO) and will have direct accountability over two streams: (1\) the existing AI COE team, providing strategic direction and governance over the bank's artificial intelligence capabilities; and (2\) a new Digital Assets team, responsible for building the bank's position in virtual assets, custody, blockchain, stablecoins, and tokenisation.
 



  





 The role combines strategic vision with hands\-on execution authority, interfacing with the Board, regulators, leadership team, lines of business, strategic partners, and clients.
 



  





**📍Location: Mauritius (Preferred) \| Hybrid: Mauritius / Dubai** 




  





**The Role** 




 Enterprise Strategy \& Roadmap
 


* Define and continuously evolve the Emerging Technologies strategy and three\-year execution roadmap aligned to enterprise priorities, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.
* Build and manage a structured innovation pipeline: use\-case identification, prioritization, business cases, and scaling paths across lines of business.
* Establish clear value\-tracking for initiatives and report progress and portfolio KPIs to CXO/ governance forums.



  





 AI Leadership
 


* Provide strategic directions to the AI team: adoption across business lines, operating model, prioritized backlog, and delivery governance.
* Drive responsible AI by embedding risk, model governance, and regulatory readiness into AI solution design and deployment.
* Expand AI capabilities into high\-value domains and ensure solutions meet customer and business requirements.



  





 Digital Assets Leadership
 


* Create and scale the bank’s Digital Assets agenda including tokenization, custody, stablecoin\-related propositions, partnerships, and future\-fit solutions.
* Lead end\-to\-end product and solution development for Digital Asset services: target operating model, product architecture, ecosystem partner selection, and go\-to\-market coordination
* Monitor market and regulatory evolution and translate developments into actionable roadmap decisions.



  





 Governance, Risk, Compliance \& Regulatory Engagement (Portfolio\-wide)
 


* Embedded the governance framework for the Emerging Technologies portfolio: policies, controls, risk registers and compliance requirements.
* Serve as a senior point of contact with regulators for emerging technology matters; ensure regulatory inquiries, examinations, and responses are coordinated and defensible.
* Build/maintain procedures with Risk, Compliance, Legal, AML and Technology to ensure products and platforms meet internal and external obligations.



  





 Stakeholder, Board \& Ecosystem Leadership
 


* Orchestrate internal alignment across CXO, CIO/, SBU heads, and control functions to enable efficient execution and scaling of initiatives.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships (technology providers, fintechs, custodians, blockchain networks, universities/innovation ecosystems) and represent the bank in industry forums as required.
* Provide credible executive\-level communication to senior leaders/board committees on strategy, progress, risk posture, and investment trade\-offs.



  





 Budget, Operating Discipline \& Delivery Execution
 


* Develop and manage budget plans in alignment with the CXO for roadmap delivery, including investment cases and resourcing plans.
* Establish delivery governance: portfolio cadence, project/program controls, resourcing allocation, and corrective actions when needed.



  





 Organization \& Capability Building
 


* Build a high\-performing Emerging Technologies function: structure, role definitions, hiring plan, capability framework, and career paths across AI and Digital Assets.
* Attract specialist talent and embed knowledge transfer through coaching, learning pathways, and local bench\-strength development.



  





**The Profile** 




 Education:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as IT, engineering, or finance.
* A Master’s degree ideally in AI, IT, FinTech, or business/ strategy would be an advantage.



  





 Experience:
 


* 10 years of broad and deep experience in virtual assets, blockchain, stablecoins, and tokenisation.
* 3 years of managerial experience leading multi\-disciplinary teams and delivering strategic objectives.



  





 Domain exposure:
 


* Regulated financial services and emerging technologies (AI, digital assets/blockchain), including evidence of product delivery and governance in regulated environments.



  





***A combination of both qualifications \& experience will be considered.***




  





 Should this opportunity match your career aspirations, skills and competencies, click on ‘Apply’ to complete your online application.
 



  





 Please ensure all required information is accurately entered in relevant sections. Any incomplete application will not be considered. Kindly attach a complete CV when applying.
 



  





 As part of the recruitment process, candidates will be required to provide a valid Certificate of Character of less than 3 months and two professional references.
 



  





 The deadline for submission of application is
 **08 July 2026\.** 




  





***Management reserves the right not to appoint anyone following this advert.***

 PMO Governance and Methodology:
 


* Establish and maintain PMO policies, frameworks, and standards.
* Ensure consistent application of project management methodologies.
* Monitor compliance with governance requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement of PMO processes and tools.



 Portfolio Oversight and Control:
 


* Monitor project health, progress, and performance across the portfolio.
* Review project risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Oversee portfolio\-level change control processes.
* Provide guidance and support to project managers.



 Reporting and Executive Support:
 


* Consolidate portfolio reports and dashboards.
* Provide management with project performance insights and recommendations.
* Support governance boards and steering committees.
* Facilitate portfolio review meetings and decision\-making processes.



 Resource, Quality, and Vendor Management:
 


* Monitor resource allocation and capacity across projects.
* Conduct project reviews and quality assurance activities.
* Support project initiation, business cases, and scope development.
* Participate in vendor evaluation, selection, and performance oversight.


 Role Accountability
 
 HR Proficiency:
 


* Ability to recruit, recognize and cultivate high performers and expose them in order to create a robust second line of management.

* Ability to treat subordinates equally without any discrimination.
* Assessment criteria of subordinates is performance that leads to planned results.
* Ensure availability of delegation of authority matrix to have sufficient delegations as per company policy.



 Responsibility:
 


* Must take full responsibility for his operation as per the job description and the required deliverables from this position, taking into consideration the general company guidelines.
* Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them

**Role:** 
 PMO \& Portfolio Management Consultant
   

  

**Location:** 
 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is seeking a PMO \& Portfolio Management Consultant to support the planning, governance, coordination, and reporting of multiple security\-related projects for a large banking client in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 The role focuses on establishing and operating effective project and portfolio management practices across a complex environment involving multiple stakeholders, vendors, delivery teams, and business functions. Cybersecurity expertise is not required; however, experience managing technology, transformation, risk, compliance, or security\-related projects is an advantage.
   

  

 The successful candidate will help ensure that projects are delivered with clear governance, accurate reporting, effective risk and issue management, strong stakeholder coordination, and alignment to portfolio priorities, timelines, budgets, and expected outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Portfolio Management
   

  

  

- Support the management of a portfolio of security\-related projects by maintaining a consolidated view of project status, priorities, timelines, dependencies, risks, issues, budgets, and key decisions.

- Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards, executive reports, and management updates for client leadership and Accenture stakeholders.

- Track portfolio performance against agreed objectives, milestones, delivery plans, and expected benefits.

- Identify cross\-project dependencies, conflicts, capacity constraints, delivery risks, and escalation items.

- Support portfolio prioritization discussions by providing accurate project data, delivery insights, and impact analysis.

- Ensure portfolio governance forums are properly structured, documented, and supported with accurate materials.

 PMO Governance and Control
   

  

  

- Establish, enhance, and operate PMO processes, templates, reporting mechanisms, governance routines, and delivery standards.

- Maintain project plans, integrated master schedules, RAID logs, action trackers, decision logs, meeting minutes, dependency trackers, and status reports.

- Monitor project progress against scope, timeline, cost, quality, risks, and deliverables.

- Support project managers and workstream leads in maintaining consistent project management discipline.

- Ensure project documentation is complete, structured, version\-controlled, and aligned with client and Accenture expectations.

- Prepare materials for steering committees, working groups, executive updates, and project governance meetings.

 Stakeholder and Vendor Coordination
   

  

  

- Coordinate with client stakeholders, Accenture teams, third\-party vendors, technology teams, risk teams, compliance teams, and business representatives.

- Facilitate follow\-ups on actions, decisions, dependencies, and pending inputs across multiple parties.

- Support meeting preparation, agenda setting, minutes of meeting, and tracking of agreed actions.

- Help resolve coordination gaps between project teams and escalate unresolved issues through the appropriate governance channels.

- Maintain a professional consulting presence with senior stakeholders in a banking environment.

 Reporting and Executive Communication
   

  

  

- Prepare clear, concise, and executive\-ready reports covering portfolio health, project progress, key risks, issues, decisions required, milestones, and upcoming activities.

- Develop dashboards and presentation materials using PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI, or equivalent reporting platforms.

- Translate complex project information into structured management insights.

- Support leadership briefings, steering committee packs, and client governance presentations.

- Ensure reporting is fact\-based, consistent, and aligned with agreed PMO standards.

 Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management
   

  

  

- Maintain and monitor RAID logs across projects and the overall portfolio.

- Follow up with project owners and stakeholders to ensure timely closure of actions, risks, and issues.

- Identify early warning indicators that may impact delivery timelines, budget, scope, or quality.

- Support escalation of critical risks and unresolved blockers to the appropriate governance level.

- Track mitigation plans, owners, target dates, and progress updates.

**Qualifications**
- 3 to 7 years of experience in project management, PMO, portfolio management, program coordination, or management consulting.

- Experience working in banking, financial services, technology transformation, risk, compliance, operations, or security\-related programs is preferred.

- Strong understanding of project lifecycle management, governance, reporting, planning, risk management, issue management, and stakeholder coordination.

- Experience supporting large\-scale programs or portfolios involving multiple projects, vendors, and senior stakeholders.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced client environment.

- Strong experience preparing executive\-level reports, dashboards, and presentations.

- The ability of working on AI tools in order to build PMO tools

**Required Skills**
- Strong project management and PMO capabilities.

- Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

- Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills.

- Ability to create structured dashboards, trackers, plans, and executive reports.

- Good understanding of portfolio governance, project controls, RAID management, dependency management, and milestone tracking.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow up effectively.

- Ability to work with ambiguity and structure complex information.

- Professional consulting mindset and client\-facing presence.

- Fluency in English is required; Arabic is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.

- Professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, PMI\-PBA, Agile, Scrum Master, MSP, MoP, or P3O are preferred.

- Experience in banking or financial services environments in Saudi Arabia or the GCC.

- Experience with portfolio management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Clarity, ServiceNow SPM, Planview, Smartsheet, Power BI, or similar platforms.

- Prior experience in consulting or working with large enterprise clients is an advantage.

 As this is our North Star, we could build the highest\-value solution in the market and subsequently serve some of the top companies and renowned startups around the world along with multiple government programs.  The people working with us expect a lot from themselves and are interested in building solutions that change the way the industry works. They have strong ambitions to achieve exceptional success personally and professionally.
 




  






 Our team is performance\-driven and serious. And we would like to invite you to work with us and become a part of a growing company that has a credible brand name and enjoy an exceptional learning journey.

**Who We Are** 




 At BKN301, we build fintech solutions that enable banks, fintechs, and merchants to grow and innovate across emerging markets.
 



 We’re a London\-based financial technology group, with offices in Milan (Italy), Doha (Qatar), and San Marino, and an international footprint that’s rapidly expanding.
 



 Our teams bring together different backgrounds, perspectives, and expertise across multiple countries and markets. We move fast, think globally, and act as one team — transforming ideas into real, scalable fintech solutions every day.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 Joining BKN301 means becoming part of a fast\-growing international fintech, where technology and people evolve together.
 



 Here, every idea counts: you’ll have a tangible impact on strategic initiatives, work alongside experienced professionals across multiple markets, and contribute to projects shaping the future of financial services.
 



 You’ll join us at an exciting stage of growth in Riyadh, helping establish and expand our local presence while contributing to strategic fintech initiatives with long\-term impact across the Kingdom.
 



 You’ll join a company that values collaboration, adaptability, and continuous learning — giving you the opportunity to grow while helping build innovative solutions in an evolving fintech landscape.
 



  





**Your Role** 




 As a
 **Senior Program Manager – Fintech Solutions** 
 , you will lead the delivery of strategic, cross\-functional initiatives in Saudi Arabia with significant business and technological impact.
 



 You will coordinate stakeholders across business, product, technology, compliance, and external partners, ensuring complex programs are delivered successfully while supporting organizational growth and transformation.
 



 Acting as a trusted partner to senior leadership, you will drive decision\-making, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure alignment between strategic objectives and execution.
 



  





**A few examples of your responsibilities** 



* Lead complex fintech programs, defining roadmaps, milestones, delivery plans, and measurable business outcomes.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams, third\-party vendors, and ecosystem partners to ensure successful program execution.
* Drive delivery across digital onboarding, payments, wallet solutions, compliance, and other financial services capabilities.
* Translate business objectives into Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
* Build and maintain governance frameworks, reporting structures, and executive\-level updates to provide visibility and control.
* Manage program risks, dependencies, priorities, and delivery challenges across multiple stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with business leaders, technology teams, compliance functions, and external partners to ensure successful outcomes.
* Define and monitor KPIs, using data\-driven insights to support decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions remain aligned with business objectives, customer needs, regulatory expectations, and technical feasibility.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





**Essential Requirements** 



* 6\+ years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Product Delivery, or similar leadership roles within fintech, banking, financial services, or consulting environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
* Fluency in Arabic and professional proficiency in English are required.
* Strong experience managing large\-scale, cross\-functional technology programs involving multiple stakeholders.
* Solid understanding of software delivery processes, including backlog preparation, sprint planning, grooming, and coordination between Product, Engineering, and QA.

* Good knowledge of API\-based products, integrations, and technical documentation.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, and modern delivery management practices.
* Ability to work with high\-level architecture and technical constraints to align product scope with implementation feasibility.
* Understanding of regulated financial services environments and fintech ecosystems.



  





**Experience in One or More of the Following Areas Is Highly Valued** 



* Digital onboarding and authentication.
* Wallet management and digital financial services.
* KYC, AML, and fraud prevention.
* Payments and transaction processing.
* Smart contracts and blockchain\-enabled solutions.
* Trading and settlement workflows.
* Custody and wallet security.
* External platform and exchange integrations.
* Regulatory reporting and auditability.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.
* Experience within Saudi Arabia or GCC financial services ecosystems.
* Exposure to digital assets, blockchain technologies, or emerging financial products.
* Previous experience engaging with regulators, financial institutions, or highly regulated industries.



  





**Soft Skills That Make a Difference** 



* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to keep stakeholders aligned and informed.
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills across technical and business teams.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross\-functionally in fast\-paced environments.
* High sense of ownership, accountability, and proactive problem\-solving.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to navigate complexity, remove blockers, and drive progress across multiple teams.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a drive for continuous improvement and innovation.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Fully remote role.

* Opportunity to play a key role in establishing and growing BKN301’s presence in Riyadh.
* You’ll be among the first members of our Riyadh team, helping shape local delivery capabilities and support our long\-term growth in the market.
* The role will initially be remote, with a planned transition to a hybrid working model as our Riyadh operations continue to grow.
* Dynamic and international environment, built on trust, collaboration, and ownership.
* Real impact on strategic fintech transformation projects.
* Exposure to innovative financial technologies and emerging markets.
* Continuous growth and learning opportunities within a fast\-evolving and international group.



  





**Our Culture** 




 At BKN301, we believe innovation thrives when different perspectives meet.
 



 Working across multiple countries and markets, we value collaboration, mutual respect, and the unique contributions that help us build stronger teams and better products.
 



 We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a fair and inclusive environment for all.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking a highly capable PMO Manager to lead the project management office for a real estate developer in Riyadh.
   

  

 The PMO Manager will oversee the full development delivery cycle: feasibility support, design management, consultant and contractor coordination, cost and schedule control, procurement tracking, risk management, project reporting, handover, and close\-out.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and manage PMO governance, reporting standards, project controls, templates, and approval workflows across the development portfolio
* Monitor projects from design stage through construction, handover, and final close\-out on behalf of the developer
* Prepare executive dashboards and weekly/monthly reports covering project progress, cost, cash flow, risks, design status, procurement, variations, sales readiness, and key decisions required
* Verify actual site progress through regular site inspections and independent validation, rather than relying solely on contractor reports
* Control approved budgets, BOQs, commitments, variations, forecasts, and cost\-to\-complete for each project
* Track master schedules, identify delays early, assess recovery plans, and escalate critical risks to management
* Lead coordination between development, design, finance, procurement, sales, legal, consultants, contractors, and government\-related stakeholders
* Review design deliverables, consultant outputs, BOQs, specifications, tender packages, and construction documentation for completeness before execution
* Monitor consultant and contractor performance against their contractual scope, deliverables, milestones, quality requirements, and approved budgets
* Maintain project risk registers, issue logs, decision trackers, action plans, and mitigation measures
* Support tender evaluations, consultant and contractor appointments, variation reviews, claims assessments, and project close\-out
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with approved product positioning, financial objectives, delivery timelines, and quality standards
* Identify operational gaps and implement practical improvements to strengthen accountability, reporting quality, and delivery performance


**Requirements**
**Mandatory Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or related discipline
* Minimum 8 years of total experience in real estate development, project management, project controls, or construction delivery
* Minimum 3 years of direct experience working for a real estate developer / owner / master developer is mandatory
* Demonstrated experience managing residential, mixed\-use, commercial, or hospitality development projects from the developer side
* Proven experience in managing consultants, contractors, design coordination, budgets, BOQs, procurement, variations, project schedules, and handover
* Strong understanding of the full real estate development lifecycle, not only construction execution
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting/dashboard tools
* Strong commercial awareness, including budget monitoring, cash\-flow tracking, cost forecasting, and variation control
* Experience establishing or working within PMO governance frameworks, including project controls, reporting standards, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, and stage\-gate processes
* Experience in project scheduling, critical\-path analysis, recovery planning, progress measurement, and executive reporting
* Experience with tender evaluation, procurement planning, variation assessment, and contractor performance monitoring
* Business\-fluent English
* Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia
* Based in Riyadh or willing to relocate
* Able to conduct regular site visits across active development and construction projects in Riyadh
* Able to work in both office and construction\-site environments
* Able to attend project meetings, inspections, and site walks as required
* Proficient in using a laptop and standard Microsoft Office tools for day\-to\-day work
* Able to work effectively with digital project documentation, drawings, BOQs, schedules, and cloud\-based collaboration platforms


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, PMI\-SP, PMI\-RMP, RICS, Primavera, or equivalent certification
* Experience with project management systems, ERP platforms, or real estate development software
* Experience managing multiple projects or a development portfolio simultaneously
* Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration, preferred for engineering\-degree holders
* Availability to join within 30 to 60 days is a plus


**What We Are Looking For**
* A developer\-side PMO professional who understands the owner's commercial, technical, and delivery priorities
* Someone who can challenge consultants and contractors constructively and protect the developer's interests
* A hands\-on manager with strong site awareness, disciplined reporting, and the ability to identify issues before they become delays or cost overruns
* A leader who can create accountability across internal teams and external stakeholders


**Benefits**
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage
* Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations
* Paid annual leave and public holidays
* Professional development and training opportunities
