data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is being built from scratch, to go\-live in 2027, and is designed to operate as a regulated financial market infrastructure from day one
 



  





 We are hiring two Business Analysts to sit at the engine room of the programme. A regulated financial market infrastructure being built from a blank sheet generates an enormous volume of design, process, and operational documentation that needs to be produced, standardised, kept current, and used to drive downstream artefacts including test plans, training materials, runbooks, and regulatory submissions.
 



  





 This programme operates as a highly AI\-leveraged programme office, with Claude adopted as the standard productivity tool. The Business Analyst is the human who knows the business, knows the documentation standards, prompts Claude well, and rigorously checks and refines its output. The principle is clear: AI is the servant, never the master. Human accountability for accuracy, judgement, and domain interpretation is non\-negotiable.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Producing, structuring, and maintaining the programme's delivery documentation: process maps, workflow diagrams, design documents, decision logs, operational procedures, runbook drafts, training materials, and papers
* Driving consistency of documentation across the programme: common templates, terminology, structure, and version control
* Operating as a skilled user of Claude: prompting effectively, iterating, refining, and treating AI output as a first draft to be improved, never as a finished product
* Identifying opportunities to use AI to compress effort across the programme, for example generating test plans from design documents or training material from runbooks
* Mapping current\-state and target\-state processes across the operating model in collaboration with the Product Owner, Operations Lead, Head of Operations Control, and other business owners
* Maintaining the programme RAID log; supporting the Project Manager on plan maintenance, dependency tracking, and status reporting
* Generating test artefacts from upstream design documentation: test plans, test cases, test data requirements, and traceability matrices
* Absorbing domain knowledge actively: how a CSD works, how settlement happens, how registry is maintained, how corporate actions flow, and what the regulator requires



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least three years in a business analyst, process analyst, or documentation\-heavy role, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. Strong process mapping and documentation skills: able to translate verbal discussion into clear, structured written output.
 



  





 Fast learner: able to absorb new domain knowledge quickly and use it accurately. High proficiency in Microsoft Office and standard process\-mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, or equivalent). Fluent in English.
 



  





 Demonstrable, hands\-on fluency with Claude or equivalent large language models as a productivity multiplier in real work is required. Candidates should be able to describe specific examples. Candidates without prior Claude experience but with strong evidence of fast AI adoption will be considered.
 



  





 Exposure to financial market infrastructure or capital markets and post\-trade processes is an advantage. So is experience producing documentation subject to regulatory inspection or external audit.
 



  





**What this is** 




 This is a hands\-on, productive role for fast learners who want to operate at the frontier of how a modern programme office works. The post\-holder will not be a passive note\-taker. They will be expected to absorb domain knowledge quickly, drive their own work, and continuously raise the standard and consistency of programme documentation. If that is the way you work and you have the AI fluency and documentation discipline to back it up, this is worth a conversation.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The role is primarily responsible for carrying out the preliminary financial and industry analysis for the existing and prospective clients handled by the Corporate and Institutional Banking Business, in adherence to the Credit Policy Guidelines and the Standardized Procedures. The role is also responsible for supporting the Relationship Managers in conducting the preliminary review of AML/KYC documents for the existing and New\-To\-Bank clients, besides providing the proactive and effective support to the Relationship Managers by liaising with internal support units/stakeholders, to ensure “the best customer experience, higher share of client’s wallet and development of the portfolio”. This position is expected to act as Backup Resource for Relationship Managers in their absence, and thus is expected to gain full knowledge over the complete range of Products and Services offered by QNB Group. These will typically include credit, trade, transaction banking and deposit services, as well as international transactions or other specialised services.
   

  

 Main Duties
   

  

* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Proactively assist the Relationship Managers in undertaking the Financial and Industry (Sectoral) analysis, so as to complete the New \& Review/Renewal Credit appraisals in time.
* Proactively undertake the Internal Obligor Risk Ratings, feed the same in Bank’s internal/external rating tools to develop the Rating Reports and Spreadsheets.
* Proactively support the Business Unit in reviewing the client’s constitutive documents to uphold and monitor full adherence and compliance with the prevailing best corporate banking practices.
* Proactively support the Business Unit/Relationship Managers in liaising with the internal Support Units for quick and smooth delivery of services.
* Proactively assist in the implementation of the strategies and plans to achieve all volume, revenue, development and profit targets for the Business Unit’s customer portfolio.
* Observes and promotes cost consciousness and efficiency, and enhance productivity, to minimize costs, avoid wastes, and optimize benefits for the bank.
* Proactively support the Business Unit in the development of Key Performance Indicators for the purpose of systematic performance monitoring and quality measurement of the Business Unit’s function, customer portfolio development and the monitoring of achievements.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and adheres to QNB policies
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Proactively support the Business Unit in maintaining and developing customer relationships, acting as an alternative to Relationship Managers, as may be required.
* Proactively support the Business Unit in dealing with and resolving customer problems and requirements, in coordination with appropriate in house and external support functions, to ensure timely, friendly and accurate responses and provision of Bank products / services.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and Corporate Banking’s compliance function, as and when required.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with all other related functions / units to assist in the achievement of the Corporate Banking’s goals and objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Proactively support the Business Unit to develop and manage on a day\-to\-day basis both potential new customer targets and existing customers to meet assigned financial and non\-financial targets, in compliance with QNB policies and procedures, regulations and prevailing best practices.
* Assist the Business Unit to prepare comprehensive credit proposals for new / prospective customers that adequately address all relevant risk factors and satisfy minimum acceptable standards of QNB corporate credit.
* Assist the Business Unit to prepare comprehensive credit reviews for existing customer facilities, at least one month before limit expiry, that adequately address all relevant and current risk factors and the latest developments in the industry, market and business.
* Assist the Business Unit to identify and timely report on all negative events and early signals on potentially problematic accounts / relationships.
* Assist the Business Unit to maintain the timely review of credit applications and documents within set turn\-around time, in coordination with Credit Risk. Support the RMs, Unit Heads and others as requested, in identifying weak aspects of the credit applications.
* Assist the Business Unit in monitoring the customer credit positions for full compliance with set limits and QNB’s Investment and Credit Strategy.
* Support the Business Unit in the preparation of periodic Management and Business Information reports to executive management, as requested.
* In the absence of Credit Admin Role:
* Liaise with HO credit admin on the credit documentation meeting the terms \& conditions as per approval.
* Seek HO Credit Admin acknowledgment when needed for collaterals submitted and supporting documents.
* Seek HO Credit Admin Review and have the checklist completed for Credit Operations to complete the remaining tasks
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Possess good knowledge of the corporate banking business; its products and services, related risks, documentation, regulatory requirements and report preparation together with a superior knowledge of controls.
* Develop a good knowledge of QNB Oman’s portfolio of customer’s business and needs.
* Possess good IT skills to be able to compose correspondence and reports using standard Bank platform and applications.
* Takes responsibility for self\-development as well as acquiring skills and knowledge required to fulfilment of one's duties by proactively identifying areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Anti\-Bribery and Corruption, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need\-to\-know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


 Education/Skills
   

  

* University graduate (Bachelors’ Degree) preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics, Mathematics, or Business Administration (related field of study), Masters preferred
* Professional certification such as ACCA, PRM, CPA, CFA is strongly preferred
* Professional certification in AML/KYC Regulations is desirable.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills (including report writing) in English.
* At least 8 years relevant experience in the banking industry, preferably with a large local / International Bank, of which at least 2 years in bank in a supervisory capacity in risk function
* Should be well\-informed of the domestic and international market trends, sectoral performance and competitive structures, industry practices and should be well versed with CBO/other regulations as applicable for the corporate banking segment.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




  





 A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is being built from scratch, to go\-live in 2027, and is designed to operate as a regulated financial market infrastructure from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are hiring an Operations Lead to design the operational function from a blank sheet in Build, and then operate it in Run. Issuers, primary dealers, custodians, settlement banks, and investors will depend on this platform to do what it says it will do, on time, every time, without exception. The Operations Lead is the person accountable for making that happen day after day once the platform is live. Scope is all operational activity except controls. Reconciliations, regulatory reporting, client money compliance, and data governance sit with the Head of Operations Control. Everything else operational sits here.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Designing the operational function from a blank sheet: team structure, capability profile, operating procedures, runbooks, calendars, cut\-offs, and escalation paths.
* Owning the operational execution of settlement: trade input, matching, instruction processing, cash and securities movement, settlement finality, and exception management.
* Owning the operational execution of registry maintenance: account opening, amendments, position management, and holding statements.
* Owning end\-to\-end operational responsibility for asset servicing and corporate actions: notification, election capture, processing, distribution, and reconciliation back to issuers and participants.
* Designing and operating the participant onboarding process; owning day\-to\-day participant services including enquiry handling, instruction support, and issue resolution.
* Owning first\-line operational risk identification, recording, mitigation, and escalation; operating the operational incident management process.
* Owning operational relationships with custodians, settlement banks, the exchange, SWIFT, and paying agents.
* Owning operational readiness for go\-live: trained team, tested procedures, signed\-off runbooks, and completed dress rehearsals.
* Line managing the Operations Analyst, Corporate Actions Specialist, and the wider Operations team as it builds.



  









**Qualifications** 




  




* At least 10 years in securities operations, custody operations, settlement operations, or financial market infrastructure operations.
* Direct, demonstrable experience operating securities settlement and registry processes at scale: this is non\-negotiable.
* Direct, hands\-on experience of corporate actions operations across a range of event types.
* Demonstrated experience designing or significantly redesigning an operational function, including procedures, runbooks, team structure, and training, rather than only operating one inherited from elsewhere.
* Track record of operating under regulatory expectations for an FMI or a securities\-services business.
* Experience managing operational relationships with custodians, settlement banks, and exchange or CSD counterparties.
* Fluent in English.
* Direct experience in a CSD, ICSD, or custody bank is a strong advantage.
* Experience operating SWIFT\-based settlement messaging and familiarity with Islamic\-finance instrument operations.



  









**Required Skills** 




  




* Settlement and registry operations background.
* Leadership to run operations to a regulated FMI standard.



  









**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience in a CSD, ICSD, or custody bank.
* Familiarity with Islamic\-finance instrument operations.



  









**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 This information is not provided in the job description.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices.

data.jd_text:
**The opportunity** 




 A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. We are hiring an Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer to own the Company's payment cycle and receivables management from day one.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Processing supplier invoices: receipt, coding, verification against purchase orders and contracts, and preparation of payment runs for approval
* Maintaining supplier master data and bank details, with appropriate fraud controls
* Processing employee expense claims and reconciling corporate travel agency invoices and card statements
* Preparing and issuing customer invoices, recording receipts, and monitoring overdue balances
* Daily bank account reconciliation and petty cash and corporate card record maintenance
* Applying payment controls including segregation of duties and dual authorisation
* Identifying and escalating anomalous transactions without delay



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least five years in an accounts payable, accounts receivable, or general accounting role. Demonstrated experience operating end\-to\-end AP and AR processes. Familiarity with corporate banking platforms and payment controls. Working knowledge of Omani VAT. Fluent in English; working Arabic preferred.
 



 A part\-qualification or accounting technician qualification is an advantage. So is experience in a regulated financial services entity or a start\-up environment.
 



  





**What this is** 




 This is a founding\-team role at an institution under construction. The processes, systems, and controls are being built now, and the person in this role will help shape them. If you want to own your function properly from the start, this is worth a conversation.

data.jd_text:
This is not another AI job.
 



  





 We are looking for someone to help redesign an entire business for the age of Agentic AI.
 



  





 Alsayegh Group is one of the Middle East’s leading integrated business groups, operating across marketing, communications, media, events, exhibitions, production, fit\-out, FF\&E, technology and immersive experiences.
 



 As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for an exceptional AI Transformation Director to lead our enterprise\-wide AI transformation and help build one of the Middle East’s first truly AI\-native organizations.
 



 This role goes far beyond implementing AI tools. You will define how AI becomes embedded into every aspect of our business, from business development and creative operations to finance, HR, project delivery, procurement and executive decision\-making.
 



  





**Your Mission:** 




 Lead the transformation of Alsayegh Group into an AI\-first enterprise by designing, implementing and scaling AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute the Group’s AI transformation strategy.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI opportunities across all business units.
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions that automate and enhance business processes.
* Build AI\-powered workflows that integrate with our existing technology ecosystem.
* Establish AI governance, security and responsible AI frameworks.
* Partner with executive leadership to embed AI into strategic decision\-making.
* Build and lead an internal AI team while managing external technology partners where appropriate.
* Foster an AI\-driven culture through education, change management and continuous innovation.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide AI or digital transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, automation platforms, AI orchestration and enterprise AI architectures.
* Experience integrating AI with CRM, ERP, project management and collaboration platforms.
* Ability to bridge business strategy with technology execution.
* Exceptional leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for building new capabilities from the ground up.
* Experience in consulting, enterprise technology, AI startups or large\-scale transformation programs is highly desirable.



  





**Bonus Experience:** 




 Experience in one or more of the following industries is a plus:
 


* Marketing \& Communications
* Events \& Live Experiences
* Exhibitions
* FF\&E
* Fit\-Out
* Technology
* Hospitality



  





**Why Join Us:** 




 This is a unique opportunity to build something from the ground up.
 



  





 You won’t be joining an AI team. You’ll be creating it.
 



  





 You’ll work directly with the Chairman and executive leadership to shape the future of one of the region’s most ambitious business groups and establish a blueprint for how AI transforms an entire enterprise.
 



  





 If you’re passionate about building the next generation of AI\-powered organizations and want to make a lasting impact, we’d love to hear from you.

**Company Description** 
 Quttainah Specialized Hospital is the largest specialized cosmetic surgery hospital in the Middle East, offering advanced aesthetic and cosmetic medical services. The hospital features a boutique center personally designed by the owner, creating a distinctive, original environment with meticulous attention to detail. Visitors experience a refined atmosphere that reflects the hospital’s commitment to quality and patient comfort. QSH aims to provide the UAE and neighboring Gulf countries with innovative healthcare, delivering cutting\-edge treatments in cosmetic medicine and surgery. Guided by the motto “Expert care exceptional results,” the hospital strives to be a leader in cosmetic healthcare across the region.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Head of Operations is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, responsible for overseeing daily operational activities across the hospital. This role ensures that clinical and non\-clinical operations run efficiently, aligning processes with regulatory requirements, quality standards, and patient experience objectives. Key responsibilities include managing departmental performance, optimizing workflows, coordinating cross\-functional teams, and implementing operational policies and procedures. The Head of Operations will monitor budgets, resource allocation, and utilization to support sustainable growth, while driving continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence. Collaboration with senior leadership, medical staff, and support functions is essential to maintain high standards of service and support the hospital’s strategic goals.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Operations Management experience, including process optimization and implementation of hospital or healthcare operational standards.
* Advanced Analytical Skills for interpreting performance data, identifying trends, and making evidence\-based operational decisions.
* Proven Team Management capabilities, including leadership, mentorship, and cross\-functional collaboration in a diverse workplace.
* Excellent Communication skills for engaging with clinical staff, management, and external stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
* Demonstrated Budgeting skills, including cost control, resource planning, and financial monitoring to support organizational objectives.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.
* Significant experience in healthcare operations, preferably within hospitals or specialized medical centers.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with UAE healthcare regulations and accreditation standards is required.

 We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial IT Manager to establish, develop, and lead the company's IT Solutions Division from the ground up. The successful candidate will be responsible for building the business, developing strategic partnerships, identifying new technology opportunities, and delivering end\-to\-end IT infrastructure and technology solutions.
 



 This is a business\-building role focused on creating value for the company by establishing a profitable IT division, expanding the customer base, developing solution offerings, and driving sustainable revenue growth. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise together with commercial acumen to build and grow the IT business across Qatar.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Establish and develop the company's IT Solutions Division, including strategy, service offerings, and business growth plans.

* Build strategic relationships with corporate clients, government entities, consultants, contractors, and technology partners.
* Develop partnerships with leading global technology vendors, distributors, and solution providers.
* Design and deliver end\-to\-end IT infrastructure solutions, including passive networking, active networking, structured cabling, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.
* Lead solution design, technical presentations, client consultations, and pre\-sales activities.
* Prepare technical proposals, BOQs, tenders, quotations, and commercial offers.
* Manage technology projects from solution design through implementation and handover.
* Develop pricing strategies, solution portfolios, and go\-to\-market plans.
* Build and lead a high\-performing technical and commercial team.
* Drive revenue growth, profitability, and expansion of the IT Solutions business.
* Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and new business opportunities.
* Report business performance, strategic initiatives, and growth opportunities to senior management.



  





**Requirements** 



* Master's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, or a related field.

* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a managerial or business leadership role.
* Proven experience in establishing or growing an IT Solutions, Systems Integration, or Technology Services business.
* Strong knowledge of passive networking, structured cabling, LAN/WAN, routing, switching, wireless solutions, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud platforms, and enterprise IT infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience in designing and delivering integrated IT infrastructure solutions.
* Experience with technology vendors, distributors, solution partnerships, and channel management.
* Strong experience in tendering, BOQ preparation, solution architecture, technical proposals, and project estimation.
* Demonstrated ability to generate revenue, secure new clients, and develop strategic partnerships.
* Strong commercial, business development, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Microsoft, VMware, ITIL, AWS, Azure, or equivalent are highly preferred.
* Experience in Qatar or the GCC market is highly preferred.
* Valid Qatar Driving License is required.

data.jd_text:
Railways for the world of tomorrow.
   

  

 DB Engineering \& Consulting (DB E\&C) is a part of the DB group, a world leading global railway company with an extensive organization in Germany and projects around the world. Our company offers technically sophisticated and customized infrastructure, mobility and transport solutions. With our sustainable concepts, gained from our experience in project work for decades, we ensure the future success of economic regions, make important contributions to the protection of the environment and help shape the world of the future. We have 180 years of rail experience, and our infrastructure projects connect continents. We set the standard for transportation and modern mobility.
   

  

 We are seeking a Asset Condition Domain Expert as part of our DB Engineering \& Consulting GmbH Branch Office. The job opening is located in the Middle East and offers exciting challenges and potential for career growth.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Lead and support the development and implementation of comprehensive asset condition assessment frameworks, including inspection, sampling, grading, and lifecycle evaluation method\-ologies.
* Develop and implement asset condition assessment methodologies and inspection protocols
* Define and apply condition grading systems and scoring models (e.g., FCI, 1–5 scales)
* Design and execute sampling strategies (risk\-based, statistical, ISO\-aligned) for fleet and component inspections
* Lead on\-site asset condition surveys and structured data collection
* Ensure consistency and quality of inspection results across assets
* Develop deterioration models and degradation curves
* Assess remaining useful life (RUL) of assets
* Benchmark asset conditions against industry standards and expected lifecycle performance
* Produce asset condition assessment reports with clear recommendations
* Translate technical findings into risk, cost, and lifecycle implications
* Support investment planning and maintenance prioritization
* Support review of fixed asset structures and classifications
* Contribute to useful life assessments aligned with IAS 16 / IFRS standards


**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related field.
* At least 10 years’ experience in asset management, maintenance, or reliability engineering in Railways project or existing metro or tram operations.
* Proven experience in asset condition \& inspection methodologies; condition grading systems \& scoring frameworks; and sampling methodologies (statistical and/or risk\-based).
* Experience with deterioration modelling and lifecycle analysis
* Experience in CMMS/EAM Systems (e.g., SAP, IBM Maximo, SCADA)
* Certification in reliability or maintenance (e.g., CMRP, CRE).
* Knowledge of IAS 16 / IFRS asset valuation principles (strong advantage).
* Qatar/GCC working experience is an Advantage.
* Experience working with Ministry, Government Agencies, and Entities.
* Proficiency in English, both spoken and written. Arabic speaker an advantage.
* Full Computer Literacy
* Excellent communication skills are essential to success in this role.
* Driving license is required to drive to site or to technical meetings with the client representative.


 Benefits:
   

  

* We invest in the development of our employees. To ensure the best start for you, we provide a global onboarding program and intercultural training and support you in preparing for the next career step.
* We offer you attractive working conditions and a competitive compensation package based on country conditions.
* To ensure a smooth and successful start for your international employment, we assist you with relocation and immigration.

Five Rivers Analytics is looking for a Service Desk Administrator to work in Camp Arifjan, KW. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!
   

  

 Our Service Desk Administrator provides front\-line customer service desk support, responsible for responding to and resolving computer, printer, and network issues. Customers contact the Service desk in\-person, by phone, using ServiceNow and/or by sending emails. This position involves a high degree of quick decision making and detailed task management to ensure all work orders not resolved at the Service Desk are immediately assigned to the appropriate IT groups. Excellent customer service skills are mandatory.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Primary support and interface with site Information Management Officers (IMO) to ensure all Service Desk resources are utilized in the most efficient manner. Assists the IMO with daily functions of computer, network and software management for the site and all users.
* Provides immediate response to all customers who come to the Service Desk. Person\-to\-person interaction involves troubleshooting, information exchange and help with ticket submission and issues. Excellent interpersonal skills are required.
* Provides telephone customer support for incoming and follow up calls used for initial troubleshooting.
* May be required to work for 12\-hour shifts utilizing ServiceNow call management software and other tools, to log and manage trouble tickets. Must have the technical ability to accurately determine call routing for trouble tickets that cannot be resolved immediately at the Service Desk.
* Troubleshoots Microsoft OS issues on Army Gold Master/Universal Gold Master along with setup and Microsoft Office 2007\. Troubleshoots all other site authorized software with IMOs and users.
* Creates logon and email accounts using Microsoft Exchange Server and User Manager. Manages Network Services with Server Manager, Print Queue Management and CISCO VMPS Administration.
* Works within a small continuous improvement focused team.
* Tracks and documents work performed to allow accurate reporting of all Service Desk activities.
* Completes all tasks and assignments as requested by Supervisors and Management.
* Performs other duties and assignments as required.

* Must be a US citizen with an active Secret clearance, or higher level, security clearance.

**Scope And Purpose**

The role serves as a central coordination point between the VPAA’s office and academic units, supporting communication, follow\-up, scheduling, reporting, and administrative processes across Academic Affairs.The position requires strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain confidentiality, and support institutional initiatives in a collaborative academic environment.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Executive Support to the VPAA**
* Manage the VPAA’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and related scheduling logistics.
* Prepare and organize reports, presentations, meeting materials, correspondence, and briefing documents.
* Support the VPAA in tracking priorities, follow\-up items, and ongoing initiatives.
* Handle confidential information and sensitive academic or personnel matters with professionalism and discretion.
* Maintain organized records, files, and documentation for the Office of Academic Affairs.


**Coordination Across Academic Units**
* Coordinate communication and follow\-up between the Office of the VPAA and academic units, including colleges, the University Library, and faculty development/research offices.

* Support organization of records and documentation related to academic initiatives, accreditation, program review, and other institutional processes as needed.
* Coordinate with faculty, staff, and external partners to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and projects.


**Communication \& Institutional Support**
* Draft, proofread, and disseminate official communications from the Office of the VPAA.

* Assist in identifying and resolving administrative bottlenecks through proactive follow\-up and coordination.
* Maintain professional and collaborative working relationships with faculty, staff, administrators, and external stakeholders.

 The selected candidate will play a vital role in supporting the 9th Air Force, a key component of the United States Air Force Central Command (AFCENT) overseeing operations in the Middle East. This position provides subject matter expertise to the 9th Air Force Expeditionary Security Forces Squadron, helping ensure base security and critical support services in one of the most dynamic and strategically important regions in the world. The 9 th Air Force serves at other locations such as Al Dhafra AB, UAE; Ali Al Salem AB, Kuwait; Al Mubarak Air Base, Kuwait; Prince Sultan AB (PSAB), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA); Muwaffaq\-Salti AB (MSAB), Jordan; Al Udeid AB, Qatar and in CONUS.

* Conduct backing up and restoring of hard drives, and perform system crash recoveries.
* Implement physical and computer security measures by assigning, modifying, and deleting passwords and privileges. Provide limited software application assistance for commonly used office automation applications sources from standard Air Force infrastructure support contracts.
* Ensure systems are kept up\-to\-date and compliant according to the Air Force Network Operations Center(AFNOSC). Ensure the required Technical Compliance NOTAM (TCNO)security patches are installed. Check files for corruption, perform initial system diagnostics, format drives, and determine available disk space.

This will additionally include video\-teleconference suite administration, network and computer malfunction isolation and repair, computer system software/hardware configuration, and operation of unclassified and classified computer systems.
* Be designated as primary unit IT Equipment Custodian. Ensure unit program IT Equipment management compliance in accordance with AFI 23\-101\.

* Train unit personnel on the operations of secure voice communications equipment.
* Be designated as unit SharePoint administrator. Modify and maintain the unit’s SharePoint site. Alternate to the TCO (Telephone Communication Officer); duties include managing the installation and maintenance of telephone systems. Provide instruction for the operation and use of secure phones.
* Request and coordinate installation and support of communications equipment. Request opening of network trouble tickets with the Communications Focal Point. Unit point of contact for creation and deletion of all network accounts.

* Five (5\) years of experience in computer systems administration support.

* Proficiency in non\-secure and secure internet protocol network and equipment


 operations.

 All employees must successfully pass all medical screening as required per CENTCOM deployment standards.

data.jd_text:
The
 **Director of IT/OT Network \& Security Operations** 
 is a critical leadership role within City Operations IT, responsible for the end\-to\-end management, reliability, and security of Qiddiya's converged IT and Operational Technology (OT) infrastructure.
   

  

 As Qiddiya transitions from construction to operations, this role will lead operational readiness, infrastructure acceptance, and the ongoing management of city\-wide digital platforms, including fiber networks, active network equipment, smart city systems, and physical security networks (VMS, ACS, CCTV).
   

  

 The role serves as a key bridge between enterprise IT and industrial OT environments, ensuring seamless integration, high availability, and a robust cybersecurity posture across all city operations. It requires deep technical expertise in network architecture and security, alongside strong vendor management and cross\-functional leadership to collaborate effectively with QTECH, MDU, District Master Developers, and third\-party operators.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Operational Leadership \& Strategy
* Lead the IT/OT Network and Security Operations function for Qiddiya City IT Operations.
* Define and execute the operational strategy for converged IT/OT environments, aligned with the City Operations Target Operating Model (TOM) and Qiddiya's digital vision.
* Establish and manage interfaces with the Network Operations Center (NOC) and Security Operations Center (SOC) for city\-level infrastructure.
* Define, monitor, and enforce SLAs, KPIs, and performance metrics across internal teams and external service providers.
* Infrastructure \& Network Operations
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations, maintenance, and optimization of city\-wide network infrastructure, including fiber backbone, MMRs, MDCs, and active network components.
* Manage the operational lifecycle of OT networks supporting smart city use cases across utilities, transportation, and facility management.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, and redundancy of critical network topologies supporting city operations.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex IT/OT network issues.
* Security Operations \& Governance
* Oversee operational security systems and their supporting network infrastructure.
* Implement and monitor cybersecurity controls across OT environments, including network segregation, access control, and threat detection, aligned with QTECH cybersecurity standards.
* Coordinate vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security audits for city infrastructure.
* Ensure compliance with national cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NCA) and internal Qiddiya policies.
* Transition, Handover \& Acceptance
* Act as the primary City Operations IT authority for the acceptance and handover of network and security infrastructure from QTECH, MDU, and District Master Developers.
* Define operational readiness criteria, testing protocols, and documentation standards for onboarding new assets.
* Participate in design reviews to ensure operational, maintainability, and security requirements are embedded early in the lifecycle.
* Vendor \& Stakeholder Management
* Manage relationships and operational contracts with neutral hosts, data center operators, and managed service providers.
* Collaborate closely with QTECH Design teams to ensure alignment on architecture, shared services, and governance frameworks.
* Engage with Business Units (e.g., Transport, Utilities, Security) to ensure IT/OT infrastructure meets operational and use\-case requirements


**Requirements**
****Education****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline.


**Experience**
* 12\-15 years of progressive experience in network engineering, IT/OT operations, and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven track record in managing large\-scale, mission\-critical infrastructure within complex environments such as smart cities, giga\-projects, utilities, or industrial sectors.
* Extensive experience bridging IT and OT environments, with a strong understanding of industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA, and IoT network architectures.
* Demonstrated experience in transitioning infrastructure from construction and delivery phases into stable, live operations.


**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Deep expertise in network routing, switching, and topology design (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent technologies).
* Strong knowledge of OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST).
* Experience with physical security network infrastructure, including CCTV, VMS, and ACS systems.
* Relevant industry certifications are highly desirable, such as:
+ Networking: CCIE, JNCIE, or equivalent.
+ Security: CISSP, CISM, GICSP, or equivalent.
+ Service Management: ITIL v4\.


****Core Competencies****
* Strategic thinker with strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams and executive leadership.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast\-paced, and evolving environments.
* Strong vendor management and contract negotiation expertise

talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

 Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on\-demand food and Q\-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
   

  

 We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
   

  

 At talabat, we foster an innovative environment where our talabaty employees can strive to create a positive impact across the region through the use of our platform.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Special Projects \& Performance role is part of the regional Chief Business Officer organizational structure. The role involves analyzing talabat’s business performance, preparing data\-driven insights for senior management, conducting in\-depth market analyses to unlock topline and bottom\-line opportunities, leading special projects, and ensuring talabat is on track to hit PnL targets.
   

  

**What’s On Your Plate?**
**Reporting Business Performance**
 This role will help drive strategic projects and generate insights for the business. The individual will be working very closely with senior management and be responsible for four main scopes:
   

  

* Analyze Data: Dive into talabat’s performance metrics, identifying key trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement.
* Prepare Reports: Create comprehensive and insightful reports for senior management, highlighting key drivers of change and actionable insights.
* Communicate Findings: Present findings in a clear and concise manner, often translating complex data into understandable recommendations for decision\-makers.


**Conducting Analytical Deep Dives**
* Country\-Specific Analysis: Perform detailed analyses of different talabat markets, focusing on identifying turnaround opportunities, growth and profitability areas.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with various departments to understand and address cross\-functional issues impacting business performance.
* Strategy Development: Develop and recommend strategies based on analysis to improve overall performance and achieve business objectives.


**Special Projects**
* Launching new products: Develop business use cases with innovative ideas and bring them to life by working on their implementation, ensuring they align with strategic goals and add value to the business.


**PnL Management**
* Budgeting: Collaborate with local teams to develop talabat’s yearly budget, setting growth and profitability goals.
* PnL management: Ensure that budgets are adhered to consistently across the organization and proactively identify and pursue opportunities to exceed financial targets and enhance overall profitability.


**What Did We Order?**
* Thought Leadership ability to drive innovation and impact
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with large datasets, and advanced proficiency in BigQuery, Tableau, and analytics tools such as Looker
* Analytical Mindset with strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on data\-driven decisions
* Curiosity, eagerness to learn, explore, and drive creative solutions.
* Stakeholder Management skilled in engaging and managing diverse stakeholder interests
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration effective in working with teams across different functions to achieve common goals
* Experience with financial modelling and PnL analysis strongly preferred
* Experience using SQL, BigQuery, Looker, Tableau strongly preferred

We are seeking a Vaccination Subject Matter Expert (SME) to provide functional expertise on immunization registries and vaccination workflows. The role will support the design, configuration, and optimization of Immunization Information Systems (IIS), ensuring alignment with interoperability standards and reporting requirements. The SME will collaborate closely with engineering, integration, and data teams to translate immunization domain requirements into system capabilities and analytics use cases.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Own the functional configuration of immunization registry workflows, including vaccine ordering, population management, deduplication, and ambiguous ID handling.
* Define HL7 VXU/ACK message mappings, validation rules, and vocabulary usage (CVX, MVX) with integration teams.
* Develop specifications for FHIR Immunization resources and related APIs.
* Validate reports and dashboards to ensure accuracy of coverage, completeness, and adherence metrics.
* Support data science teams in defining features and labels for vaccination forecasting and risk\-scoring models.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT), stakeholder demonstrations, and end\-user training.
* Serve as the Level\-3 escalation point for vaccination\-related functional issues.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, vaccine schedules, and operational documentation.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Nursing, Health Informatics, Pharmacy, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in immunization programs, vaccination registries, or vaccine management systems.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more Immunization Information Systems (IIS).
* Strong knowledge of national or regional vaccination programs and immunization registries.
* Working knowledge of HL7 v2\.x VXU messaging, ACK handling, and CVX/MVX vocabularies.
* Familiarity with FHIR R4 resources, including Immunization, Patient, and Encounter.
* Understanding of analytics and machine learning use cases in immunization, such as coverage forecasting and risk scoring.
* Strong communication skills in English; Arabic proficiency is highly preferred.
* Experience within GCC or Middle East public health environments is advantageous.



 Preferred Technical Skills
 


* Immunization Information Systems (IIS)
* HL7 v2\.x VXU/ACK standards
* CVX and MVX vocabularies
* FHIR R4 (Immunization, Patient, Encounter)
* Power BI, SSRS, or Tableau
* Exposure to Python and machine learning notebooks is an advantage



 Key Competencies
 


* Strong domain expertise and stakeholder credibility
* Customer\-facing and collaborative approach
* Ability to manage operational escalations effectively
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. We are hiring an IT Operations Officer to own the corporate IT environment: end\-user devices, productivity systems, identity management, IT support, and corporate cybersecurity hygiene.
 



  





 This role covers corporate IT only. Production technology systems sit separately with the technology leadership team
 **.** 




  





**What the role covers** 



* Procurement, configuration, and lifecycle management of laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices; maintaining the device inventory and asset register
* Administering the productivity suite (M365 or equivalent) including mailboxes, file storage, collaboration tools, and licensing
* Identity and access management: account provisioning, role\-based access, multi\-factor authentication, and the joiner\-mover\-leaver process
* First\-line IT support for staff: incident triage, resolution, and escalation to the outsourced managed service provider where needed
* Applying cybersecurity policy to corporate systems: email security, endpoint protection, patching, and security awareness training
* Managing corporate IT vendor relationships, service contracts, and the IT contract register



  





  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least five years in an IT operations, IT administration, or end\-user computing role. Demonstrated experience administering M365 or equivalent productivity suites. Working knowledge of identity management, MDM, and endpoint security. Fluent in English; working Arabic preferred. Microsoft, CompTIA, or equivalent certifications are an advantage. So is familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001\) and prior experience in a small\-firm or regulated environment.
 



  





**What this is** 




 This is a founding\-team role. The corporate IT environment is being built now, and the person in this role will set it up properly from the start. If you are self\-sufficient, security\-conscious, and want to own your environment rather than operate within one someone else built, this is worth a conversation.

Job Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced
 **Data Workstream Project Manager** 
 to lead the end\-to\-end data migration workstream for a
 **Temenos T24 Core Banking Transformation Program** 
 . The role will be responsible for planning, governing, and executing data migration from legacy banking systems to the new core banking platform, including downstream applications, reporting systems, and operational data stores (ODS).
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in banking data migration, ETL strategy, data governance, reconciliation, and cutover execution, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and compliance throughout the transformation lifecycle.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Data Migration Strategy \& Planning
 


* Lead end\-to\-end data migration strategy for Temenos T24 implementation.
* Define migration scope, strategy, roadmap, and execution plans.
* Establish source\-to\-target mapping across legacy and new banking systems.
* Develop migration runbooks, timelines, and governance frameworks.



 2\. ETL Design \& Data Transformation
 


* Oversee ETL design and execution for migrating customer, account, transaction, loan, deposit, and treasury data.
* Define transformation rules and business logic for data conversion.
* Ensure seamless migration into core banking modules, peripheral systems, and reporting platforms.
* Coordinate with ETL developers and SI/vendor teams.



 3\. Data Mapping \& Governance
 


* Establish and maintain data mapping documentation.
* Implement data governance frameworks, policies, and controls.
* Ensure data lineage, ownership, and accountability across systems.
* Manage master data consistency and standardization.



 4\. Data Quality \& Cleansing
 


* Drive data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, and validation activities.
* Define data quality metrics and control mechanisms.
* Identify data anomalies and resolve quality issues before migration.
* Ensure trusted and accurate data migration.



 5\. Mock Migration \& Reconciliation
 


* Plan and execute multiple mock migration cycles.
* Oversee reconciliation tools, balancing processes, and defect management.
* Validate data completeness, integrity, and consistency after each migration cycle.
* Coordinate issue resolution with vendors and internal teams.



 6\. Cutover Execution \& Rollback Planning
 


* Own final cutover data migration activities.
* Manage freeze windows, cutover plans, approvals, and sign\-offs.
* Prepare rollback strategies and contingency plans.
* Ensure successful go\-live data transition.



 7\. Downstream System Integration
 


* Coordinate impact analysis for downstream systems.
* Ensure data synchronization across:
* Reporting systems
* Data warehouses
* Risk systems
* Tax systems
* Regulatory platforms
* Support integration readiness and post\-go\-live stabilization.



 8\. Regulatory Reporting \& Compliance
 


* Ensure compliance with central bank, tax, audit, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Support data readiness for financial and operational reporting.

The Healthcare Assistant (HCA) provides essential support to nursing and clinical teams in delivering high\-quality, compassionate care to patients in a long\-term and rehabilitation setting. The HCA assists patients with daily living activities, ensures comfort and safety, and supports clinical staff with basic medical and administrative tasks.
 



  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Patient Care \& Support** 



* Assist patients with activities of daily living (ADLs), including bathing, grooming, toileting, feeding, and mobility.
* Provide emotional support and companionship to patients, fostering a caring and respectful environment.
* Monitor patients’ conditions, such as taking and recording vital signs (temperature, pulse, respiration, and blood pressure).
* Report any changes in patient health or behavior promptly to the nursing team.



**2\. Clinical Assistance** 



* Support nurses and therapists during rehabilitation sessions and clinical procedures.
* Assist in repositioning and transferring patients safely to prevent bedsores and ensure comfort.
* Help maintain accurate patient records, charts, and documentation as required.
* Ensure infection control standards and hygiene practices are followed at all times.



**3\. Operational Support** 



* Maintain cleanliness and orderliness of patient areas, equipment, and supplies.
* Prepare and serve meals, ensuring dietary requirements are followed.
* Safely transport patients within the facility (to therapy rooms, diagnostic areas, etc.).
* Assist in the safe handling and disposal of clinical waste.



**4\. Compliance \& Professional Conduct** 



* Adhere to hospital policies, Bahrain’s Ministry of Health regulations, and international best practices.
* Participate in training, workshops, and continuing education as directed.
* Maintain confidentiality and respect the dignity of all patients.
* Follow health and safety procedures to minimize risks to patients and staff.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




  




* **Education:** 
 Secondary School Certificate or equivalent; Diploma/Certificate in Healthcare Assistance preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 1–2 years’ experience as a Healthcare Assistant, Nursing Aide, or similar role (experience in long\-term care/rehabilitation preferred).



  




* **Skills \& Competencies:**
* Compassionate and patient\-centered approach.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic clinical knowledge (vital signs, infection control, hygiene).
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
* Physically fit to handle patient transfers and mobility support.



  




* **Language:** 
 Proficiency in English is required; Arabic knowledge is an advantage.

The team aim to ensure the security and stability of the ByteDance cloud platforms while enabling the success of the cloud business.
   

  

 The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for the overall cybersecurity posture of the organization and for ensuring compliance with applicable cybersecurity laws, regulations, and regulatory frameworks, including the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA).
   

  

 The CISO will provide independent executive leadership and oversight across cybersecurity governance, risk management, and security operations. The role requires a pragmatic, business\-oriented leader with strong expertise in cybersecurity, cloud security, and modern technology environments, capable of ensuring that cybersecurity risks are identified, managed, and reported in alignment with the organization's risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with senior executives. This role offers the opportunity to shape strategic outcomes, reduce risk exposure, and drive secure innovation across complex, interconnected ecosystems.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

 Cybersecurity Governance \& Leadership:
   

 \- Establish and maintain enterprise\-wide cybersecurity governance in line with SAMA CSF and NCA ECC requirements.
   

 \- Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and segregation of duties across cybersecurity functions.
   

 \- Advise executive management on cybersecurity risks, threats, and control effectiveness.
   

 \- Ensure cybersecurity considerations are embedded into corporate governance and enterprise risk management.
   

  

 Cybersecurity Risk Management \& Compliance:
   

 \- Own and oversee the cybersecurity risk management framework.
   

 \- Ensure continuous compliance with applicable regulations and industry good practices.
   

 \- Ensure timely remediation of audit findings and regulatory observations.
   

 \- Act as the primary point of accountability for cybersecurity matters with regulators.
   

  

 Security Operations \& Technology Oversight:
   

 \- Oversee cybersecurity operations including monitoring, detection, vulnerability management, IAM, and incident response.
   

 \- Ensure effective prevention, detection, response, and recovery capabilities.
   

 \- Govern the selection and operation of cybersecurity technologies.
   

 \- Ensure security by design across infrastructure, applications, cloud, and data platforms.
   

  

 Incident Management \& Cyber Resilience:
   

 \- Ensure effective incident response and cyber crisis management.
   

 \- Lead executive coordination during material cybersecurity incidents.
   

 \- Ensure alignment with business continuity and disaster recovery.
   

 \- Oversee post\-incident reviews.
   

  

 Third\-Party \& Outsourcing Cybersecurity:
   

 \- Ensure third\-party cybersecurity risks are identified and managed.
   

 \- Ensure compliance of vendors with regulatory and contractual obligations.

The Associate Director, Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineering is responsible for leading the execution, implementation, operational stability, resilience, automation, and cost optimization of Digital infrastructure and DevOps foundations across all Qiddiya Digital assets. This role acts as the Digital execution owner for infrastructure services, cloud environments, DevOps enablement, automation, observability foundations, infrastructure reliability, operational readiness, and infrastructure cost management. The role ensures that Digital infrastructure and platform services are implemented, maintained, and operated in alignment with Qiddiya enterprise cloud guidelines, cybersecurity requirements, architecture standards, compliance policies, and governance frameworks. This role does not own Qiddiya's enterprise cloud strategy, enterprise cloud governance, company\-wide cloud standards, application development, or application maintenance. These responsibilities remain with the relevant central Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, and application delivery teams. Instead, this role is accountable for translating enterprise cloud and infrastructure guidelines into practical execution across Digital environments, vendors, infrastructure services, DevOps tooling, deployment foundations, production readiness, and platform operations. This is a senior technical leadership role requiring strong infrastructure depth, DevOps execution experience, vendor governance, operational ownership, and the ability to drive Restricted This document has been classified as Restricted by Samy Baili reliable, secure, scalable, automated, and cost\-efficient Digital infrastructure across multiple System Integrators and delivery teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Infrastructure \& Platform Execution
* Lead the implementation and operationalization of Digital infrastructure and platform services across all Digital assets and environments
* 
* Translate enterprise cloud guidelines, architecture principles, cybersecurity requirements, and governance expectations into executable Digital infrastructure plans
* Ensure Digital workloads are implemented in line with approved QIC technology standards, security policies, compliance requirements, and operational controls
* Drive consistency across Digital environments, including development, SIT, UAT, staging, pre\-production, production, and hotfix environments
* Ensure infrastructure foundations are production\-ready, secure, resilient, scalable, observable, and aligned with Digital delivery needs
* Work closely with the central Cloud team to ensure alignment with enterprise direction while owning Digital\-level execution
* Ensure infrastructure decisions are documented, reviewed, controlled, and implemented through the appropriate governance channels. DevOps Engineering \& Automation
* Lead the execution of DevOps engineering practices across Digital infrastructure and platform services
* Drive automation of infrastructure provisioning, environment setup, configuration management, deployment support, and operational tasks
* Support the adoption and governance of Infrastructure as Code, automated provisioning, controlled deployments, and auditable environment changes
* Partner with DevSecOps teams to ensure infrastructure services are integrated into CI/CD pipelines, release governance, security gates, and deployment workflows
* Ensure Digital environments support faster, safer, and more predictable delivery without compromising compliance, security, or operational stability.
* Identify and remove infrastructure, environment, and deployment bottlenecks impacting Digital delivery teams.
* Drive standardization of DevOps practices across vendors, System Integrators, and Digital technology teams. Infrastructure Reliability \& Resilience
* Own the reliability, resilience, stability, and operational health of Digital infrastructure and platform services
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, backup, failover, recovery, and capacity practices are implemented and tested across Digital assets.
* Drive the implementation of resilience requirements for mission\-critical Digital journeys from an infrastructure and platform perspective
* Reduce infrastructure\-related incidents, environment instability, deployment blockers, and operational risks
* Establish operational readiness criteria before go\-live, including monitoring, alerting, escalation paths, runbooks, support models, backup readiness, and recovery procedures.
* Ensure Digital infrastructure can support business growth without compromising reliability, performance, availability, security, or cost control.
* Partner with application teams and vendors to support production readiness while keeping application ownership with the relevant delivery teams. Infrastructure Operations \& Run Management
* Lead the operational management of Digital infrastructure services across all Digital products, environments, and vendors
* Define and enforce operational practices for environment availability, infrastructure maintenance, incident support, release support, and service continuity.
* Ensure clear ownership and accountability across System Integrators, vendors, internal teams, and support functions for infrastructure operations.
* Drive proactive issue identification, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement for infrastructure and platform\-related issues.
* Ensure operational documentation, runbooks, support models, escalation paths, handover materials, and recovery procedures are complete and maintained.
* Act as the Digital execution owner for infrastructure operations, ensuring vendors operate under a consistent, controlled, and measurable model.
* Partner with ICC and operations teams to ensure infrastructure\-related production issues are visible, actionable, and resolved with the right ownership
* Cloud Execution Alignment
* Ensure Digital infrastructure execution is aligned with Qiddiya enterprise cloud strategy, cloud standards, architecture guardrails, and governance requirements.
* Work with the central Cloud team to translate enterprise cloud direction into practical execution across Digital environments and assets.
* Implement approved cloud patterns, landing zone requirements, network designs, security controls, access models, and operational standards within Digital.
* Provide feedback to the central Cloud team on execution challenges, operational risks, cost impacts, and improvement opportunities observed across Digital.
* Ensure Digital cloud workloads are implemented in a secure, compliant, scalable, and cost\-efficient way
* Avoid duplication of enterprise cloud governance by keeping the role focused on Digital execution, operationalization, and run management. FinOps \& Cost Management
* Own Digital infrastructure cost visibility, optimization, and accountability.
* Establish and drive FinOps practices across Digital infrastructure services, environments, vendors, and products.
* Monitor infrastructure spend and ensure costs are aligned with business value, usage, capacity, and growth expectations.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives across compute, storage, networking, environments, observability tooling, DevOps tooling, and vendor\-managed services.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field
* 10\+ years of experience with cloud engineering (Azure preferred)
* Understanding of IaC, monitoring and cloud security fundamentals
* Ability to collaborate with DevSecOps and cyber stakeholders

**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Manager, Data Domain and Products is accountable for governing, coordinating, and enabling a portfolio of data domains and their associated data products, rather than owning a single domain directly.
   

  

 The role ensures that domain data owners (Principal Specialists) operate within a consistent enterprise framework for data products, governance, quality, and value realization. It acts as the portfolio‑level authority, aligning domain priorities with enterprise strategy, resolving cross‑domain conflicts, and ensuring that data products are delivered as reusable, governed assets rather than siloed solutions.
   

  

 This role is responsible for how data domains operate together, how data products are prioritized and standardized, and how domain outputs collectively support enterprise reporting, operations, controls, and decision‑making.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide leadership and oversight across multiple data domains, each owned by a designated domain owner
* Ensure domain owners apply consistent principles for data ownership, stewardship, modeling, quality, and governance.
* Balance demand across domains by prioritizing data products based on enterprise value, regulatory need, and readiness.
* Ensure domain data products integrate cleanly with enterprise platforms and downstream consumers.
* Act as the primary business‑facing interface for enterprise data domains, translating strategic needs into coordinated domain roadmaps.
* Enable domain owners to focus on execution by removing blockers, resolving dependencies, and clarifying priorities.
* Ensure lifecycle artifacts (ownership, definitions, quality expectations, refresh SLAs) are consistently produced across domains.
* Lead and develop domain owners, ensuring clarity of role boundaries between domain ownership and enterprise oversight.

* Educate patients, families, and caregivers on rehabilitation techniques, safe mobility, and long\-term condition management.

* Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills.

data.jd_text:
**JOB PURPOSE:** 




 To lead the planning, execution, and adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, Intelligent Automation, and emerging technology initiatives across Dubai Chambers. The role will drive AI transformation projects, coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders, manage technology partners, and ensure successful implementation of AI solutions that enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, and organizational innovation.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




  





**AI Transformation Strategy \& Implementation** 



* Lead the implementation of Dubai Chambers' AI transformation roadmap.
* Identify and prioritize AI use cases across business functions.
* Support the deployment of AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Ensure alignment between AI initiatives and organizational objectives.



  





**AI Project \& Program Management** 



* Manage end\-to\-end AI and automation projects from concept through implementation.
* Develop project plans, timelines, governance frameworks, and performance metrics.
* Coordinate stakeholders, vendors, and internal teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, budgets, and implementation progress.



  





**AI Innovation \& Emerging Technologies** 



* Monitor developments in AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
* Evaluate innovative solutions and recommend adoption opportunities.
* Conduct pilot programs and proof\-of\-concept initiatives.
* Support business cases for AI investments and technology adoption



  





**Intelligent Automation \& Process Optimization** 



* Identify opportunities to automate and optimize business processes.
* Collaborate with departments to redesign workflows using AI and automation technologies.
* Measure and track efficiency improvements and business benefits.



  





**Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management** 



* Engage with business units to understand operational requirements and transformation opportunities.
* Promote AI awareness and adoption across the organization.
* Support change management activities associated with AI implementation.
* Deliver presentations, workshops, and awareness sessions to stakeholders.








**Vendor \& Technology Management** 



* Manage relationships with AI technology providers, consultants, and implementation partners.
* Participate in solution evaluations, procurement activities, and vendor assessments.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure delivery against agreed objectives.



  





**Governance \& Responsible AI** 



* Support the development and implementation of AI governance frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data privacy, and ethical AI requirements.
* Promote responsible and secure use of AI technologies across Dubai Chambers.



  





**Information Security** 



* Adherence to the information security policies/processes/program and for reporting any security breaches or incidents to the direct management.



  





**Policies, Systems, Processes \& Procedures** 



* Support the development and continuous improvement of incubation frameworks, methodologies, and operational processes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable policies, governance requirements, and ethical AI principles.
* Contribute to the implementation of best practices in startup incubation and venture development.



  





**Quality, Health, Security, Safety and Environment** 



* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and relevant quality, health, safety, security and environmental procedures and controls across the Department to guarantee employee safety and delivery of high\-quality services.



  





**Reporting** 



* Prepare executive reports, dashboards, and updates on AI initiatives.
* Monitor project KPIs, adoption rates, and business impact.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 




**Minimum Qualification** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Digital Transformation, or a related field.



  





**Preferred Qualification** 



* Master's Degree in Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation, Technology Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.



  





**Professional Certifications (Preferred)** 



* PMP or PRINCE2
* Agile / Scrum Certification
* AI, Cloud, or Digital Transformation Certifications



  





**Minimum Experience and Skills** 



* 6–8 years of experience in technology, digital transformation, project management, or innovation.
* Minimum 3–5 years leading AI, automation, digital transformation, or emerging technology initiatives.
* Experience managing cross\-functional projects and external technology partners.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience implementing AI, Generative AI, Copilot, automation, or intelligent workflow solutions.
* Experience within government, semi\-government, large enterprise, or digital transformation environments.
* Experience managing enterprise\-wide technology adoption programs.
